jobs.description:
Remote | United Kingdom | Crypto & Payments | FCA Authorisation | Employment or B2B

Our client is an established, profitable fintech operating at the intersection of crypto and traditional payments. It runs a consumer on/off-ramp platform and a fast-growing B2B infrastructure business: APIs and white-label solutions that let exchanges, neobanks, PSPs, wallets and other platforms embed regulated crypto and fiat services. The company is authorised under MiCA and PSD2 in the EU and is now building its regulatory presence in the UK. The culture is owner-led, high-ownership and low-bureaucracy: decisions are made quickly and close to the founders.

About the role

This is a senior, hands-on legal role with a single, clear mandate: own the company’s UK regulatory build. You will report directly to the CEO and be the most senior legal voice in the business on UK matters.

The UK’s new cryptoasset regime takes effect in October 2027. From that date, regulated cryptoasset activity in the UK requires FCA authorisation. You will own a first-wave authorisation under this new regime end to end, alongside a UK e-money application. For a regulatory lawyer, this is a career-defining piece of work, and the window to start it is narrow.

The role has no direct reports at hire. You will work closely with the company’s EU legal function. This is a deliberately focused UK mandate, not a group legal role.

What you will own

  • FCA cryptoasset authorisation: perimeter analysis of B2C and B2B activities against the new regime, application strategy, drafting, regulatory business plan input, RFI handling and dialogue through to decision.

  • UK EMI application: ownership on the same basis, including sequencing between the two applications.

  • FCA relationship: acting as the senior in-house legal counterpart to the regulator.

  • UK conduct perimeter: the cryptoasset financial promotions regime, Consumer Duty, the UK Travel Rule, and safeguarding and prudential requirements.

  • Post-authorisation readiness: governance, senior manager and certification considerations, reporting and disclosures.

  • External counsel: briefing, directing and quality-controlling UK external counsel, and managing that spend.

  • International expansion: legal lead on additional licence applications in other jurisdictions, and advice where the UK and EU regulatory perimeters meet.

  • Commercial legal: drafting and negotiating English-law B2B agreements. This includes MSAs, API and white-label terms, referral and agent agreements, and banking, payment and card scheme counterparty agreements.

  • UK consumer-facing legal: consumer terms, financial promotions review and UK-specific disclosures.

  • UK employment: UK employment law and contractor arrangements, in partnership with HR.

What we are looking for

  • Qualified solicitor or barrister in England & Wales, typically with 8+ years PQE.

  • Hands-on UK financial services regulatory experience, including at least one FCA authorisation or variation of permission that you personally owned or materially led, from perimeter analysis to decision.

  • Direct, personal interaction with the FCA: correspondence, meetings and representation that you led yourself.

  • Crypto or digital-asset legal experience at licensed or established firms, such as registered or authorised exchanges, regulated on/off-ramps, licensed custodians or infrastructure providers.

  • Cryptoasset, e-money or payments perimeter experience. Engagement with the 2025–26 FCA cryptoasset consultations is highly relevant.

  • Ability to draft and negotiate English-law B2B fintech agreements independently.

  • A track record of owning regulatory outcomes, not only advising on them. Law-firm backgrounds are welcome where this is evident.

  • Ability to take a clear position under pressure from senior stakeholders and counterparties, and to translate legal risk into business options with a recommendation.

  • Comfort operating as a remote senior with no legal support structure beneath you, working with a leadership team based outside the UK.

  • Practical use of AI tools in legal drafting, research or review.

  • Fluent legal English to regulator-facing standard.

  • Existing right to work in the UK, and the ability to attend regulator meetings in London as required.

Team management experience is not required. We welcome strong senior counsel ready to step into a Head of Legal role.

Nice to have

  • Previous Head of Legal, GC or senior counsel role at a UK-authorised EMI, PI or FCA-registered cryptoasset firm.

  • Experience of a firm moving from AML registration to full FSMA authorisation.

  • Involvement in industry working groups or trade association engagement on the new UK crypto regime.

  • SM&CR experience.

  • Knowledge of UK safeguarding and prudential requirements for e-money and payments.

  • Crown Dependency (Jersey, Guernsey, Isle of Man) or Australian regulatory exposure.

  • Card scheme legal experience, such as Visa/Mastercard rules and principal membership.

  • Experience building a legal or regulatory function in a jurisdiction from scratch.

What’s on offer

  • A direct reporting line to the CEO and ownership of the company’s UK market entry.

  • A defining role in a first-wave authorisation under the UK’s new cryptoasset regime.

  • A remote setup in the UK, with a flat structure and fast decisions.

  • An employment or B2B contract, with a performance bonus linked to UK authorisation milestones.

  • A fast, transparent hiring process, typically completed within four weeks.

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the Programme

This is a structured 18–24 month global programme designed to launch high-potential commercial careers. You don’t need prior sales or payments experience; what you need is ambition, curiosity, resilience, and the drive to build relationships and solve complex problems.

You will join a global cohort of Business Development Representatives (BDRs) with structured learning, dedicated coaching from sales leaders, and real commercial responsibility from month one. Throughout the programme, you will master enterprise sales: researching strategic accounts, engaging senior decision-makers, conducting sharp discovery conversations, and building pipeline that drives real business growth.

High performers transition into Sales, Account Management, and other commercial roles across the business. Many of our top commercial leaders, including our Chief Revenue Officer, started their journey at Checkout.com as BDRs or interns. Whether you are a recent graduate, an early-career professional with 1–3 years of experience, or a career switcher, what matters most is your hunger to learn and achieve.

What You’ll Do

  • Research Strategic Accounts: Identify high-value targets by researching key organizations, industries, and executive stakeholders.

  • Initiate High-Impact Outreach: Open doors with senior decision-makers using personalized outreach across email, phone, and LinkedIn.

  • Build Qualified Pipeline: Drive consistent growth momentum through disciplined prospecting, rigorous follow-up, and account mapping.

  • Run Consultative Discovery: Uncover merchants' technical and business challenges to align Checkout.com’s solutions with their goals.

  • Partner on Live Deals: Work alongside Sales Representatives to support opportunities through to deal execution.

  • Leverage AI & Modern Tech: Use CRM, intent data, and approved AI tools to streamline research, refine outreach, and work smarter.

Who We’re Looking For

We welcome applications from recent graduates and professionals with 1–3 years of experience looking to change careers. Regardless of your background, we are looking for the following core skills to set you up for success:

  • Driven & Goal-Oriented: You set high personal standards, work hard, and stay motivated when tackling challenging commercial goals.

  • Resilient & Adaptable: You bounce back quickly from rejection, view obstacles as practice, and maintain consistent output.

  • Relational & Engaging: You genuinely enjoy starting conversations, asking sharp questions, and building trust with diverse stakeholders.

  • Track Record of Achievement: You demonstrate drive and ownership through professional, academic, athletic, or entrepreneurial success.

  • Commercial & Tech Curiosity: You are eager to learn complex fintech products and use AI and sales tools to work smarter.

  • Coachability & Clear Communication: You listen well, articulate ideas clearly, and actively apply feedback to improve performance.

What You’ll Get Out of It

A 2-year structured programme that ensures you have a successful career in sales. A clear progression pathway built around key pillars:

  • Fintech & Enterprise Sales Mastery: Build deep expertise in global payments, digital commerce, and complex deal execution alongside experienced Account Executives.

  • AI-Native Commercial Skills: Master modern sales tools, intent data, and AI to automate routine tasks and focus on high-impact prospecting.

  • Coaching & Leadership Growth: Receive 1:1 mentorship from sales leaders, earn certifications, and take on senior BDR responsibilities, from mentoring peers to working on live deals through pricing and signing

  • Direct Career Acceleration: Graduate with a tight-knit global network and a direct pathway into Account Executive, Account Management, or Commercial Strategy roles.

Want to Stand Out?

When we review your CV, ensure you show us why you're great for this role. Ensure and share something you’ve built, led or achieved, whether that’s hitting a target, launching a side project, or leading a team effort.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

  • Who should apply? Recent graduates, early-career professionals (1–3 years experience), and career changers with strong commercial drive.

  • When does the programme start? We have start dates in March and September 2027.

  • What is the application deadline? Apply early for the best chance of being reviewed. We will close once we receive a sufficient number of applications.

  • Where are the roles located? We have roles in London, New York, Barcelona, Amsterdam, Riyadh, Dubai, and Shanghai.

  • Do I need a second language? Fluent English is required. Specific local language proficiency may be required depending on the hiring region.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.

Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.

Dave is an inspector. Today he's climbing through one of Europe's biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he'll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.

We're building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we're building the world's largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.

It's a $2T market and we're just getting started, with ambitions. We work with 6 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.

We've assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Goldman Sachs, Flexport and Amazon.

Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures, the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with 100+ unicorns backed to date.

About the role

We're hiring our first Product Designer.

Every engineer at Scope is a product engineer: they talk to users, decide what to build and ship it themselves. You'll work the same way, with design as your edge, and help the engineers around you to build a better product. That covers the whole experience, not just the surface: which problem we solve, how the flow works, what happens when things go wrong, and how it all looks. You'll work closely with the engineers, with Ish our Product Manager, and with Jakob the CTO.

We work in person five days a week from our office in Farringdon.

What you'll work on

Some examples of surfaces in our product that will need your help:

  • Our mobile app gets used inside tanks and on top of pressure vessels. People wear thick gloves, there's usually no signal, and one hand is often holding on to something. Most of what makes a normal app pleasant doesn't apply there, so a big part of the job is figuring out what does.

  • Then there's the report. How AI and the inspector will work together to produce 40 page reports and review them is something nobody has designed well yet.

  • Inspectors but also decision makers should be able to ask things like "Which tanks were over the corrosion limit last year?". Sometimes the right interface will be a chat but often it isn't.

What you'll do

  • Go on site with inspectors and test your designs there, gloves and all.

  • Own the design of every launch, down to the empty states.

  • Prototype fast, in code when it helps.

  • Work next to engineers while they build, so the details come out right.

  • Decide with Ish and Jakob which problems are worth solving.

  • Build the design system that lets engineers ship great work without waiting on you.

Who you are

  • Minimum 3 years designing products that were shipped.

  • A portfolio that shows the messy middle, not just the final screens.

  • You sweat the mobile details: touch targets, offline, errors.

  • You have opinions on where AI helps and where it gets in the way.

  • You'd happily put on a hard hat to understand a problem.

  • Bonus if you've designed for industrial or field work, or prototype in code.

Interview process

  • Intro call.

  • Portfolio deep dive with Ish and an engineer: one project, including what went wrong.

  • Interview with a cofounder: Jonny (CEO) or Jakob (CTO and CPO).

  • Onsite: a real Scope design problem, worked on with the team, then a short presentation.

  • Offer!

What we offer

  • £70k to £100k base + significant equity, so you have a stake in what you are building

  • Full visa sponsorship, giving us access to global talent and an international, diverse team

  • Tools to do your job, including a brand new MacBook and Scope merch

  • Generous above-market annual leave allowance

  • Bupa private medical (0 excess, pre-existing conditions covered) + Bupa dental

  • Employee pension through NEST

  • Flexible parental leave (including adoption leave)

  • Healthy meal-prep lunch and dinners, a fully stocked fridge, and team lunches on Fridays

  • Regular events including off-sites

We value diverse perspectives. If you don't match every point above but this is the kind of problem you want to work on, we strongly encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Customer Service Administrator
jobs.description:
About this job

Heb jij een passie voor klantenbegeleiding, interesse in de autosector én zin in een nieuwe job? Overloop dan zeker even de vacature en solliciteer bij een mooie match!

Momenteel zoeken we voor onze klant een gedreven customer service administrator. Je bent de spil tussen partners enerzijds en klanten anderzijds. Je staat iedere klant vlot te woord, helpt hen bij het maken van de juiste keuzes en volgt alles administratief op.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Als Customer Service Administrator ben jij hét eerste aanspreekpunt voor werknemers van klanten en begeleid je hen door het gehele proces. Concreet zijn dit jouw taken:

  • Klanten ondersteunen bij de keuze van de ideale mobiliteitsoplossing.
  • Samen nadenken over en adviseren bij een op maat gemaakt mobiliteitsplan.
  • Offertes opvragen bij leveranciers en deze bespreekbaar maken met de klant.
  • Werknemers up-to-date houden over de status van hun bestelling en afspraken.
  • Nauwkeurige administratieve verwerking en gegevensregistratie in het systeem.

Als Medewerker Automotive herken jij jezelf in de volgende eigenschappen:

  • Meertaligheid: Je spreekt en schrijft professioneel Nederlands, Frans én Engels. Perfectie is geen must, maar vlot kunnen communiceren is essentieel.
  • Opleiding en ervaring: Bij voorkeur heb je een bachelordiploma of enkele jaren ervaring in een klantgerichte functie.
  • Mobiliteitskennis: Interesse in en enthousiasme voor mobiliteit zijn prioriteit, kennis van auto's is mooi meegenomen.
  • Teamspeler: Je staat bekend als een enthousiaste teamgenoot met een oplossingsgerichte mindset.
  • Bereikbaarheid: Je bent zelfstandig mobiel, of dit nu met een eigen wagen, openbaar vervoer of de fiets is.
  • Uitdagingen: Moeilijke vraagstukken motiveren je om alles uit jezelf te halen.

jobs.title: Wegenwerker
jobs.description:
Deze onderneming begon als een familiebedrijf en heeft sinds de oprichting in 1984 een indrukwekkende groei doorgemaakt op het gebied van expertise en materieel. Na jarenlang actief te zijn geweest in de regio Hasselt, verhuisde het bedrijf na ruim twintig jaar naar de huidige vestiging in Beringen. Met de intrede van een nieuwe generatie werd het aanbod verder uitgebreid en kwamen activiteiten als containertransport, slibvervoer en waterbouw erbij. Bovendien beschikt het bedrijf over een eigen breekwerf en betoncentrale.

Werken bij deze organisatie betekent deel uitmaken van een familiebedrijf met een heldere toekomstvisie en een blijvende passie voor het vak. De jarenlange ervaring op diverse terreinen, zoals transport, recycling en watergebonden projecten, vormt een sterke basis. Professionaliteit is terug te zien in de infrastructuur, het team en het moderne machinepark. Door de flexibele aanpak kan het bedrijf snel inspelen op ontwikkelingen en wordt elke vorm van input, zowel van medewerkers als van externe partners, gewaardeerd. Een persoonlijke benadering staat centraal; voor vragen en advies is er altijd ruimte, wat zorgt voor een open en toegankelijke sfeer.

Bij deze werkgever staat samenwerking, betrokkenheid en ontwikkeling van medewerkers hoog in het vaandel.


Jobomschrijving

3 redenen om voor deze job te kiezen

  • Je hebt werkzekerheid
  • Je werkt met de beste materialen
  • Je werkt in een welgekende firma


Zo ziet je job er uit

Voor deze job als wegenwerker regio Beringen zullen je taken bestaan uit:

  • Assisteren bij het leggen van bestrating, asfalteren, en het verrichten van grondwerken
  • Aanleveren van materialen en gereedschappen
  • Verrichten van eenvoudige graaf- en sloopwerkzaamheden
  • Zorgen voor een schone en veilige werkplek
  • Volgen van veiligheidsvoorschriften en -procedures
  • Eventuele andere taken zoals aangegeven door de ploegbaas

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Onze klant is voor deze job als wegenwerker in regio Beringen op zoek naar iemand die zich herkent in volgende zaken:

  • Een eerste ervaring in de wegenbouw
  • In staat om fysiek zwaar werk te verrichten.
  • Bereid om in de buitenlucht te werken, ongeacht de weersomstandigheden.
  • Je geraakt elke dag tot in Paal (Beringen)

jobs.title: Medewerker Proshop

Dankzij jouw technische kennis en commerciële flair zorg je ervoor dat elke klant met de juiste oplossing én een goed gevoel naar huis gaat.

Wat ga je doen?

Geen enkele dag is hetzelfde. Dit mag je verwachten:

  • Je geeft technisch en commercieel advies over ons uitgebreide assortiment sanitair, verwarming, airco, ventilatie en hernieuwbare energie.
  • Je verwerkt bestellingen, offertes, verkoopbonnen en betalingen correct en efficiënt.
  • Je stelt bestellingen samen en controleert goederen op kwaliteit, aantallen en verpakking.
  • Je ontvangt leveringen, voert controles uit en houdt de voorraad nauwkeurig bij.

  • Je bouwt mee aan duurzame klantenrelaties en werkt hiervoor nauw samen met de andere collega’s in het filiaal en de vertegenwoordiger.

Deze kennis en ervaring breng je mee

  • Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring met magazijnbeheer en toonbankverkoop.
  • Een technische achtergrond in sanitaire installaties, bouw, koeling of centrale verwarming is een sterke plus. Je bent leergierig om onze producten snel te leren kennen.

Waarom kiezen voor STG?

Bij STG krijg je geen koude douche, maar een warm bad. Je komt terecht in een stabiele en ambitieuze organisatie waar mensen centraal staan en waar je elke dag kan groeien.

jobs.title: ICT Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
Als ICT Systems Administrator maak je samen met 2 collega's deel uit van het Datacenter team dat instaat voor de uitbating en de verdere uitbouw van de centrale infrastructuur en bijbehorende operations. Je rapporteert aan Thomas De Baerdemaecker - Teamlead daily operations en je werkt nauw samen met jouw collega's binnen Directie ICT

Een greep uit je takenpakket:

  • Je staat mee in voor het dagelijkse beheer, de monitoring en de verdere uitbouw van de VMware-omgeving, waaronder de ESXi-hosts, vCenter en de virtuele machines;
  • Je beheert en controleert de back-upomgeving met Veeam. Je volgt de uitvoering van back-ups en replicaties op en voert regelmatig restore-tests uit;
  • Je werkt mee aan updates, upgrades en capaciteitsbeheer van de VMware- en Veeam-omgeving en helpt de beschikbaarheid en continuïteit van de infrastructuur te garanderen;
  • Security is een constant aandachtspunt, een deel van je taken zal zich dan ook toespitsen op het monitoren en verbeteren van de ICT-infrastructuur op dit vlak;
  • Samen met je collega's sta je in voor de 2de en 3de-lijngebruikersondersteuning en het oplossen van systeemgerelateerde incidenten en problemen;
  • Je volgt het serverpark op door middel van management- en monitoringtools, en helpt mee aan de constante verbetering en uitbouw ervan;
  • Je documenteert de configuratie en procedures die je dagdagelijks uitvoert;
  • Je kan meewerken om de ICT-infrastructuurvisie om te zetten in een technische implementatie;
  • Door middel van een vlotte communicatie en transparante werking ben je een aanspreekpunt voor zowel de collega's binnen ICT alsook de betrokken businessdepartementen;
  • Je draagt proactief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het VUB ICT Operations team en informeert je over de nieuwe evoluties.

Voor deze functie zal Brussels Humanities, Sciences & Engineering Campus (Elsene) je thuisbasis worden, in combinatie met thuiswerk.

Wat verwachten wij van jou?

  • Je hebt een bachelor in de informatica, systeem- en netwerkbeheerder of gelijkaardig, of bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring
  • Idealiter heb je minstens drie jaar relevante werkervaring in systeembeheer of het beheer van datacenterinfrastructuur. Ook als gemotiveerde starter met de juiste technische basis en ambitie kan je in aanmerking komen;
  • Je hebt kennis van virtualisatie en bij voorkeur ervaring met VMware (ESXi, vCenter);
  • Je hebt kennis van back-up en restore, bij voorkeur met Veeam Backup & Replication;
  • Je hebt ervaring met het beheer, de monitoring en beveiliging van Windows Server, en een goede kennis van Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS en DHCP;
  • Je hebt basiskennis van server- en storage-infrastructuur en PowerShell en staat open voor verdere automatisering;
  • Kennis van Linux, Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune en beheer- of monitoringtools is een pluspunt;
  • Je bent vertrouwd met tweede- en derdelijnsondersteuning of bent bereid je hierin verder te ontwikkelen;
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd, documenteert duidelijk en hebt aandacht voor informatieveiligheid, beschikbaarheid, back-up en disaster recovery;
  • Je werkt zelfstandig én goed in team, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en bent klant- en oplossingsgericht;
  • Je communiceert zeer vlot in het Nederlands en beschikt over een goede professionele kennis van het Engels;
  • Last but not least ben je ook eenvoudigweg een fijne collega om mee samen te werken;

VUB wil een weerspiegeling zijn van de maatschappij waar ieders talent wordt gewaardeerd, ongeacht het gender, geslacht, leeftijd, religie, huidskleur, migratieachtergrond, functiebeperking en de neurodiversiteit.

jobs.title: Creatieve Product manager
jobs.description:
Bmfabrics is een editeur van interieurtextiel. Een ondernemend familiebedrijf in Herzele van meer dan 75 jaar die internationaal actief is. De raamdecoratie die bmfabrics aanbiedt brengt dagelijks emotie en beleving bij onze dealers in Benelux, Frankrijk en onze wereldwijde distributeurs. Samen met ons team van 45 werknemers streven we naar een productieve, maar familiale sfeer. Om ons team te versterken zoeken we een creatief talent die onze verschillende collecties (bmfabrics, ode en así) helpt vorm te geven.


Jobomschrijving

Ben jij de kleurrijkste in huis, volledig wild van textiel en een echte trendwatcher ? Bmfabrics zoekt een creatieve product manager met een liefde voor kleur, interieur en textiel.

  • Je detecteert de nieuwste interieur en- stoffen trends en vertaalt deze naar een coherente en commerciële collectie in lijn met de stijl van bmfabrics/ode/así.

  • Je staat in voor kwaliteitskeuze en designs maar ook voor het kleurenpallet.

jobs.title: Besiktningstekniker till Besiktas station i Timrå
jobs.description:
Är du fordonsintresserad och söker ett socialt arbete med mycket kundkontakt?Vill du ha ett socialt arbete där du får använda ditt tekniska kunnande och samtidigt ha mycket kundkontakt? Då är detta jobbet för dig! Som besiktningstekniker får du använda ditt tekniska intresse varje dag, samtidigt som du skapar långsiktiga kundrelationer. Tidigare erfarenhet av att besikta fordon är inte ett krav. Däremot ser vi gärna att du har ett intresse för fordon och grundläggande fordonsteknisk kunskap att bygga vidare på.

Dina arbetsuppgifterSom besiktningstekniker kommer du att utföra noggranna och säkerhetsfokuserade fordonsbesiktningar, samtidigt som du skapar en positiv helhetsupplevelse för våra kunder genom tydlig, trevlig och förtroendeskapande kommunikation. I tjänsten ingår det även försäljning av våra tilläggstjänster och trygghetspaket, där du guidar kunden utifrån deras behov och intressen. Du bidrar till en trygg arbetsmiljö genom samarbete och ansvarstagande, och möter en varierande arbetsdag fylld med tekniska utmaningar och kundkontakt.

Från fordonsintresse till certifierad teknikerFör att lyckas i tjänsten erbjuder vi en omfattande utbildning som leder till att du blir certifierad besiktningstekniker för de fordon du kommer att arbeta med. Utbildningen bygger vidare på ett befintligt fordonsintresse och en grundläggande fordonteknisk förståelse, något som gör det lättare att ta till sig innehållet och få ut det mesta möjliga av utbildningen. Under utbildningen får du stöd av vår utbildningsorganisation och erfarna handledare, så att du steg för steg känner dig trygg i tjänsten innan du arbetar självständigt.

För hos oss får du mer än bara ett jobb:Utbildning och certifiering till besiktningstekniker - vi satsar på dig och din kompetensEn tjänst med ansvar och frihet - där du får driva och utveckla stationenTrygghet och stabilitet - vi är en arbetsgivare med kollektivavtal och schyssta villkorVariation i vardagen - med både teknik, kundkontakt och självständigt ansvar.

Vi söker dig som:

    Har ett genuint intresse för fordon och teknik
    Har ett skarpt öga för detaljer och trivs med att arbeta efter fastställda säkerhetskrav
    Är engagerad i att kontinuerligt utbilda dig och utveckla din kunskap
    Är duktig på att bygga och underhålla goda kundrelationer
    Är bekväm med försäljning och ser det som en naturlig del av kundmötet
    Trivs i en dynamisk arbetsmiljö och kan snabbt anpassa dig till förändringar

    Talar och skriver svenska obehindrat
    God fordonskunskap och teknisk kompetens
    B körkort (manuell)

Meriterande: Arbetslivserfarenhet och/eller utbildning inom fordonsteknik, sälj samt service. Körkort för fler fordonstyper som är relevant för stationen är meriterande.

Om tjänstenVi erbjuder en heltidstjänst där anställningen inleds med en provanställning på sex månader, därefter övergår den till en tillsvidareanställning. Arbetstiderna är varierade och förlagda över veckans alla dagar, inklusive kvällar och helger. Tjänstgöring på andra stationer i närområdet kommer att förekomma.

Tillträde och rekryteringsprocessVi kommer att göra urval efter sista ansökningsdatum. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Som en del i vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi en säkerhetsbedömning som inkluderar belastningsregister, kreditupplysning, företagsverksamhet och körkortsinnehav - alltid med ditt samtycke.

Dela våra värderingar och ansök nu!Vi välkomnar sökanden av olika åldrar, kön och etniska bakgrunder, och det avgörande för oss är att du delar våra grundläggande värderingar GAS - Glädje, Ansvar och Stolthet i arbetet med kollegor och i mötet med våra kunder.

Besikta är en av Sveriges ledande aktörer inom fordonsbesiktning. Vår historia tar sin början i samband med avregleringen av den svenska besiktningsmarknaden 2010, då delar av den tidigare statliga Bilprovningens verksamhet blev grunden till det som idag är Besikta.

Sedan dess har vi vuxit till branschens bredaste stationsnätverk med över 200 stationer runt om i Sverige. Med drygt 600 medarbetare över hela landet arbetar vi varje dag för att bidra till ökad trafiksäkerhet och minskad miljöpåverkan genom att säkerställa att fordon uppfyller gällande krav och regelverk.

Besikta är idag en del av Applus+, en internationell koncern inom testning, inspektion och certifiering. Kombinationen av vår lokala närvaro och den globala styrkan inom Applus+ ger oss möjlighet att utveckla verksamheten och möta framtidens krav inom fordonsbesiktning och teknisk kontroll.

Det som förenar oss är vårt fokus på kvalitet, säkerhet och professionalism. Samtidigt värnar vi om en arbetsmiljö där samarbete, delaktighet och engagemang står i centrum. Våra värderingar Glädje, Ansvar och Stolthet (GAS), genomsyrar vårt arbete och beskriver hur vi möter kunder, samarbetar med kollegor och tar ansvar för vårt viktiga samhällsuppdrag.

Hos Besikta blir du en del av en verksamhet med en viktig roll i samhället, där vi tillsammans arbetar för säkrare vägar, nöjdare kunder och en hållbar framtid.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - Financial Services
jobs.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Mirakl Labs Financial Services squad, based in Paris. The team is structured as a cross-functional Squad composed of a Senior Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, Software Engineers  and a QA engineer. You'll be mentored by Wael Osmani, Software Engineer. You'll join a team that builds and ships the core product features powering some of the world's most ambitious marketplace platforms, with a particular focus on financial services capabilities.


2. Your Impact

  • Contribute to the development and evolution of a production application, primarily on the frontend — from UI implementation to user experience improvements
  • Support backend work by participating in API design and development, collaborating closely with the engineering team
  • Work hand-in-hand with UX/UI designers to deliver features that are both technically solid and user-centric
  • Take part in agile rituals — stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives — and contribute actively to the team's roadmap
  • Monitor and take ownership of your contributions in production, following a you build it, you run it mindset


3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • Currently pursuing a Master's degree (M1 or M2) in software engineering, computer science, or a related field, and looking for a 6-month internship
  • First hands-on development experience through an internship, academic project, apprenticeship, or personal project
  • Solid understanding of frontend development and object-oriented programming principles
Skills:
  • Proficiency or strong interest in frontend frameworks such as React or Angular, and in JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Familiarity with Java for backend and API development
  • Curiosity for clean code, software quality, and working on production-grade applications
  • A collaborative mindset, intellectual curiosity, and a genuine drive to learn


4. Tech Stack

  • Back-end: Java 21, Spring Boot
  • Front-end: ReactJS
  • Data & Messaging: Kafka, ElasticSearch, PostgreSQL
  • Tooling & Practices: CI/CD, Git, Docker, Monitoring


5. Languages

  • French: Fluent
  • English: Professional proficiency (written and spoken)

 

Compensation, Perks & Benefits

  • Pay Range: €1,200 – €1,400 per month

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter, then an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.
  2. Recruiter interview (30 min) — conversation about your background, motivations, and an introduction to Mirakl
  3. Hiring Manager interview (45 min) — technical discussion covering Java and web development fundamentals, including practical exercises
  4. STAR interview (1h) — exchange with one or two team members exploring Mirakl's values and culture

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French.

jobs.title: Satellite Systems Engineer (m/w/d), Space & Defense Industry
jobs.description:
About the Company

Infinite Orbits GmbH is the German subsidiary of Infinite Orbits SAS, a NewSpace company founded in 2017 that now has more than 200 employees, with locations including Luxembourg, the UK, Spain, and Singapore.

The company develops in-orbit servicing solutions built on its own autonomous Rendezvous and Proximity Operations (RPO) technology, spanning awareness, surveillance, inspection, and protection of space assets through to life extension.

With its newly established Munich site, Infinite Orbits builds a dedicated local presence in Germany, developing capabilities in business development, R&D, product development, system engineering, production, and mission operations to enable Europe's defense and space sector.

Infinite Orbits is looking for the founding team for its Munich site. Candidates who bring entrepreneurial drive, thrive in ambiguity, want ownership over what they build, and want to make a real difference in space are invited to explore the open positions on the company's website.

Job Description

About the Role

As Satellite Systems Engineer, you own the spacecraft. You turn the agreed mission concept into a buildable, verifiable spacecraft solution covering platform, payload, and their interfaces, drawing on the Infinite Orbits Group's platforms and on German suppliers and partners.

Proposal preparation is a core part of this role: you author the spacecraft design sections of Infinite Orbits Germany's bids, RFI/RFP responses, and funding applications. You substantiate sizing, heritage, and maturity, consolidate supplier input, and make sure that what we offer can be built, verified, and delivered within the cost and schedule we commit to. You work hand in hand with the Mission Systems Engineer, who owns the mission concept, and the Proposal & Project Manager, who runs the proposal process.

Once contracts are won, you carry the spacecraft design through reviews, verification, and integration, and you help build up spacecraft engineering and integration capability in Munich as our German hardware content grows.

  • Spacecraft proposal content: Author the spacecraft design sections of RFI/RFP responses, customer proposals, and national and European funding applications, covering configuration, subsystem and payload selection, spacecraft budgets, heritage and maturity (TRL) justification, compliance, and technical risks.

  • Cost & schedule input for bids: Provide the Proposal & Project Manager with the technical basis for proposal cost and schedule, including make-or-buy decisions, supplier selection, procurement lead times, and verification and integration effort.

  • Supplier & partner input: Request, assess, and consolidate technical offers from suppliers and partners into a coherent proposal baseline.

  • Spacecraft requirements & budgets: Own spacecraft-level requirements derived from the mission baseline and manage spacecraft budgets (mass, power, thermal, link, pointing, propellant) through design and delivery.

  • Interfaces & integration: Define and manage platform, payload, and subsystem interfaces (ICDs), including the integration of payloads and subsystems from German partners.

  • Design reviews & verification: Prepare spacecraft design reviews and own verification and test planning at spacecraft level.

  • Project execution: Own spacecraft engineering workstreams on won contracts, ensuring delivery against technical and contractual requirements.

  • Group coordination: Work closely with platform engineering in Toulouse and other Group entities to reuse existing designs and keep the spacecraft baseline consistent across the Group.

  • Capability build-up: Support the build-up of spacecraft integration and verification capability in Germany as the German hardware share grows.

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Engineering degree in aerospace, space systems engineering, or a related field, or equivalent.

  • 3+ years of experience in spacecraft systems engineering, ideally at platform, prime, or integrator level.

  • Experience contributing spacecraft design, cost, or schedule content to technical proposals in the space or defense sector.

  • Experience with spacecraft integration, verification, or AIT is a plus.

Skills & Other Requirements

  • Strong command of spacecraft subsystems and their interactions (AOCS/GNC, power, thermal, propulsion, communications, structures, data handling).

  • Working knowledge of ECSS standards and spacecraft verification approaches.

  • Ability to size and defend spacecraft solutions, including heritage and maturity claims, under customer or stakeholder scrutiny.

  • Excellent structured writing: able to turn design work into clear, compliant proposal content under deadline pressure.

  • Experience working with suppliers and partners on technical offers and interface definitions.

  • Autonomy and ownership: comfortable owning workstreams independently in an early-stage, cross-border team environment, working closely with Group entities in France and beyond.

  • Fluent in German and English.

  • Willingness to undergo a German security clearance procedure (Sicherheitsüberprüfung).

  • Frequent travel required within Germany and to Infinite Orbits' HQ in Toulouse and other European locations.

What we offer

  • A founding technical role with direct ownership of spacecraft design and proposal content in a growing European space and defense company.

  • Direct influence on how Infinite Orbits builds spacecraft engineering and integration capability in Germany, in close collaboration with the Infinite Orbits Group.

We are looking forward to your application!

jobs.description:
Über das Unternehmen

Die Infinite Orbits GmbH ist die deutsche Tochtergesellschaft der Infinite Orbits SAS, eines 2017 gegründeten NewSpace-Unternehmens mit heute mehr als 200 Mitarbeitenden und Standorten unter anderem in Luxemburg, Großbritannien, Spanien und Singapur.

Mit dem neuen Standort in München baut Infinite Orbits eine eigene Präsenz in Deutschland auf und entwickelt Kompetenzen in den Bereichen Business Development, Forschung und Entwicklung, Produktentwicklung, Systems Engineering, Produktion und Missionsbetrieb, um den europäischen Verteidigungs- und Raumfahrtsektor zu stärken.

  • Partnerschaften & Teaming: Aufbau von Partnerschaften und Konsortien mit der deutschen Industrie, KMU und Forschungseinrichtungen für gemeinsame Angebote und Programme.

  • Beschaffungs- und Förderprogramme: Beobachtung nationaler und europäischer Beschaffungs- und Förderinstrumente in Raumfahrt und Verteidigung und Qualifizierung von Opportunities, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den R&D and Innovation Managern.

  • Marktbeobachtung: Analyse von Kundenprogrammen, Budgets, Wettbewerbern und Partnerlandschaft; Einbringen der Erkenntnisse in die Produktpositionierung und das Angebot der Gruppe.

Anforderungen

Ausbildung & Erfahrung

  • Ein etabliertes Netzwerk im deutschen Verteidigungs- und Raumfahrtumfeld (Bundeswehr, Beschaffungsorganisationen, DLR, Industrie) ist ein großer Vorteil.

Fähigkeiten & weitere Anforderungen

  • Fundiertes Verständnis deutscher und europäischer Vergabeverfahren in Raumfahrt und Verteidigung.

  • Ausreichendes technisches Verständnis von Raumfahrtsystemen, um In-Orbit-Servicing- und RPO-Lösungen mit Kunden glaubwürdig zu diskutieren.

  • Regelmäßige Reisetätigkeit innerhalb Deutschlands sowie zum Hauptsitz von Infinite Orbits in Toulouse und zu weiteren europäischen Standorten.

Was wir bieten

  • Eine Rolle im Gründungsteam mit direkter Verantwortung für Kundenbeziehungen, Capture und Angebote in einem wachsenden europäischen Raumfahrt- und Verteidigungsunternehmen.

jobs.title: Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights
jobs.description:
We are growing! We are currently looking to hire a Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights.  

About CXG:

Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide.

The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation.

We are passionate about delivering impact.

Our clients include the world's most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction.

We are looking for a thought leadership expert with the editorial vision to spot what matters next, the conviction to shape CXG's point of view, and the writing talent to make it influential across luxury retail, beauty and cosmetics, watches and jewellery, automotive, and hospitality.

Context and role

Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will lead CXG's Thought Leadership and Market Intelligence functions. You will define the topics on which CXG should have a distinctive and credible point of view, turn CXG's proprietary data, expertise and market knowledge into original external content, and position the company ahead of emerging developments in customer experience, luxury and its priority verticals.

This is a hands-on role: you will research, analyse, write and produce content yourself, while mobilising expertise and data from across the business. You will be accountable for ensuring that every publication presents a recognisable CXG angle rather than simply reporting market developments or repeating established industry views. You will manage one Market Intelligence team member.

Thought Leadership Development

  • Define the thought leadership strategy and roadmap, including priority themes, target audiences, formats and a realistic publication calendar.
  • Drive and coordinate content creation across Practices, Solutions and Regions.
  • Work closely with Practices, Regions and Solutions to:
    • Push: scan for trends and hot topics and ensure CXG has a voice and perspective, commenting regularly on these subjects.
    • Pull: identify and collect new ideas and proposed topics from the relevant stakeholders, prioritise and incorporate them into the thought leadership roadmap.
  • Use market intelligence, CXG's proprietary data, internal expertise and client-facing insights to identify emerging topics early, develop a clear CXG point of view and decide where CXG can make a credible contribution to the conversation.
  • Research, interview internal experts, write and edit articles, perspectives and other thought leadership content directly. Challenge generic claims and ensure each piece advances a clear argument and is supported by credible evidence.
  • Ensure that analysis is methodologically sound, appropriately contextualised and presented without compromising client confidentiality.
  • Develop topics that connect expertise across Practices and Regions, while reflecting relevant differences between markets.

Thought Leadership Communication

  • Ensure relevant thought leadership pieces (e.g., perspectives, publications) are disseminated on a periodic basis.
  • Work with Marketing on the publication, distribution and promotion of content, while retaining ownership of the editorial strategy, substance, quality and consistency of CXG's point of view. In addition, collaborate with Marketing to maximise impact by communicating through the channels relevant to each market.
  • Track the reach, engagement and qualitative response generated by CXG's thought leadership, as well as relevant business enquiries influenced by published content. Use the findings to refine the roadmap.
  • Shape and host or contribute to CXG's podcast "The Luxury Edit", working with internal experts and guests to develop topics, prepare interviews and turn conversations into useful content.
  • Develop the content and key messages for CXG-hosted events and external conferences, panels and talks; act as a CXG speaker where appropriate; and work with internal experts to prepare other CXG speakers and turn the company's point of view into compelling presentations and discussion topics.
  • Look for and test new thought leadership formats (e.g., interactive reports, data visualisations, short-form video, newsletters, social-first content) to broaden reach, engage new audiences and keep CXG's content distinctive.
  • Identify and build collaborations with conferences, specialised industry magazines and universities (e.g., content partnerships, guest articles, co-branded publications, joint research, guest lectures, speaking slots) to extend CXG's visibility and credibility with target audiences.

Market Intelligence

  • Keep abreast of market and competitive developments and ensure relevant findings are communicated across CXG.
  • Translate these findings into clear implications for CXG's strategic priorities, client conversations, commercial opportunities and external thought leadership.
  • Contribute market intelligence, evidence and relevant CXG perspectives to priority proposals and client deliverables, working with Practices, Solutions and Regions to strengthen the quality and relevance of the final output.
  • Manage and develop the Market Intelligence team member, setting clear priorities and reviewing the quality and usefulness of their work.

Competitive Analysis

  • Develop and continuously update a list of CXG competitors.
  • Research competitor performance, including revenues and market share where reliable information is available.
  • Identify and assess the impact of new competitors' offerings.
  • Review competitors' thought leadership, influence and presence.
  • Identify gaps in the conversations competitors are leading and opportunities for CXG to establish a distinct position.

Industry Analysis

  • Research and review clients' developments (e.g., new strategy, launch of new product or service, restructuring, M&A, key managerial appointments).
  • Track public financial announcements (e.g., quarterly and annual earnings).
  • Monitor developments in luxury, retail, customer experience and adjacent sectors; distinguish lasting shifts from short-lived topics and explain their implications for CXG and its clients.
  • Publish the weekly "This Week in Luxury" news brief and issue timely flash updates when significant developments require immediate attention, such as financial announcements, major transactions or leadership changes.

Internal Dissemination and Application

  • Synthesise research and findings into concise, actionable outputs tailored to the needs of relevant internal stakeholders. Feed findings into the Thought Leadership roadmap.
  • Proactively bring relevant market signals to Practices, Regions and leadership early enough to inform decisions, client conversations and potential cross-practice opportunities.
  • Disseminate new thought leadership across CXG and equip Practices, Regions and client-facing teams with the key messages and supporting materials needed to use it in client conversations and commercial activities.

Requirements

What will you bring along?

    • Proven experience developing thought leadership, editorial content or insight-led communications in a consulting, research, customer experience, retail or luxury environment.
    • Excellent English writing and editing skills, with a portfolio demonstrating original, well-argued, evidence-led articles or publications written personally. If possible, include examples that turn proprietary research, data or specialist expertise into a distinctive point of view. Additional languages (e.g., French, Mandarin) are a plus.
    • Strong oral communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to represent CXG as a speaker at conferences, panels and client events.
    • Proven ability to build relationships and influence senior stakeholders across functions and regions without direct authority.
    • An established network or demonstrated ability to build partnerships with media, conference organisers, academic institutions or industry bodies.
    • Comfort working with quantitative data and research methods, and the ability to translate data into clear, credible narratives and visualisations.
    • Ability to define and track content performance indicators and use them to refine editorial priorities.
    • Strong research and analytical skills: able to assess sources critically, connect market signals and form a clear point of view rather than simply summarise trends.
    • Familiarity with AI-assisted research and content tools, used with appropriate rigour.
    • Sound knowledge of luxury, retail and customer experience, and curiosity about how these sectors are evolving across markets.
    • Ability to interview senior experts, challenge ideas constructively and turn specialist knowledge into accessible, credible content.
    • Comfort working independently in a remote setting, managing an editorial roadmap and delivering finished work without a large production team.
    • Experience managing or coaching at least one team member.
    • Confidence preparing and hosting interviews or podcasts is a plus.

jobs.title: Head of Enterprise IT
jobs.description:
At Sensio, we build welfare technology that health and care services rely on every day. Our solutions help create safer living environments and more sustainable care, across multiple products, countries and platforms.

We are a complex technology organization for our size. Product development, infrastructure, security and internal technology are closely connected, so how we run IT matters for everything we deliver.

Now we are looking for a Head of Enterprise IT to build and develop our Enterprise IT function and create a secure, scalable and modern technology foundation for the organization.


Your day-to-day

We want Enterprise IT to evolve from traditional IT administration toward a modern engineering-oriented function with strong automation, clear standards and close collaboration with the rest of the technology organization.

  • Enable AI across Sensio. You establish the secure foundation that lets teams use AI safely, prototype solutions yourself and create capabilities others can reuse.

  • Automate how IT is run. You are comfortable writing automation and Infrastructure as Code yourself, using Git, peer review and engineering practices to make changes secure and reproducible.

  • Simplify and prioritize. Understand why things are the way they are, then make them simpler. Challenge what we ask for and be clear about what it takes to reach our goals.

  • Own Sensio's IT. From identity and devices to business systems and integrations. You take responsibility for reliable operations, security, and continuous improvement. Set the direction, establish clear ownership, and balance technology with business needs.

  • Build and lead the function. Create clear roles and a way of working that scales with us, so IT doesn't depend on one person fixing every problem.


This is what we’re looking for

  • You have a technical background and have led or rebuilt an Enterprise IT, Corporate IT or similar function

  • You know IaC, Git, CI/CD, APIs and cloud well enough to build good solutions and talk easily with developers

  • You know IT changes affect colleagues who deliver around the clock, so you introduce new security measures and routines gradually, monitoring first and enforcing later

  • You build security into how things work, without adding unnecessary bureaucracy

  • You enjoy people as much as technology, and can bring both engineers and the business along

  • You have learned from things that didn’t work, and you use that experience to make better decisions

It’s a plus if you have experience with some of these:

  • Identity and devices: Entra ID, Intune, FreeIPA, EDR, across Mac, Windows and Linux

  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, PowerShell

  • Compliance: ISO 27001, change management

You don't need to be an expert in everything. Some of the best people we know took a less obvious path to get here.


What Sensio can offer

  • A job that really matters, supporting health and care every day

  • A real mandate to shape Enterprise IT from the ground up

  • A Norwegian product and technology environment with an established European presence

  • A central seat in product and tech, close to Infrastructure, Security and developers

  • Close collaboration with strong teams across hardware, software, product and design

  • Room to take ownership, influence technical direction and grow professionally

  • Oslo-based, with trips to Vestfold and other locations


Sound interesting?

If this role sparks something, let's have a chat.

We'd love to get to know you and can't wait to tell you more about what makes Sensio a great place to work. Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile, or reach out to Malin Mosskull (Talent Partner) at +47 46 79 32 77.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Sensio, we’re on a mission to accelerate the digital transformation of care. With roots in the Nordic start-up scene, we’ve grown into a fast-scaling caretech company backed by Nordic Capital, with more than 230 colleagues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the UK – and now expanding into Germany. Our technology is already installed in thousands of care homes and hospitals, helping staff prevent falls, save lives, and free up time for what really matters: people. We build everything from advanced safety sensors and cloud platforms to apps and data tools – all developed in-house by our 80+ product and tech specialists. What makes Sensio unique? - Impact with scale – our solutions improve everyday life for tens of thousands of residents and caregivers, and we’re just getting started. - A true growth journey – from Nordic frontrunner to European scale-up, we’re building the leading caretech platform of tomorrow. - Innovation at heart – our R&D teams shape the future of care technology with cutting-edge hardware, AI, and software. - People-first culture – we believe the best products come from teams that feel at home, have freedom to experiment, and share knowledge across borders. If you want to be part of a meaningful growth story – where tech meets one of society’s biggest challenges – join us. Let’s create more time for care.

jobs.description:

00SMART AS owns Norwegian Patent No. 348622, covering a mechanism for controlled automatic opening and closing of windows. We have a functioning solution already installed and operating on two real windows at TradLab, Norsk Folkemuseum in Oslo.

We are now looking for someone who enjoys opening doors, contacting potential customers and developing new business opportunities.


Your role will include:

  • Identifying potential customers and commercial partners

  • Contacting relevant decision-makers

  • Generating qualified leads and arranging meetings

  • Presenting the commercial opportunity together with our technical team

  • Exploring opportunities for sales, pilots, licensing and partnerships

  • Helping move interested prospects toward a commercial agreement

We are particularly interested in people with experience or contacts within:

  • Window and façade companies

  • Building technology and PropTech

  • Building automation and ventilation

  • Property developers and construction companies

  • Distributors and manufacturers


What we offer:

This is a freelance, commission-based collaboration. Compensation will be based on an agreed percentage of commercial business generated through your work. The detailed commission structure and terms will be agreed in writing before sales activities begin.

00SMART will provide product information, presentations, demonstrations and technical support.

This could be a good opportunity for someone who already has a strong B2B network and wants to help bring a patented Norwegian technology to the market.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

00SMART is a Norwegian smart-building technology startup developing a vendor-independent Digital Twin and Automated Fault Detection and Diagnostics (AFDD) platform. Buildings generate large amounts of operational data from HVAC systems, BMS, sensors, controllers and IoT devices, but this data is often fragmented across different suppliers and systems. As a result, technical faults can remain hidden, energy is wasted, and building operators spend significant time troubleshooting manually. 00SMART connects these different data sources, validates and structures the data, and makes it usable for automatic fault detection, dashboards, Digital Twin/3D visualisation and operational decision support. Our goal is to help building owners and facility managers detect problems earlier, reduce energy waste, improve indoor comfort and make building operations more efficient. We are currently strengthening and expanding an existing working platform and preparing for further verification in real buildings.

jobs.description:

Was Du mitbringst

Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, schlagkräftigen Teams, in dem jeder Verantwortung übernimmt und Ergebnisse erzielt:

jobs.description:

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. Engineering is at the heart of Rocket Lab.   • Lead the planning, scheduling, and execution of test, launch, and mission operations for Electron launch vehicles and related systems.

  • Mentor and train other operators, sharing your expertise and best practices.
  • Drive process improvements, automation, and standardization across Integrated Operations.
  • Prepare and present technical documentation, readiness reviews, and post-operation analyses.

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.

  • Proven leadership in test, launch, and mission operations.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and process improvement skills.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

 

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Master's degree or higher in a relevant engineering discipline.

  • Experience mentoring and training technical teams.
  • Previous experience in a fast-paced, safety-critical aerospace environment.

 

If the above sounds like you apply now!

 

WHAT TO EXPECT 

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. jobs.description:
Vår kommun präglas av den välkända Gnosjöandan. Här finns entreprenörskap, hjälpsamhet och klurighet, som visar på att allt är möjligt. Familjeföretagandet finns i vårt DNA och barnen får testa att driva eget redan i skolan.

På vår arbetsplats är kontaktvägarna korta, det finns en närhet som bara den lilla kommunen kan erbjuda. Vi erbjuder dig ett meningsfullt arbete på en spännande plats. Här finns möjlighet till utveckling och nya modiga idéer.

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Vill du vara med och göra skillnad i barn och ungdomars vardag? Nu söker vi en engagerad och trygg medarbetare till vår verksamhet inom Korttids Barn och Unga LSS.

Tjänsten blir ledig då en av våra uppskattade kollegor väljer att gå vidare med studier. Samtidigt står verksamheten inför en spännande utveckling då vi inom kort flyttar in i helt nyrenoverade och moderna lokaler, anpassade för att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för både barn, ungdomar och medarbetare.

Hos oss arbetar du med att ge barn och ungdomar med funktionsnedsättning en trygg, meningsfull och utvecklande vistelse. Du blir en del av ett engagerat arbetslag där barnens individuella behov, delaktighet och självständighet står i fokus.

Vi söker dig som:

Är engagerad och ansvarstagande.

Har ett gott bemötande och förmåga att skapa trygghet.

Trivs med att samarbeta och bygga goda relationer.

Har utbildning och/eller erfarenhet inom vård, omsorg eller pedagogiskt arbete.

Vi erbjuder:

Ett meningsfullt och varierande arbete.

Engagerade kollegor och ett gott arbetsklimat.

Möjlighet att vara med och utveckla verksamheten.

En arbetsplats i helt nyrenoverade, ändamålsenliga lokaler.

Välkommen med din ansökan och bli en del av vår fortsatta utvecklingsresa!

Intervjuer sker löpande!
