jobs.description:
Finance Specialist (m/w/d)

Wertschätzendes Betriebsklima

Flexible Arbeitszeiten

Langfristige Perspektive

Teamevents

Unser Kunde, eine führende internationale Management- und Operations-Beratung mit Fokus auf Transformation und nachhaltiger Leistungssteigerung in der produzierenden Industrie. Gemeinsam mit seinen Kunden realisiert er ganzheitliche Lösungen entlang der Wertschöpfungskette, von effizienten Prozessen über moderne Organisationsmodelle bis hin zur industriellen Digitalisierung. Dabei stehen messbare Ergebnisse, partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und langfristige Wirkung im Mittelpunkt. Für seine Umsetzungskompetenz und Innovationskraft wird er regelmäßig in der Branche ausgezeichnet.

Für dden Standort Puch bei Hallein suchen wir einen engagierten Mitarbeiter (all genders) im Bereich Accounting & Reporting, der/die eine zentrale Rolle in der Abwicklung und Weiterentwicklung der Accounting-Aktivitäten übernimmt und aktiv die Zukunft der Finanzprozesse mitgestaltet.

Deine Aufgaben:

- Laufende Buchhaltung & Zahlungsverkehr: Du bearbeitest Debitoren-, Kreditoren- und Anlagenbuchhaltung, führst den Zahlungsverkehr durch und übernimmst das Mahnwesen.
- Abschlüsse nach IFRS & UGB: Du unterstützt aktiv bei Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen und wirkst an Intercompany-Abstimmungen sowie Konzernverrechnungen mit.
- Abgaben & Meldungen: Du erstellst fristgerecht Abgabenmeldungen (UVA, ZM) und gewährleistest die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben.
- Systeme & Prozesse: Du pflegst und entwickelst unsere Buchhaltungsprozesse in Oracle NetSuite kontinuierlich weiter und bringst Impulse zur Optimierung ein.
- Zusammenarbeit & Schnittstellen: Du arbeitest eng mit Steuerberatern sowie internen Fachabteilungen zusammen und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Informationsfluss.

Das bringst Du mit:

- Ausbildung: Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder vergleichbar.
- Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Buchhaltung, idealerweise im Beratungs- oder Dienstleistungssektor.
- IT- und Software-Skills: Sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit Buchhaltungsprogrammen wie Oracle NetSuite und Yooz.
- Arbeitsweise: Strukturierte, verantwortungsbewusste und selbstständige Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Zahlenaffinität.
- Persönlichkeit: Freude an Teamarbeit, Hands-on-Mentalität und hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein.
- Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen:

- Weiterentwicklung: Neben einer steilen Lernkurve mit abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben und Projekten stehen dir umfangreiche und maßgeschneiderte Trainingsprogramme sowie persönliche Unterstützung durch Mentor:innen zur Verfügung. Zusätzlich hast du individuelle Karriereoptionen, auch über Abteilungs- und Ländergrenzen hinweg.
- Arbeitsmodelle: Du kannst deine Arbeitszeit bei uns flexibel gestalten und hast die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten. Zudem bieten wir unbefristete Arbeitsverträge an.
- Teamzusammenhalt: Bei uns erwartet dich eine offene und kollegiale Teamkultur auf Augenhöhe, mit regelmäßigen Angeboten wie gemeinsamen Mittagessen, Firmenevents und Teamentwicklungsveranstaltungen.
- Sport und Wellbeing: Du profitierst von attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten, z. B. JobRad, EGYM Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft und Corporate Benefits.

In dieser Rolle als Inside Sales Advisor / Sales Operations Advisor / Sales Support Advisor betreust du Kunden und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Verkaufsprozess. - Flexibilität: Du arbeitest gerne eng mit verschiedenen Menschen zusammen und kannst gute Arbeitsbeziehungen zu allen internen Interessengruppen aufbauen und pflegen.

jobs.title: Bartender Heltid
jobs.description:
Bartenders sökes – bli en del av vårt team på Södermalm! 🍸

Bartender sökes till Restaurang Den Gröne Jägaren i hjärtat av Södermalm.

Vi söker nu engagerade och serviceinriktade bartenders som vill vara med och skapa minnesvärda upplevelser för våra gäster – mitt i hjärtat av Södermalm.

Om tjänsten

Som bartender hos oss blir du en viktig del av en livlig, social och välkomnande miljö. Hos oss händer det alltid något – vi arrangerar bland annat populära karaokekvällar, quiz och visar fotbollsmatcher.

I rollen ansvarar du för att blanda och servera drycker samt ge förstklassig service, både i baren och ute vid borden. Du kommer att arbeta i både vår nedre och övre bar, där vi erbjuder både bords- och barservering. Vid behov kan arbete även förekomma på vår festvåning.

Som bartender är du en viktig del av gästens helhetsupplevelse. Du bidrar med energi, servicekänsla och ett professionellt bemötande och ser till att våra gäster känner sig välkomna och väl omhändertagna. En viktig del av rollen är också att alltid arbeta ansvarsfullt med alkoholserveringen och följa gällande regler och riktlinjer. Du ska kunna göra trygga och professionella bedömningar innan servering.

Arbetet innebär både dag-, kvälls- och helgpass. Under helgerna arbetar ni vanligtvis två personer i barerna, vilket innebär att ni tillsammans ansvarar för att hålla ett bra tempo och en hög servicenivå.

Det finns även goda möjligheter till extra timmar, då vi ofta har matchdagar på söndagar.

Arbetsuppgifter

    Servera öl, blanda drinkar, och andra drycker
    Servera mat och dryck vid borden
    Ge gäster ett professionellt och trevligt bemötande
    Ha ansvar för baren du jobbar i och hålla serveringsytor och baren rena, organiserade och välfyllda
    Hantera kassasystem och betalningar på korrektt vis

Vi söker dig som

    Har erfarenhet som bartender
    Har genomgått STAD-utbildning i ansvarsfull alkoholservering
    Har ett genuint intresse för service, mat och dryck
    Är social, stresstålig och har god samarbetsförmåga
    Är flexibel och kan arbeta kvällar och helger
    Talar svenska flytande

Vi erbjuder

    Ett roligt och varierande arbete i ett härligt team
    En arbetsplats i en av Stockholms mest levande stadsdelar
    Möjlighet att utvecklas inom service och bar

Ansökan

Låter detta som något för dig? Skicka in din ansökan med CV och en kort presentation om dig själv redan idag!

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Det finns möjlighet att provjobba redan till helgen.

Observera att ansökningar från personer utan erfarenhet tyvärr inte kommer att beaktas.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Berlin, Germany (office first) 

Team description

Our Platform Tribe builds Fleet, the infrastructure foundation that every engineering team at SumUp relies on to ship safely and quickly. Fleet gives teams a stable, self-service platform, built on AWS, Kubernetes and Terraform, so they can focus on their products instead of infrastructure bottlenecks. As part of the Cloud Infrastructure team, you'll take ownership of critical platform services, help modernise how we run Kubernetes at scale, and support engineers across the business as they build on top of what you maintain. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems that quietly power everything else, this is where that work happens.

What you'll do

  • Design and maintain Terraform modules and infrastructure patterns that other engineering teams build on

  • Manage production Kubernetes (EKS) clusters, including performance tuning and service mesh implementation

  • Lead security and compliance work across frameworks such as PCI DSS and SOC2, partnering with the Security team

  • Define and monitor service reliability metrics, take part in on-call rotation, and drive improvements after incidents

  • Improve developer experience through automation, better CI/CD pipelines, and clearer documentation

  • Mentor other engineers on the team and contribute to technical design discussions

You'll be great for this role if…

  • At least 8 years of experience in DevOps, platform, or infrastructure engineering

  • Proven hands-on experience in software development (Go preferred, but anyone would be good)

  • Experience designing and maintaining infrastructure as code, ideally with Terraform

  • Strong knowledge of Kubernetes in production, including cluster operations and troubleshooting

  • Hands-on experience with core AWS services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, and load balancing

  • Comfort working within security and compliance requirements without slowing teams down

  • Ability to mentor other engineers and explain technical decisions clearly to different audiences

Why you should join SumUp 🎉

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🩺 Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance, and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

une commerciale ou un commercial - (B2B)

Vos missions:

- Développer l’activité de vente B2B dans la région autour de Souvans
- Mettre sur pied d’une activité de vente directe aux particuliers ainsi qu’à des professionnels, collectivités ou industriels équipés de chaudières/chaufferies à granulés
- Créer un fichier clients d’installateurs de poêles et de chaudières
- Suivre et contrôler les indicateurs de performance
- Conduire autonome de l’intégralité du cycle de vente jusqu’à la signature du contrat/finalisation de la vente
- Fournir un soutien actif à la direction des ventes
- Assurer une veille permanente de l’évolution des marchés et de la concurrence

Votre profil:

- Expérience dans la vente et intérêt pour les granulés de chauffage
- Maîtrise avérée des techniques de vente et capacité à s’organiser
- Bonne aisance dans le relationnel client
- Mode de travail méthodique, précis, sérieux et autonome
- Bonnes capacités linguistiques en anglais tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit (niveau B1)

Nous vous proposons:

À propos de nous

La société EC Bioenergie GmbH & Co. KG a son siège à Heidelberg. Elle fait partie des pionniers et leaders sur le marché allemand des granulés de chauffage. Grâce à un maillage d’usines réparties sur l’ensemble du territoire allemand, notre société est en mesure de proposer un approvisionnement énergétique sûr et respectueux du climat en granulés pour des clients professionnels de toute taille en Allemagne, en Suisse et dans l’Est de la France. La construction d’un nouveau site de production en France est actuellement en voie d’achèvement.

Pour toute candidature, veuillez nous faire parvenir vos dates de disponibilité ainsi que vos prétentions salariales à l’adresse ci-dessou.

jobs.title: Senior IMS Specialist
jobs.description:
﻿IMS-specialist – stordatormiljö inom finanssektorn

Om uppdraget

Vår kund, en aktör inom finanssektorn, söker en erfaren IMS-specialist för drift, förvaltning och vidareutveckling av en affärskritisk stordatormiljö. Du blir en del av ett mindre specialistteam och ansvarar för den löpande leveransen av IMS-miljön i en komplex z/OS-miljö där stabilitet, säkerhet och tillgänglighet står i fokus.

Dina ansvarsområden

    Administrera, konfigurera och optimera IMS och tillhörande databaser
    Analysera transaktionsprestanda och felsöka incidenter
    Installera, underhålla och supportera IMS-systemprogramvara
    Samarbeta nära med specialister inom angränsande teknikområden som MQ, DB2 och WebSphere/Liberty
    Bidra till att säkra stabilitet, resiliens och tillgänglighet i leveransen

Krav

    Gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av administration, konfiguration och optimering av IMS-databaser
    Flerårig erfarenhet av arbete i z/OS-miljöer
    Erfarenhet av transaktionshantering och prestandaanalys
    Goda kunskaper i TSO/ISPF
    Erfarenhet från stora, komplexa och verksamhetskritiska miljöer med höga krav på stabilitet, resiliens och tillgänglighet
    Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på engelska

Meriterande

    Kunskaper i svenska
    Erfarenhet av backup och recovery i IMS
    Förståelse för hur IMS-transaktioner och databaser samverkar med applikationskod, till exempel COBOL
    Erfarenhet från bank eller andra starkt reglerade och säkerhetskritiska miljöer

Din profil

Du är analytisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad och sätter dig snabbt in i komplexa tekniska miljöer. Du arbetar pragmatiskt, är nyfiken och samarbetar väl med andra specialister.

jobs.title: B2B-säljare till Jobbplatsen
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och bygga försäljningen i ett växande nätverk av nischade jobbsajter?

Jobbplatsen i Sverige AB driver ett nätverk av specialiserade jobbsajter inom framför allt vård, omsorg och teknik. I nätverket ingår bland annat Vårdjobb.nu, Sjuksköterskajobb.nu, Läkarejobb.se, Undersköterskejobb.se, Ingenjörjobb.se och EngineeringJobs.se.

Plattformen, sajterna och våra erbjudanden finns redan på plats. Nu förstärker vi den kommersiella sidan och söker en självgående B2B-säljare som vill skapa nya affärer, bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer och vara med och utveckla nästa fas av bolaget.

Om rollen

Du arbetar främst med nykundsbearbetning mot arbetsgivare, bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt andra organisationer med aktuella eller återkommande rekryteringsbehov.

Du driver dina affärer från första kontakt till avslut och fortsatt kundrelation.

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

• identifiera företag och organisationer med rekryteringsbehov

• kontakta beslutsfattare via telefon, mejl och andra relevanta kanaler

• presentera våra nischade jobbsajter och annonseringslösningar

• sälja jobbannonser, premiumexponering och större återkommande samarbeten

• följa upp leads och pågående kunddialoger

• utveckla långsiktiga kundrelationer

• bidra med idéer kring hur vår försäljning och våra erbjudanden kan utvecklas

Du kommer in i en verksamhet där den tekniska plattformen och produkterna redan är byggda. Ditt fokus är att skapa affärer och utveckla kundrelationer – inte att börja från noll.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är affärsmässig, kommunikativ och självgående.

Du behöver inte vara den mest högljudda personen i rummet. För oss är det viktigare att du kan skapa förtroende, förstå kundens behov, ta egna initiativ och konsekvent driva dina affärer framåt.

Tidigare erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning och nykundsbearbetning är meriterande. Erfarenhet från rekrytering, bemanning, HR, media, digital annonsering eller liknande är också värdefull.

Vi tror att du:

• tycker om att skapa nya kundkontakter

• är bekväm med att prata med beslutsfattare

• är uthållig och följer upp tills du får ett tydligt besked

• kan arbeta självständigt mot konkreta mål

• är lyhörd och affärsmässig i kunddialogen

• motiveras av att dina egna resultat påverkar din ersättning

• vill vara med och utveckla något, inte bara förvalta en färdig kundportfölj

Ersättning och anställning

Ersättningen är helt provisionsbaserad och utan fast lön. Provision utgår på den försäljning du själv genererar.

Vi vill att modellen ska vara enkel och transparent. Du ska veta hur provisionen beräknas, vad varje affär är värd för dig och när ersättningen betalas ut. Fullständiga provisionsnivåer och villkor går vi igenom innan start.

Anställningen är inledningsvis tidsbegränsad i 3–6 månader. För rätt person finns möjlighet till fortsatt samarbete och utökat ansvar i takt med resultat och verksamhetens utveckling.

Rollen är på deltid och arbetet kan utföras på distans.

Möjlighet att växa med bolaget

Det här är inte en roll i en stor färdig säljorganisation där du blir en person i mängden.

Du kommer in i ett skede där infrastrukturen redan finns men där den kommersiella organisationen ska utvecklas betydligt.

För rätt person finns därför möjlighet att påverka hur försäljningen byggs upp, arbeta nära företagets grundare och få ett större ansvar i takt med egna resultat.

Vårt största fokus ligger just nu på vård och omsorg, där vi driver flera nischade jobbsajter och ser stor potential att utveckla fler långsiktiga kundsamarbeten.

Så arbetar vi

Vi tror på tydliga mål, stort eget ansvar och korta beslutsvägar.

Du får frihet att hitta ditt eget sätt att skapa affärer, samtidigt som vi förväntar oss aktivitet, struktur, uppföljning och resultat.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att vara med och påverka – och se en tydlig koppling mellan det du själv skapar och hur både rollen och bolaget utvecklas.

Ansökan

Skicka gärna en kort presentation där du berättar:

• vilken erfarenhet du har av försäljning

• hur du brukar skapa nya kunder

• vilken affär du själv är mest stolt över att ha vunnit

• varför du tror att den här rollen passar dig

Vi tittar mer på vad du kan skapa och vilka resultat du kan åstadkomma än på hur ditt CV är formulerat.

Urval och samtal sker löpande.

jobs.title: Servicetechniker Elektrotechnik im Außendienst, Salzburg/Linz (m/w/d) (Techniker/in - Kraftfahrzeugtechnik/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
jobs.description:
Was Dich erwartet

Als Außendiensttechnikerin in unserem Außendienstteam für Energie und Ladung spielst Du eine wichtige Rolle dabei, sicherzustellen, dass sowohl unsere Energiespeicherprodukte als auch unsere Supercharger optimal funktionieren. Unsere Energiespeicherprodukte sind von entscheidender Bedeutung, um die Schwankungen der erneuerbaren Energiequellen wie Wind und Sonne auszugleichen und den Übergang zu einem umweltfreundlicheren Stromnetz zu beschleunigen. Unser Supercharging-Netz ist das größte globale Schnellladenetz der Welt und ermöglicht es unseren Kundinnen, lange Strecken bequem zurückzulegen. Zu Deinen täglichen Aufgaben gehören die Durchführung von vorbeugenden Wartungen, Upgrades, Fehlersuche und Reparaturen sowie Inbetriebnahmen an verschiedenen Standorten in Österreich. Bist Du Techniker*in mit Erfahrungen im Bereich Elektrizität und Energie? Möchtest Du Teil eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens sein und mit den neuesten Technologien arbeiten? Dann sucht Tesla genau Dich!

Was zu tun ist

- Durchführung aller technischen Tätigkeiten: vor Ort im Zusammenhang mit der Installation, Inbetriebnahme, Reparatur und Wartung unseres Energiespeicher- und Supercharging-Netzes in Österreich und bei Bedarf im Ausland
- Fehlerbehebung und Ursachenanalyse: sowohl extern als auch vor Ort
- Stakeholder management: Erster Ansprechpartnerin für die Auftragnehmer*innen
- Team Work: Analyse wiederkehrender Probleme und Feedback an die Entwicklerteams
- Organisatorische Aufgaben: Vorbereitung, Organisation und Planung Deiner eigenen technischen Aktivitäten
- Perform all on-site technical activities related to the installation, commissioning, repair, maintenance of our Energy storage and Supercharging network in Austria and abroad when needed
- Troubleshoot and perform root-cause analysis, both remotely and on-site
- Stakeholder management and acting as the first point of contact to contractors
- Team work, preventing recurring issues with other team colleagues and provide feedback to the engineering teams
- Organizational tasks, including preparation, organization, and plannning of your own technical activities

Was mitzubringen ist

- Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Erfahrung im Außendienst von Vorteil
- Erfahrung mit elektrischen Nieder- und Mittelspannungsanlagen, Kenntnisse mit Hochspannung von Vorteil
- Begeisterung für erneuerbare Energien
- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, selbständig, motiviert und proaktiv zu arbeiten
- Reisebereitschaft
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse
- Gültiger Führerschein (B)
- Für diese Stelle ist ein EU-Pass oder eine Arbeitserlaubnis erforderlich
- Experience as a technician in the electrical engineering field
- Experience with Low- and Medium Voltage electrical systems, High Voltage is a plus
- A passion for renewable energy
- Excellent communication skills and ability to work independently, motivated and a proactive attitude
- Flexible towards travelling
- Fluency in German and a good command of English
- An EU passport or work permit is needed for this position

Tesla ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit verwirklicht, und der sich der Diversität am Arbeitsplatz verpflichtet hat. Alle qualifizierten Bewerber für eine Stelle haben die gleiche Chance unabhängig von Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, geschlechtlicher Orientierung, Alter, Herkunftsland, Behinderung, Veteranenschutzstatus, geschlechtlicher Identität oder anderen Faktoren, die durch die geltenden US-, bundesstaatlichen oder örtlichen Gesetze geschützt sind.

Tesla engagiert sich übrigens dafür, Chancengleichheit für Menschen mit Behinderungen zu verwirklichen und ihnen dafür angemessene Vorkehrungen zu bieten. Bitte teilen Sie Ihrem Personalverantwortlichen mit, wenn Sie zu irgendeinem Zeitpunkt während des Vorstellungsgesprächs eine spezielle Unterstützung benötigen.

Datenschutz hat für Tesla höchste Priorität. Wir integrieren ihn in unsere Produkte und betrachten ihn als wesentlichen Bestandteil unseres Geschäfts. Um mehr über die Daten zu erfahren, die wir im Rahmen Ihrer Bewerbung erfassen und verarbeiten, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzhinweise für Tesla-Bewerber.

jobs.title: (Senior) Spezialist*in Beteiligungsmanagement (Finanzassistent/in)
jobs.employer: Commerz Real AG Commerz Real Düsseldorf
jobs.description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Spezialist*in Beteiligungsmanagement

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real AG ist der Asset Manager der Commerzbank Gruppe und verfügt über 50 Jahre internationale Markterfahrung. Das Unternehmen vereint umfassendes Know-how im Asset Management mit breiter Strukturierungsexpertise und entwickelt daraus sachwertorientierte Fondsprodukte sowie maßgeschneiderte Investmentlösungen in den Bereichen Immobilien und Infrastruktur. Als Leasingdienstleister des Commerzbank-Konzerns bietet die Commerz Leasing zudem bedarfsgerechte Leasingkonzepte. Seit 2025 sind die Asset-Management-Beteiligungen der Commerzbank Gruppe bei der Commerz Real AG gebündelt. Neben den Marken und Produkten der Commerz Real zählen dazu die Aquila Capital Investmentgesellschaft mit Fokus auf nachhaltige Sachwertinvestments im Bereich Energieinfrastruktur sowie Yellowfin Asset Management als Boutique für liquide Investmentstrategien. Unter dem Dach der Commerz Real AG verwalten insgesamt rund 1.000 Mitarbeitende an rund 20 Standorten Vermögenswerte von rund 55 Milliarden Euro.

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Du begleitest das Team bei der Strukturierung und dem Erwerb von Immobilien, nachhaltigen Infrastrukturprojekten sowie Equity oder Private Debt Investmentprodukten
- Du erstellst Reportings von Fonds und SPVs nach LUX GAAP oder IFRS
- Als Ansprechpartner übernimmst du die Koordination und Steuerung von externen und internen Dienstleistern (z.B. Wirtschaftsprüfer, Rechts- und Steuerberater, Zentralverwalter, Buchhalter)
- Du überprüfst Steuererklärungen und Steueranmeldungen
- Du verantwortest das Liquiditätsmanagement in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Finanzdienstleistungsteam
- Du arbeitest bei der laufenden Verbesserung der Qualität und Effizienz im Bereich Finance mit und Du bist aktiv eingebunden in unsere Projekte betreffend Technologie und Prozessoptimierung

Profil:

- Du verfügst über mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Accounting (je nach Erfahrung und Kenntnissen erfolgt die Eingruppierung auf eine Junior- oder Senior- Position)

jobs.title: Head of Security
jobs.description:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location:

Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

About the role:

As Head of Security, you'll define and drive Morpho's security strategy across the entire organization - corporate IT, cloud and infrastructure, application, supply chain, identity, incident response, threat intelligence, and counterparty security - and you'll build the team and function to deliver it. This is a hands-on leadership role: in the early days you'll personally do the work while you hire, and you'll stay close enough to the technical detail to earn the trust of a deeply technical organization. You'll also be Morpho's credible security voice, internally to leadership, and externally to the integrators, institutions, and ecosystem partners who depend on us. You'll partner closely with Engineering on infrastructure and deployment integrity, and with our Integration team, which works with various partners across the Morpho ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and continuously evolve Morpho's security strategy and roadmap across, cloud/infrastructure, application, supply-chain, identity, and operational security.

  • Build and lead the security function - hire, grow, and develop the team, recruiting skillsets across security operations and application security.

  • Oversight of the IT function

  • Stay hands-on. Personally execute critical security work - threat modeling, architecture review, control implementation, and incident command - while the team scales.

  • Set the governance architecture: a coherent security framework that ties tooling and controls together, rather than accumulating tools in isolation.

  • Own incident response end to end - runbooks, incident command, severity and escalation structure, and market communication during an event.

  • Build and run a counterparty security program for curators and partners - identity verification, screening, operational diligence, and bidirectional incident-coordination channels.

  • Lead Morpho's certification strategy (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001), meeting both the spirit and the letter sustainably.

  • Represent Morpho's security posture externally - to fintechs, financial institutions, and the broader ecosystem - and internally to executives.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Protocol, and Integrations, driving security outcomes through both direct ownership and influence.

What Success Looks Like:

First 30 Days

  • You've built a clear, independent picture of Morpho's posture, architecture, threat model, and in-flight work - and pressure-tested the existing strategy against it.

  • You've met the team and established working relationships with the people who own the surfaces you'll most depend on.

  • You understand the path-to-funds attack surface in depth and have an early, evidence-based view of the highest-severity risks and quick wins.

  • You know exactly where incident-response readiness stands today.

First 60 Days

  • You've published a clearly prioritized security roadmap with clear sequencing, owners, and the rationale for what's deferred and aligned leadership behind it.

  • You've defined the team build-out plan and opened the first hire.

  • You're personally driving the top-severity gaps - identity and authentication enforcement, deployment guardrails, and a documented incident-response runbook among them.

  • You've set the governance framework and the certification path in motion.

First 90 Days

  • Demonstrable progress closing the highest-priority gaps, with key controls enforced rather than optional.

  • A documented incident-response capability that's been validated by at least one tabletop exercise.

  • Hiring underway, and a clear operating rhythm established with Engineering, Protocol, and Integrations.

  • Morpho's external security posture is taking shape - trust surface, counterparty security program, and ecosystem engagement - and you're recognized internally and externally as Morpho's credible security voice.

Must-have Experience & Skills:

  • 10+ years in security, several of them building or leading a security function, ideally at a crypto/web3, fintech, or financial-services company where security is core to the business.

  • Strong grasp of the crypto/web3 threat model

  • Proven experience building and growing a security team from a small base, recruiting across security operations and application/infrastructure security.

  • Deep, hands-on technical expertise across cloud, infrastructure, CI/CD, supply-chain, identity, and application security - you do the work, not just direct it.

  • Owned incident response end to end, including incident command and external communication.

  • Sharp prioritization and the ability to galvanize action through hard and soft influence, including driving outcomes through teams you don't own.

  • Exceptional, organized, responsive communication - credible to executives and to external audiences from fintechs to Fortune 500 institutions.

  • Humble.

Nice to Have:

  • An established network and public profile in the security or crypto-security community, and comfort representing security work publicly (talks, writing, framework contribution).

  • Offensive security depth, or experience standing up red/blue capabilities.

  • Familiarity with institutional and regulatory expectations and threat-sharing networks (e.g. Crypto ISAC, TIBER-style frameworks).

  • Taken an organization through certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent)

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

jobs.title: Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
About Atira

Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.

We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!

Why engineers are the foundation of everything Atira ships

As an Engineering Intern at Atira, you will work on frontier AI technology, such as (recursive) agent harnesses, runtimes, evals, inference and self-verification in complex engineering domains. You build the frameworks, primitives and scaffolding that let agents reliably handle complex industrial processes end to end, from the first inbound RFQ to the write-back into ERP.

Misreading or wrongly interpreting a spec can cost a manufacturer six figures, so the challenges are real and the margin for error is thin.

Where you trained matters less than what you've built and how clearly you can describe what broke. Atira is at a stage where you must own problems end to end, because what you ship today is what our customers use tomorrow.

What you will do

  • Work on the agent runtime and harnesses. You improve the core components that let Atira's agents reason in complex engineering environments across the entire sales-engineering lifecycle, orchestrate themselves recursively at scale through dynamic programs, and handle arbitrarily large amounts of data. This includes the runtime/sandboxing, the harness, and the outer orchestration layer that ties it together

  • Build out our AI moat. You are in charge of improving quality & evals, improving the ontology layer that unlocks compounding process knowledge and fusing deterministic guardrails with agentic agency to make our agents actionable at enterprise level complexity

  • Unlock industrial scale. Industrials live in multi-modal, data-heavy environments: 1000-page inbounds, pricing lists, CAD files, ERP tables, legacy applications. You scale the AI systems behind them to millions of concurrent LLM requests in isolated sandboxes, with no silent failures, cost blowouts or latency explosions.

  • Advance our internal tooling. FDEs, platform engineers and the GTM team depend on tooling you build to improve Atira's internal context layer, ambient agents, insight and observability engines

  • Work with FDEs when customer problems hit the platform. When an FDE hits a problem they should be able to pull you in. At a team of 20, the boundary between AI, platform and customer is thin, and you'll cross it regularly

What we are looking for

Ownership, depth, and the instinct to take problems personally, go deep until you understand the system, and own the outcome including the parts that broke.

Your profile

  • Agent fluency sits on top of real engineering fundamentals. Solid skills in Python, TypeScript, or a comparable language. We value someone that can still code without AI. Ideally paired with hands-on experience with agents, evals, harnesses, runtimes, sandboxing and tools

  • You've gone further than most with AI-assisted development. Whether it's Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or your own setup, you've invested seriously in building the skills, context, and workflows to get maximum leverage from coding agents. This isn't a nice-to-have. We think engineers who have mastered this are fundamentally more productive, and we hire accordingly

  • You reason clearly about technical tradeoffs. You don’t need to have run systems at scale yet, but you can think through how a design would hold up at thousands of requests per second and explain the pros and cons of different approaches. Every design has tradeoffs: no free lunch

  • You’ve demonstrated ownership and initiative. A side project you took further than anyone asked, a serious open-source contribution, a research project or a startup. We want evidence that you build without being told to and can explain what broke and why

  • You have a strong technical foundation. Enrolled or recently graduated in Computer Science, Information Systems, AI, or a related technical field from a strong technical university (cracked dropouts can qualify too though)

  • Full working proficiency in English. German is not required

  • You're ready for a real internship, not a side gig. You can commit to at least three months full-time, on-site in Munich

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: you'll be one of the early team members and shape both product and architecture as well as work closely with customers

  • Strong peers and mentorship: work with and learn from engineers who have shipped AI systems in industrial environments at scale, with the opportunity for mentorship along the way

  • Impactful work: your code is deployed all across Europe’s and US industrial backbone, affecting how complex products and services are sold and configured worldwide

  • Competitive salary and additional benefits

  • Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity

What success looks like at the end of the internship

  • You've shipped meaningful improvements to the agent runtime, our AI pipelines and related systems that are running in production across multiple customer deployments

  • You own one well-defined piece of our AI stack end to end (an eval suite, an internal tool, part of the context layer or the SDK), and the team trusts your judgment on how it should evolve

  • When something breaks in the part you own, you can trace it end to end, from agent behaviour back to the agent infrastructure layer, and fix it

  • You’ve made an improvement to our internal AI tooling that the team now uses day to day

  • The design decisions in your piece have held up under real load, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made and what you’d do differently

  • If these metrics are met, we'd take you full-time without thinking twice

  • A true partner in automation: you'll work hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated — this isn't a role where you're expected to grind through manual work alone.

  • International scope from day one: France, the US, and future markets — you'll help build the multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as Joko expands.

 

🎯 What you will do

As Finance Manager, Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting), your main mission is to own the reliability, timeliness, and completeness of Joko's financial information. Rather than doing the bookkeeping — we have an external accounting partner for that — you set the standards, drive the calendar, and hold your internal and external stakeholders accountable.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Drive the closing calendar: own the monthly and annual closing calendar, holding our external accounting partner and auditors to a high standard;

  • Own our legal reporting package: make sure the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement are always accurate and delivered on time;

  • Oversee AP/AR end to end: keep invoicing, payment runs, and collections under control;

  • Lead our international accounting build-out: as we open new entities and markets, including our IFRS consolidation framework;

  • Own cash management: reconciliation, yield optimization, and day-to-day treasury;

  • Be the main point of contact for our banking and accounting partners, and a key interface for auditors as we scale toward IPO readiness;

  • Continuously strengthen and document our financial processes and controls, working hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated, making everything more robust and less error-prone as the company scales.

 

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: 4–8 years, with a strong foundation in accounting or audit (Big 4 or equivalent), ideally combined with in-house experience in a scale-up.

  • Education: A master's degree from a top business school. A double degree in accounting (DCG/DSCG) is a plus.

  • Financial rigor: Deep understanding of French GAAP and treasury fundamentals — you bring the same discipline to a closing cycle as you do to a cash position.

  • International mindset: Excited to build a multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as we expand; IFRS exposure is a plus.

  • Stakeholder management: You build trust with partners inside and outside Joko, and you're comfortable holding them accountable.

  • Problem solving: You dig into the root cause and fix things.

  • AI centricity: You use AI in your daily work today, and you're excited to help automate reporting and reconciliation as part of Joko's AI-first finance ambition.

  • Languages: Fluent French and English.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

jobs.title: Internship Talent Acquisition
jobs.description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You’ll join our Talent team and help build the team that builds a bank. We’re scaling fast across Berlin, New York and Dallas, and every hire either raises or lowers the bar. You’ll own real parts of our hiring engine from day one. Like everyone at Augustus, you’ll run day-to-day work in parallel with one or two larger projects.

  • What you’ll work on:

    • Source and engage candidates across engineering, product, operations, compliance and sales.

    • Coordinate interview processes and keep hiring managers and candidates moving.

    • Build and automate our recruiting workflows with Ashby, n8n and AI, so we hire better without adding headcount.

    • Own a larger project, like a new sourcing channel, our employer brand, or hiring analytics.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You are low ego and ready to jump in where you are needed most.

  • You are relentless about finding great people. You’d rather send 50 personalized messages than post and pray.

  • You know every candidate interaction reflects on Augustus, and you treat it that way.

  • You build your personal AI stack that optimizes your productivity and you treat new AI tools as defaults, not curiosities.

  • You can build workflows in n8n/zapier/make.

  • You are comfortable talking to senior leaders, hiring managers, and candidates from day one.

  • You are genuinely excited about what we are building.

This is not for you if:

  • You only want to work on strategic projects.

  • You see recruiting as admin work.

  • You need to know exactly what you will be working on before you join.

  • You are looking for a 9-5 role.

Hard Requirements

  • You are currently pursuing or have obtained a Bachelor's or Master's degree from a stellar institution.

  • You have 1-2 previous internships or roles in high-growth startups, venture capital, or consulting and/or you have demonstrated initiative through side projects, student organizations, research, or entrepreneurial experiences.

  • You are available for 3-6 months.

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Commercial Sales
jobs.description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

Zip is looking for a Senior Director of EMEA Commercial Sales to lead and scale our Commercial business across Europe.

This is a second-line leadership role. You will initially lead two frontline Commercial Sales Managers and, through them, a growing team of Account Executives. As Zip expands across Europe, you will build the leadership structure, sales capacity, and go-to-market approach required to capture that opportunity.

Your leverage comes through your managers, but this is not a role for someone who operates from a distance. You will stay close to the business: understanding the pipeline, inspecting deals, helping your managers improve their teams, and personally getting involved in the opportunities where your experience can change the outcome.

You will own the performance of EMEA Commercial end to end: the number, pipeline, forecast, talent, geographic expansion, and operating rhythm of the segment.

Commercial is already an important part of Zip's EMEA business. The opportunity now is to turn it into a scaled, predictable growth engine across the region.

You Will

  • Own EMEA Commercial performance. Deliver quarterly and annual new-business revenue targets through the frontline managers and Account Executives who report into your organization.

  • Build and develop exceptional frontline managers. Coach your leaders on pipeline management, forecasting, deal inspection, rep development, and performance management. Hold them accountable for running their businesses with the same rigor you bring to yours.

  • Scale Commercial across Europe. Determine where and when to add coverage as Zip expands into new countries and markets, and build the teams and leadership required to win locally without creating unnecessary complexity.

  • Own pipeline well before the quarter begins. Establish coverage requirements, identify future gaps early, and work across Business Development, Marketing, Partnerships, and the AE organization to address them before they become revenue problems.

  • Drive rigorous forecasting. Build a business that is predictable. Know what is real, what is at risk, what has changed, and why, and ensure your managers operate with the same level of precision.

  • Stay close to the deals. Ensure your managers are inspecting opportunities rigorously, and personally engage in important customer conversations where executive involvement can improve discovery, create urgency, strengthen sponsorship, or move a deal forward.

  • Build a high-performance organization. Recruit outstanding managers and sellers, raise the talent bar as we grow, develop top performers, and address underperformance quickly and directly.

  • Improve the Commercial sales motion. Diagnose where performance is constrained by pipeline, execution, territory design, productivity, process, or capability and make the changes required to improve it.

  • Operate cross-functionally. Build strong partnerships with Business Development, Solution Consulting, Advisory, Marketing, Partnerships, GTM Operations, Customer, and Zip's Executive team.

  • Represent the Commercial business internally. Provide clear, credible reporting on performance, pipeline, forecast, market dynamics, competitive trends, and the investments required to continue scaling.

  • Build for where Zip is going, not where it is today. Create the leadership bench, operating model, and market coverage that will support a significantly larger EMEA Commercial organization over the next several years.

To Excel in This Role

  • You have successfully led frontline sales managers, not only individual sellers.

  • You know that your job as an L2 is not to run every deal yourself. You make your managers better at running their teams while knowing when your involvement can materially improve an outcome.

  • You are rigorous about pipeline creation and pipeline quality. You think several quarters ahead rather than discovering a pipeline problem once the quarter has begun.

  • You run a predictable business and have a strong track record of forecast accuracy and operational discipline.

  • You are comfortable getting into the details. You can move from a regional strategy discussion to inspecting a deal, a territory, a rep's pipeline, or a manager's operating cadence without losing altitude.

  • You have built or expanded sales teams across multiple European markets and understand that what works in the UK does not automatically translate into Germany, France, Benelux, Nordics, or Southern Europe.

  • You have a track record of hiring and developing strong sales leaders and creating a bench of future leadership talent.

  • You are equally comfortable with high expectations and hands-on coaching. You give clear, actionable feedback and address problems early.

  • You operate well in a fast-growth environment where the organization, product, market, and playbook are all evolving quickly.

  • You have a strong executive presence and can build credibility with senior customer stakeholders while keeping the Account Executive and frontline manager at the center of the relationship.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of B2B technology sales experience, including meaningful sales leadership experience.

  • 2+ years managing frontline sales managers or equivalent second-line leadership responsibility.

  • Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding revenue targets through teams.

  • Demonstrated experience scaling sales organizations across territories, countries, or customer segments.

  • Strong experience with pipeline management, forecasting, sales process, territory design, productivity metrics, and performance management.

  • Experience hiring and developing both sales managers and Account Executives.

  • Experience operating in a high-growth SaaS or enterprise technology company.

  • Experience selling through value-based, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Based in the UK and able to work from Zip's central London office three days per week.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience building sales teams outside the UK and entering new European markets.

  • Experience leading a high-velocity Commercial or mid-market SaaS organization.

  • Experience selling to Procurement, Finance, IT, Legal, or other cross-functional enterprise buyers.

  • Experience at a company scaling from an early EMEA presence into a substantial pan-European business.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Full health, vision & dental coverage

  • 🚍 Commuter benefit

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget

  • Employer pension contribution

 

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

Receptionist

Company Description

Our heart beats turquoise.

Working at Motel One is like coming home to friends, where you can be your true self and where appreciation and support matter. We meet on an equal footing and see ourselves as one team: from our management to our trainees.

We create a home away from home for our guests with our shared passion for modern design and high-quality service. Our more than 100 hotels in 14 countries impress with exclusive design, high service standards and first-class inner-city locations at an attractive price.

As the founder and pioneer of the budget design concept, we are successfully expanding in the metropolises of Europe and beyond. Become part of our team and develop Motel One with us.

As a Receptionist, you are the first and last impression of our hotel, placing the guest at the centre of everything you do. From managing check-ins and check-outs to responding to guest enquiries and resolving requests with care and efficiency, you will provide exceptional service while working collaboratively with your colleagues to exceed guest expectations. You will take pride in creating a welcoming atmosphere, anticipating guests' needs and ensuring every stay reflects the high standards and hospitality of Motel One.

Qualifications

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to multitask while maintaining high standards of service.
- Must be eligible to work in Ireland and currently resident in Ireland.

jobs.title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
jobs.description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:

- Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
- A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action
- President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers
- Flexible work: Do great work from anywhere but also visit local office to deliver excellence in team relationship
- Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities
- Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future
- You can find all current benefits here: https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits (https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits)

Have we piqued your interest?

Then apply with your CV and a few clicks via our online form! No cover letter is necessary.

Do you have any questions? Then feel free to send us an email at malte.ruetten@softwareone.com.

jobs.title: Barnvakt sökes till familj i Mälarhöjden / Hägersten
jobs.description:
Happy Nanny söker en varm, trygg och lekfull barnvakt till en familj i Mälarhöjden med två döttrar, 2,5 och 4,5 år. Familjen planerar att gifta sig sommaren 2028, och söker därför någon som de kan lära känna i god tid inför bröllopet.

Flickorna tycker om att leka tillsammans och gillar bland annat dockor, målning, pyssel, pussel och lekplatser. De söker en närvarande vuxen som gärna deltar i leken och hittar på roliga aktiviteter.

Vi söker dig som är lyhörd, omtänksam och har ett mjukt bemötande av barn. Familjen önskar att du bor i närheten av Mälarhöjden och vill bygga upp en trygg och långsiktig relation med både barnen och föräldrarna genom regelbundna träffar inför bröllopet. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av barn i åldrarna 2–5 år, exempelvis genom arbete på förskola eller tidigare uppdrag som barnvakt.

Känner du igen dig i beskrivningen? Välkommen med din intresseanmälan och skriv "Familj Mälarhöjden" i ämnesraden!

jobs.title: AI Adoption Specialist
jobs.description:
AI Adoption Specialist – utbildning och coachning för utvecklingsteam

Om uppdraget

Vår kund, ett större företag, vill öka den praktiska användningen av AI i sina utvecklingsteam och söker en AI Adoption Specialist som kan leda arbetet genom utbildning, workshops och nära coachning. Tyngdpunkten ligger på att hjälpa teamen att använda AI i vardagen, inte på projektledning eller AI-arkitektur.

Dina ansvarsområden

    Självständigt planera och hålla flera praktiska workshops i veckan, med innehåll som utgår från teamens behov och dagliga arbetsuppgifter
    Utbilda inom generativ AI, GitHub Copilot, prompting, AI-agenter samt AI-stöd för utveckling och test
    Coacha utvecklingsteamen så att kunskap blir till konkreta, fungerande arbetssätt
    Kartlägga behov, hinder och möjligheter i teamen
    Ta fram och sprida utbildningsmaterial och övningar
    Dokumentera och föra över material, övningar och arbetssätt till interna AI-ambassadörer och utbildare

Teknikmiljö

GitHub Copilot, VS Code, Visual Studio, React, MUI, .NET 10, Java och SQL Server

Krav

    Praktisk kompetens inom generativ AI och AI-stöd i mjukvaruutveckling
    Praktisk erfarenhet av GitHub Copilot, inklusive prompting, kontext, instruktioner och AI-assisterade utvecklingsflöden
    Förmåga att självständigt planera och leda praktiska utbildningar och handledda workshops för utvecklingsteam
    Förmåga att anpassa upplägg och övningar efter olika roller, kunskapsnivåer och arbetsuppgifter
    Erfarenhet av att omsätta teamens behov i konkreta utbildnings- och coachningsinsatser
    God förståelse för AI-verktygens begränsningar, säker användning och betydelsen av mänsklig granskning

Meriterande

    Erfarenhet från reglerad verksamhet, till exempel bank eller försäkring
    Praktisk kompetens inom AI-agenter och automatiserade arbetsflöden
    Kunskap om AI-stöd för testdesign, testautomatisering och kvalitetssäkring
    Erfarenhet från stora organisationer med flera utvecklingsteam och SAFe-tåg
    Erfarenhet av interna AI-ambassadörsnätverk eller liknande former av kunskapsspridning

Din profil

Du är pedagogisk och kommunikativ och kan förklara tekniska ämnen på ett tydligt och lättförståeligt sätt. Du lyssnar in olika behov och anpassar ditt arbetssätt efter målgruppen. Du är initiativrik och självgående med stark drivkraft att få saker gjorda: du söker själv upp teamen och driver utbildningsinsatserna från identifierat behov till genomförande och uppföljning. Du skapar engagemang och kan med träffande exempel visa både vad AI kan göra och var gränserna går. Du arbetar strukturerat och ser till att kunskap och material kan tas vidare av andra.

Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager*in

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real AG ist der Asset Manager der Commerzbank Gruppe und verfügt über 50 Jahre internationale Markterfahrung. Das Unternehmen vereint umfassendes Know-how im Asset Management mit breiter Strukturierungsexpertise und entwickelt daraus sachwertorientierte Fondsprodukte sowie maßgeschneiderte Investmentlösungen in den Bereichen Immobilien und Infrastruktur. Als Leasingdienstleister des Commerzbank-Konzerns bietet die Commerz Leasing zudem bedarfsgerechte Leasingkonzepte. Seit 2025 sind die Asset-Management-Beteiligungen der Commerzbank Gruppe bei der Commerz Real AG gebündelt. Neben den Marken und Produkten der Commerz Real zählen dazu die Aquila Capital Investmentgesellschaft mit Fokus auf nachhaltige Sachwertinvestments im Bereich Energieinfrastruktur sowie Yellowfin Asset Management als Boutique für liquide Investmentstrategien. Unter dem Dach der Commerz Real AG verwalten insgesamt rund 1.000 Mitarbeitende an rund 20 Standorten Vermögenswerte von rund 55 Milliarden Euro.

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
