jobs.title: Electrical Harness & Hardware Design Engineer - 20064/20092
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Role Summary

An experienced Electrical Harness & Hardware Design Engineer is needed to support the development of electrical systems in a complex automotive engineering environment. The assignment focuses on electrical system design, covering both schematic and 3D design, as well as the development and integration of electrical harnesses and associated hardware.

Key Responsibilities

    Develop electrical system designs, including schematics and 3D electrical design deliverables.
    Design, develop and integrate electrical harnesses and related hardware components.
    Ensure electrical solutions are robust, manufacturable and aligned with overall product requirements.
    Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders in Mechanical Design, Production, Purchasing and other technical functions.
    Manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced engineering environment.
    Support different technical areas as needed throughout the development process.

Technical Stack & Requirements

    Hands-on experience with CATIA V5 for electrical design.
    Experience using Saber ESD.
    Experience working with OAS.
    Experience with Siemens Capital is advantageous.
    Knowledge of FRAS is considered meritorious.
    Knowledge of electrical harness and hardware design within an automotive engineering context.

Qualifications & Experience

The ideal candidate holds a B.Sc. and/or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline and has at least 2–3 years of relevant professional experience. Previous experience from a similar automotive engineering environment is required. The role requires an engineer who can take ownership of deliverables, work independently as well as collaboratively, and adapt to changing priorities.

jobs.title: Haetaan osa-aikaista talvikauden kiinteistöihmettä Sodankylään!
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko aidosti mahtavaan työporukkaan töihin Sodankylään - tuletko meidän kiinteistöihmeeksi? Peerâ Hotels & Cottages operoi neljää kohdetta Lapissa, joista kaksi Sodankylässä, Hotel Sodankylä & Hotel Karhu, Sodankylästä 50km pohjoiseen Peurasuvanto Mökit & Camping, sekä Pyhätunturilla KeloVilla Tietotunturi.

Kiinteistöhoitajan rooli on meillä erittäin tärkeä asiakastyytyväisyyden ylläpitämisessä ja parantamisessa, ja etsimämme talvikauden vahvistus toimii tiiviissä yhteistyössä nykyisen kokoaikaisen Sodankylän kiinteistöihmeemme Tonin, sekä koko Sodankylän hotellitiimin kanssa arjen askareissa. Käytännössä korjaat hotellissa ilmeneviä erilaisia vikoja, teet ennakoivia huoltotoimenpiteitä ja pääset välillä toteuttamaan joitain parannusprojektejakin. Et missään nimessä ole piilossa työkalupakin takana, vaan mielellään tervehdit iloisesti myös asiakkaita, kun kuljet hotellin käytävillä, välillä myös rallienglannilla!

Lähiesihenkilönäsi toimii Peerân kiinteistöhuollon päällikkö Asko Karjalainen, jolla on pitkä historia alalta, myös kiinteistöhuollon aikuiskoulutuslinjan opettajana. Asko asustelee Kajaanissa ja kulkee kohteissamme tasaisin väliajoin - ja aina saa puhelimitse kiinni kinkkisessä tilanteessa.

Työpäivät sijoittuvat pääasiassa ma-la välille päivätyönä, mutta koska olet omistautunut osa tiimiä, joskus voi olla tarpeen, että käyt hätätilanteessa auttamassa työkavereita tai ainakin annat neuvoja miten toimia. Muutoin ulkoalueiden hoito ja päivystävä kiinteistöhuolto ovat ulkoistettuja. Jos Sinulla on LVIS-osaamista, se on iso plussa!

Kiinnostuitko? Haluatko hypätä huipputiimin kelkkaan, jossa puhalletaan aidosti yhteen hiileen?

jobs.title: Pulveroperatör - Hårdmetall
jobs.description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Vi söker nu en framåtsträvande operatör till vår pulvertillverkning på hårdmetallsfabriken.Här får du en central roll i att säkerställa effektiv produktion, samtidigt som du deltar i ett spännande förändringsarbete. Ta chansen att bli en del av vårt engagerade team och bidra till framtidens hårdmetallsproduktion.



Bli en del av vårt teamVälkommen till pulvertillverkningen inom hårdmetallsfabriken hos Epiroc Drilling Tools. Här blir du en del av ett dedikerat team om tre personer, som tillsammans strävar efter att upprätthålla en högkvalitativ produktion och en trygg arbetsmiljö.



Vi lägger stor vikt vid inkluderande och mångfaldsfrämjande värderingar. Kommunikation, öppenhet, nytänkande och personligt ansvar är centrala delar i vår arbetskultur. Vi stöttar varandra i vårt gemensamma uppdrag – att skapa en säker, hållbar och effektiv produktion med fokus på kvalitet och ständiga förbättringar.



Ditt uppdragSom operatör på pulvertillverkningen har du en viktig roll i produktionen där du ansvarar för drift och omställning av maskiner, operatörsunderhåll och kvalitetskontroller. Rollen innefattar självständigt arbete såväl som i grupp. Vi säkerställer att produkterna levereras med hög kvalitet och i rätt tid. Du identifierar och rapporterar avvikelser, samt bidrar aktivt till att kontinuerligt förbättra arbetsprocesserna tillsammans med ditt team.



Din profilVi söker dig som trivs med att ta ansvar och att driva på förändring. Din nyfikenhet, initiativförmåga och förmåga att strukturera och organisera är egenskaper vi värderar högt. Vi tror också att du trivs med att skapa och bibehålla relationer, och har lätt för att samarbeta effektivt med både ditt team och övriga funktioner inom produktionen och organisationen.



I den här rollen är det viktigt att du kan kommunicera på svenska i både tal och skrift.



Placering och övrigtDenna position är placerad i Fagersta, Sverige.Arbetstiderna är för närvarande förlagda till dagtid.



Livet på Epiroc



När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.



Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc:




    Globala karriärmöjligheter.
    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.
    Samhällsengagemang.
    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus.



Ansökan och kontakt



Vi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 28 Oktober 2026. Ansökningar granskas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.



Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter.



För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta:

jobs.title: Kvantitativ konsult Quantitative Intelligence | Stockholm

Vill du använda kvantitativ analys, riskkompetens och teknik för att bidra i verksamhetskritiska beslut?





Möjligheten

Ansvarsområden

jobs.title: Control Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking to expand our Swedish engineering team with a junior software / control systems engineer who is motivated to grow into a complex and specialized technical environment.

The role is focused on control systems for our waterjets, where software, PLCs, and HMIs interact closely with mechanical and hydraulic systems. You will work alongside experienced engineers and gradually take on more responsibility as your understanding of the systems grows.

Today, our systems are primarily based on PLC and HMI platforms, but we are currently developing our next-generation control system, which will be PC-based, running Linux, with Qt-based displays. This provides an opportunity to work with both established technologies and modern software platforms.

This position is well suited for someone early in their career who is curious, structured, and eager to learn how real-world control systems are built, maintained, and supported over long lifecycles.

Key responsibilities

    Support development, maintenance, and troubleshooting of control software for industrial and marine systems.
    Work with PLC-based control systems, learning to read, understand, and modify existing code.
    Assist with configuration and development of HMI applications used in operational systems.
    Participate in testing and validation using development and simulation environments.
    Support investigation of field issues together with senior engineers.
    Collaborate with colleagues in Sweden and support internal teams when needed.
    Be part of the development of our next-generation control system.

Required qualifications

    A degree in software engineering, automation, mechatronics, electrical engineering, or a related field.
    Basic understanding of programming concepts and structured code.
    Interest in industrial control systems, automation, or embedded/real-time software.
    Willingness to work with existing systems and learn from legacy codebases.
    Ability to work in a structured and careful manner, especially in environments where reliability is critical.
    Good communication skills in Swedish and English.

Preferred (but not required)

    Exposure to PLC programming (e.g. CODESYS or similar).
    Basic knowledge of industrial automation or control theory.
    Experience from internships, thesis work, or projects related to automation or embedded systems.
    Interest in systems that combine software, hardware, mechanics, and hydraulics.

Personal qualities

For this role, attitude and mindset are more important than specific tools. We are looking for someone who:

    Is curious and motivated to learn.
    Is patient and methodical when working with complex systems.
    Is comfortable asking questions and learning from more experienced colleagues.
    Takes responsibility and follows tasks through to completion.
    Enjoys understanding how systems work, not only writing new code.

What we offer

    The opportunity to develop deep competence in a specialized technical domain.
    A long-term role in a stable engineering environment in Sweden.
    Exposure to real-world systems with long lifecycles and high technical requirements.
    Opportunities to travel, as our customers are located around the globe.



The position is based at our head office in Uppsala and it is full time.

jobs.title: KØKKENCHEF - HOOKED
jobs.description:

Er du klar på at tage ejerskab over et køkken – både på gulvet og bag kulisserne? Vi søger en energisk og handlekraftig Køkkenchef der kan lede vores køkkenteam og sikre høj kvalitet i både mad og drift.

  • Sikre overholdelse af hygiejne-, rengørings- og sikkerhedsstandarder

  • Administrative opgaver såsom godkendelse af fakturaer, vagter og deltagelse i driftsmøder

  • Samarbejde med front-of-house for at sikre flow mellem køkken og service samt kundetilfredshed

Vi søger en person, der

  • Har erfaring med arbejdet i køkkener, gerne som manager eller med udvidet ansvar

  • Trives i højt tempo, bevarer overblikket og arbejder struktureret under pres

  • Har interesse i den økonomiske del af et Køkken og, arbejdet med vareforbrug og lønprocent

Vi tilbyder

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Send en kort ansøgning og CV — vi ser frem til at høre fra dig og byde dig velkommen hos Hooked.

jobs.title: Geodata Specialist
jobs.description:
Exploration Geodata Specialist for Boliden Mines

Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society’s access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future. What matters is how we produce them. Become part of us and drive change for generations to come.

Your opportunity

Would you like to combine geoscience, data and technology to support the future of mineral exploration?

We are looking for an Exploration Geodata Specialist to help develop and maintain Boliden’s geoscientific data platform and support exploration teams across the organization. You will help ensure that Boliden’s geoscientific and exploration data remains reliable, accessible and useful over time. A key part of the assignment will be contributing to the implementation and further development of our new SQL-based geodata platform, QDB, across our exploration sites.

The position can be based at the Boliden office or at one of our sites, subject to agreement.

Who you will work with

You will be part of our Exploration Geodata team and collaborate with database geologists, geologists, geophysicists, GIS users, mine geologists, Boliden IT, the Assay & Data Quality group and Exploration management. You will also interact with software suppliers, consultants, developers and other technology partners.

This is a collaborative role where you will connect operational geoscience needs with practical and sustainable technical solutions.

What you will do

Your main responsibilities will include:

    Develop, improve and document SQL-based exploration database structures, views and validation logic
    Design workflows for geological, geophysical and spatial data
    Support the rollout and continued development of QDB
    Develop SQL scripts, import and export routines and automated workflows
    Integrate databases with GIS, modelling, reporting and analysis tools
    Support data quality, governance, QA/QC, metadata management and controlled access
    Translate the needs of geologists, geophysicists and Geodata users into practical system improvements
    Test new solutions and provide technical support, documentation and training material
    Collaborate with Geodata, Exploration, GIS users, IT and external suppliers
    Help ensure that exploration data is reliable, validated, traceable and accessible over time

What you bring

You enjoy working at the intersection of geoscience and technology. You approach complex information methodically and understand the importance of quality, traceability and long-term maintainability. You communicate clearly and can turn operational needs into practical technical solutions.

We believe you have

    A university degree or equivalent education in geology, geophysics, GIS, geodata management, database development, computer science or another relevant technical field
    Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases
    A good understanding of geological or geophysical data, drillhole data and exploration workflows
    Practical experience with GIS and spatial data
    Programming or scripting skills
    The ability to develop, test and document database applications and automated workflows
    A structured, quality-focused and analytical approach
    Good written and spoken English
    Proficiency in the local language relevant to your workplace
    The ability to collaborate effectively with both technical specialists and operational users
    A valid European Category B driver’s license

It is an advantage if you have

    Experience integrating databases with GIS or geological modelling tools
    Experience with geodata management, exploration databases or geological and geophysical information
    Broad academic or professional experience covering both geoscience and data systems

We value potential and encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

Why work with us

At Boliden, care, courage and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a collaborative workplace where your contribution can have a direct impact on future generations. You will have the opportunity to work with geoscientific information that supports exploration activities across Boliden and to shape systems and workflows designed for long-term value.

Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!

At Boliden, diversity and inclusion are drivers of innovation. We know that different perspectives and experiences strengthen us and help us remain at the forefront of an important and exciting industry. We therefore encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Together, we build a workplace where everyone can feel safe and inspired to reach their full potential.

Want to know more about the position? Contact hiring manager Monica Johansson, monica.johansson@boliden.com, +46 70 201 21 67.

Questions about the application are answered by our Talent Acquisition Partner, Terese Lindholm, terese.lindholm@boliden.com.

For union information, please contact Mats Lindblom, SACO, +46 73-350 04 19, Andreas Mårtensson, Unionen, +46 70-541 83 93 or Peter Markström, Ledarna, +46 910-77 40 09.

Last day to apply: Sunday 8 November 2026

As part of Boliden’s qualitative recruitment efforts and systematic safety work, background checks may be included in the recruitment process.

If you represent a recruiting company, please refrain from contacting us about this advertisement. We appreciate your consideration.

jobs.title: Research Infrastructure Architect
jobs.description:
The eScience Center at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) develops and operates large-scale IT infrastructure dedicated to research in all fields. The center is a leading national provider of supercomputing resources and facilities, often provided in close collaboration with other Danish universities. 

Our mission is to support research via the development of advanced IT infrastructure and by providing support and expertise to researchers. The key areas of the center are High Performance Computing (HPC), Cloud Services, Data Analytics, and Data Management Services. We assist a large research community, educational and government institutions, as well as commercial companies. The center has developed a user-friendly and advanced private cloud system called UCloud, which is the foundation for the DeiC national system for interactive HPC and cloud computing.

We continuously tackle new technological challenges as part of our ongoing systems development. The SDU eScience Center offers a research-like environment where we encourage the study of innovative solutions and personal growth. We firmly believe in open-source and web technology as means to reach our goals.

We are currently looking to fill a position within the infrastructure team. We are looking for candidates with experience in Linux systems administration and a strong desire and ability to learn. The successful candidate will work closely with the current senior systems administrator, who has a long-time expertise in scientific research, programming, and Linux systems administration.

While this position does offer flexibility and the possibility of remote work, the candidate is expected to be on-site in Odense the majority of the time.

Job description:

We seek candidates with experience in the following areas.

  • Linux systems administration

  • High Performance Computing (hardware and software)

  • Kubernetes (on-prem)

  • Automated deployment (e.g. via Ansible)

  • Advanced networking (ethernet and infiniband)

  • Enterprise storage systems

  • Cloud computing

  • Systems development and integration

Experience in at least two of the above areas is required, and candidates with previous experience in high-performance computing, Linux systems administration, and Kubernetes will be strongly preferred.

Tasks under the infrastructure team include, but are not limited to, configuration of hardware, network, and software; automated deployment using Ansible; configuration of virtualized and container-based environments, such as Kubernetes; operating and maintaining distributed storage systems, such as Ceph WekaIO, and Quantum ActiveScale; configuration of Linux systems and common services.

Required qualifications:

  • Proven experience in at least two of the areas in the job description.

  • Strong background in Linux systems.

  • Programming skills (e.g. in Go, Python, bash, …).

  • Proven ability to work productively both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team balancing divergent objectives involving research, code development, systems administration, and consulting with scientists.

Other relevant qualifications (not required):

  • MSc or PhD in a relevant field of science or engineering.

  • Experience with common DevOps practices (such as Git and GitHub, continuous integration and deployment, software documentation).

Condition of Employment

The starting date for the job is as soon as possible, and it will be agreed upon with the successful candidates. Appointments are for full-time positions for a limited time period of at least 1 year based on the candidate’s profile with the possibility of extension. 

All inquiries are welcome. Please contact:
Prof. Director Claudio Pica
SDU eScience Center
Dept. of Mathematics and Computer Science
University of Southern Denmark
email: pica@cp3.sdu.dk 

or the infrastructure team leader:
Martin Lundquist Hansen
SDU eScience Center
Dept. of Mathematics and Computer Science
University of Southern Denmark
email: hansen@imada.sdu.dk 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Lokalvårdare timvikariat, Service, Umeå
jobs.description:
Region Västerbotten arbetar för att god hälsa och hållbar utveckling ska stärka varandra. Vi tar ansvar för en jämlik välfärd och för att forskning och innovation ger resultat.

Digitalisering och Service är ett verksamhetsområde som skapats för att ännu bättre och mer effektivt stödja Hälso- och sjukvården. Vi vill möjliggöra mer tid till vård genom smarta servicelösningar och digitalisering. Digitala lösningar och innovationer är en viktig del för att klara morgondagens utmaningar för sjukvården och där ligger Region Västerbotten i framkant. Vi arbetar i nära samarbete med Hälso-och sjukvården och har en stark relation. Vi vill vara en modern och flexibel arbetsplats med många olika förmågor som kan tillgodose framtidens behov. I dagsläget ingår fem verksamheter i verksamhetsområdet, vi finns i hela länet med verksamhet på alla tre sjukhusen i Västerbotten. Vi har ett spännande och utmanade arbete framför oss, tillsammans är vi starka!

Service i Umeå är en enhet som ingår i Region Västerbottens Digitalisering och Service organisation och erbjuder servicetjänster bland annat inom området lokalvård. Inom lokalvården är vi totalt cirka 217 medarbetare i länet varav drygt 100 medarbetare återfinns i Umeå.

Vi har ansvar för all städning inom Regionen vilket sker utifrån fastställda riktlinjer. I uppdraget som lokalvårdare ansvarar du för att minska risken för smittspridning samt bidrar till trivselhöjande insatser för västerbottningar och medarbetare som vistas i våra lokaler. Arbetet bidrar även till att bibehålla värdet på lokalerna samt möjliggöra systematiska kvalitetskontroller.

Vi söker nu fler kollegor som vill arbeta på timmar hos oss på lokalvården.

5 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som lokalvårdare hos oss ger du viktig service och möjliggör insatser som påverkar många.

Vi arbetar professionellt med de senaste städmetoderna i sjukhusmiljö. Som lokalvårdare kommer du främst att arbeta med regelmässig städning, men även andra arbetsuppgifter kan förekomma som till exempel källsortering.

Du arbetar i team i olika områden men har ett stort eget ansvar i att ditt arbete utförs enligt gällande instruktioner med hög kvalitet och egenkontroll.

Din placering blir vid lokalvården kan utifrån behov utlånas till de andra verksamheterna inom Service i Umeå. Arbetstiderna är varierande där kvälls- och skiftarbete kan förekomma samt arbete under helg.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Tidigare erfarenhet av lokalvård är meriterande, likaså om du har en städutbildning och datavana. Kan du dessutom köra kombiskurmaskin, polermaskin och andra, i lokalvårdsyrket, relevanta maskiner så är det ytterligare en merit.

Arbetet präglas av många kontaktytor i sjukhusmiljö och då ställs stora krav på att vara serviceinriktad och flexibel. I ditt arbete tar du eget ansvar och har förmågan att organisera och prioritera ditt arbete, samt samarbeta med andra kollegor.

Att tala, läsa och skriva på svenska är nödvändigt för att kunna förstå och använda städinstruktioner. Svenska D eller motsvarande kunskaper är ett krav. För att bedöma om du uppfyller språkkraven kan du behöva genomföra ett test som arbetsgivaren tillhandahåller.

Stor vikt kommer läggas vid personlig lämplighet. Rekrytering sker löpande.

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet: max 10 dagar.

Läs mer om våra förmåner för dig som jobbar med oss på webbsidan

https://www.regionvasterbotten.se/nar-du-jobbar-hos-oss/formaner

Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

jobs.title: Senior therapieplanner
jobs.description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Adelante Zorgroep in Hoensbroek een senior therapieplanner.

Adelante biedt ondersteuning aan volwassenen en kinderen die te maken hebben met de gevolgen van een ziekte, aangeboren aandoening of ongeval. Ruim 1.100 professionals verlenen zorg en onderwijs vanuit diverse locaties verspreid over heel Limburg. Cliënten kunnen terecht voor medisch specialistische revalidatie, gehoor-, taal- en spraakproblemen, speciaal onderwijs, medische kindzorg, sport en arbeidsrevalidatie. Adelante richt zich niet op de beperking maar op de mogelijkheden om door te kunnen gaan.

Ons motto: haal het beste uit jezelf!

Wat ga je doen?
Als medewerker in ons team MAP (Medische Administratie en Planning) werk je op onze locatie in Hoensbroek. MAP speelt een cruciale rol in de patiëntreis. Als planner ben je verantwoordelijk voor de planning en communicatie rondom de instroom, doorstroom en uitstroom van patiënten. Adelante streeft ernaar om het functioneren van MAP continu te verbeteren door dingen op het juiste moment te doen, volledig afgestemd op de patiëntreis. Jij gaat hier een belangrijke rol in spelen!

Vorig jaar is Adelante overgestapt op een nieuw elektronisch patiëntendossier. Naast de technische implementatie is het essentieel dat de processen efficiënt en effectief worden ingericht. Samen met je collega's werk je sinds de overgang aan het optimaliseren van de operationele planning. Hierbij focus je op het verbeteren van de huidige operationele processen en het verder stroomlijnen van de planning.

Wie zoeken wij?

  • Je hebt een relevante hbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur zorglogistiek of bedrijfskunde
  • Je hebt oog voor innovatie en het verbeteren van processen.
  • Je hebt kennis van een zorgorganisatie en de processen
  • Je hebt uitgebreide vakkennis om afwijkende situaties te kunnen beoordelen en oplossen, of daarin te adviseren
  • Je hebt analytisch vermogen om verbanden tussen de benodigde kenniselementen te kunnen leggen en te adviseren
  • Vakkennis en wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving worden bijgehouden voor de uitvoering van de werkzaamheden
  • Handigheid in technische systemen

jobs.title: Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder AFAS
jobs.description:

Ons motto: haal het beste uit jezelf!

Wat ga je doen?
Als Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder AFAS krijg je de vrijheid om jouw eigen werkdag in te richten en de werking van onze software continu te verbeteren. Je werkt in Hoensbroek aan de ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van AFAS voor HR, inkoop, logistiek en financiën, en beheert daarnaast aanpalende applicaties.

  • Je voert het functioneel beheer uit van AFAS, Ortec, Zenya en Konnect/Portabase.
  • Je analyseert en verhelpt storingen en problemen in de systemen.
  • Je ondersteunt gebruikers en traint hen in het gebruik van de applicaties.
  • Je schrijft heldere werkinstructies en houdt deze bij.
  • Je voert test- en acceptatiesessies uit voor software-aanpassingen.

jobs.title: The Jeffery- Prep Chef
jobs.description:
PREP CHEF – THE JEFFERY

Are you an experienced and organised kitchen professional who enjoys making sure everything is ready for a busy service? Then you might be exactly who we're looking for!

The Jeffery is a pub concept created by the team behind Hooked, located at Nørrebrogade 160 in Copenhagen. It's our take on a classic British pub – think proper pub food, great drinks, sports on the screens, busy nights and plenty of personality.

Our kitchen is at the heart of it all, and we're looking for a dedicated Prep Chef to help keep things running smoothly behind the scenes.

About the role

As our Prep Chef, you'll play an important part in making sure our kitchen is prepared for the day ahead. You'll be responsible for preparing ingredients, following recipes and ensuring that everything is organised, stocked and ready for service.

You'll work closely with the rest of the kitchen team, helping maintain a high standard of quality, consistency and efficiency.

What we're looking for

  • Previous experience working in a professional kitchen.

  • A structured and organised approach to your work.

  • An eye for detail and a commitment to food quality and consistency.

  • The ability to work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.

  • A good understanding of food safety, hygiene and kitchen procedures.

  • A positive attitude and a willingness to help your teammates.

At The Jeffery, things can get busy, and good preparation makes all the difference. We're looking for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys having a clear overview and understands the importance of getting the small details right.

We work hard, help each other out and like having a good time while doing it. You'll become part of a social kitchen team where teamwork, good energy and a shared passion for food are what keep things moving.

Sound like your kind of workplace?

Send us an application and tell us a little about yourself, your previous kitchen experience and why you'd like to join The Jeffery.

We'd love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Manufacturing Associate
jobs.description:
Job Scope

Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function.

The Manufacturing Associate performs all functions associated with manufacturing operations. This includes operating process machines and auxiliary equipment, troubleshooting, and maintaining the machine. The manufacturing associate is also expected to collaborate with colleagues and engineers on tasks including (but not restricted to): set-up, calibration, rework, material handling, sampling and experiments. This role requires technical understanding of the manufacturing process and uses custom programs to support the collection of operating data to make real-time adjustments to processes, instruments or equipment. The manufacturing associate will assist in developing methods and procedures to control or modify the manufacturing process and improve shop floor management.  

Key Responsibilities

Overall areas of responsibilities and activities

Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)

    Assure safe conditions through defined procedures (including Lock out tag out – LOTO) during equipment repairs, cleaning, or inspections.

    Work under the defined shift model to ensure customer demand is met in the assigned production time. Working full-time on the shop floor, supporting operation. 

    Operate the process machines and material handling equipment used in production, following implemented work instructions, standard operating procedures, and guidelines.

    Perform troubleshooting, autonomous maintenance, cleaning activities and pre-start up inspections/safety checks on production and material handling equipment and fixtures.

    Support the review and optimization of work instructions and process documentation.

    Train and validate the competence of new manufacturing associates.

    Assist with the distribution and handling/re-stocking of PPE and shop floor consumables.

    Handle production waste.

    Report current condition, status and also deviations in machine function, area cleanliness or personnel behavior to shift leader.

    Contribute to maintaining high 5S standards within the process areas and general factory areas.

    Follow all currently implemented work instructions and standard operating procedures for cleaning, material handling, waste handling, and PPE use.

    Maintain accurate records and documentation related to the machine, product, and process.

    Work proactively with the support functions (Manufacturing technicians, quality, logistics, etc).

    Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resources for the benefit of the business.

Requirements

Educational background and previous experience required for the role

Qualifications and Experience

    High school education or a relevant education (e.g., industrial program at a gymnasium level, automation operator/technician education, process operator/technician education) is a plus.

    1 year previous experience from the manufacturing or processing industry (e.g., battery, pulp and paper, food, chemicals, microelectronics, oil & gas, pharmaceutical processing).

    Experience with some of the following is advantageous: permit procedures, Lock Out Tag Out, near-miss reporting, safety audits, maintenance audits, process control systems, and daily follow-up on safety actions.

    Understanding how to utilize equipment to run efficient manufacturing with energy and costing optimization.
    Experience with production processes including mechanical, electrical, pneumatic and hydraulic components.

Specific skills & Knowledge  

    Knowledge of Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) or other sample tracking software is a plus.

    Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.

    High work ethic, critical thinking, and strong problem-solving skills are a must.  

    This role requires the ability to stand for extended periods and perform manual labor in physically demanding environments. This can include 100% working hours allocation into clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. The role also requires working shifts and working in multiple process areas, according to business needs. This role requires working full-time on the shop floor, supporting operation. 

    A genuine technical interest and curiosity about working within production is highly valued. A good understanding of machines and equipment such as pipes, pumps, and valves is a plus.

jobs.title: Co-Founder / CEO - Hybrid/Remote
jobs.description:
Co-Founder / CEO – Build the Next Big Tech Company

Start from day one – with capital, customers, and a team behind you

Company Description

This isn’t your typical company – we launch one new tech venture every month.

We develop the idea, validate customer demand, secure funding, and build the initial infrastructure – then we bring in a founder like you to step in as the CEO & co-founder from day one.

You won’t be starting alone. You’ll be building something new, bold, and scalable – but with a team of experienced operators, proven processes, and startup capital behind you.

Our team has founded and scaled companies like Realforce (120+ M ARR) and Minna Technologies (770M exit to Mastercard). Now we’re doing it again – over and over – and we’re looking for founders to build with us.

Our Model

What we provide:

A validated business idea and early customer interest

Startup capital and a full operational support team (tech, finance, legal, growth)

You as CEO & co-founder with equity from day one

A proven framework that creates profitable companies fast

Our Background & Track Record

We’ve launched multiple ventures already, and several became profitable within 12 months.

We select one founder per month to build with – and fully commit our resources to that venture.

This is not an accelerator, incubator, or passive investment – it’s co-building from scratch.

Our Team & Culture

We’re builders – not theorists.

We value speed, ownership, and clarity. Our studio is structured for execution, and we only work with people who have the grit and vision to drive something forward – fast.

You’ll work alongside operators in tech, design, GTM, legal and fundraising – and have the space to make the CEO role your own.

Requirement Profile – Who We're Looking For

We only work with three founder personas. Do you recognize yourself in one of them?

Founder Personas

1. The Growth Hacker

Commercially driven and thrives in sales and GTM

Built sales machines, funnels, teams or grown revenue 0–20M+

Ready to lead and build from scratch – with strong operational support

2. The Ex-Consultant

Background at McKinsey, BCG, Bain or similar

Wants to own a P&L, not just analyze it

Gets things done even in messy, imperfect conditions

Ready to lead a company, not just build decks

3. The Tech Builder

Senior developer or product builder who’s shipped real V1s

Can turn ideas into MVPs in weeks – not months

Has “unshakable conviction” about their ability to solve hard problems

Wants to be CEO and get commercial help from day one

Role Responsibilities

    Step in as CEO & co-founder of a new company
    Lead product development, GTM, hiring and growth
    Work directly with our team for support in sales, marketing, operations, finance, tech and legal
    Build and scale a business from 0 to funding, profitability, or beyond

Your Day-to-Day

    Operate as CEO of a brand-new venture
    Work closely with customers to validate and refine the product
    Collaborate with the team + other portfolio companies to execute and scale
    Recruit early team members
    Set goals and drive traction – fast

Qualifications & Experience

    You’ve built something before – a product, a sales pipeline, a company, or a team
    You’re comfortable with ambiguity and quick decision-making
    You have strong leadership instincts and can own your work
    You match one of our founder personas (Growth, Consulting, Tech)
    You have high “GSDQ” – Get Shit Done Quotient

Traits & Characteristics

    Entrepreneurial mindset
    Action-oriented and strategic thinker
    Clear communicator and team leader
    Quick learner with a hunger for building
    You don’t want a job – you want ownership

Career Growth & Benefits

    30% Equity as co-founder from day one
    Support from a full operational team
    Network, partners and potential investors provided
    High-impact role with startup-level freedom and real backing
    Proven model with real success stories



Compensation: 0 SEK base salary. Salary negotiated within 6 months. 30% equity as Co-Founder from day one.

Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

You will be employed directly by the company. You will receive information about which company the advertisement refers to when you are in contact with the recruiter. Bumbli Group is therefore not the employer but the recruitment agency.

Welcome to submit your application!

Bumbli Group is part of House of Recruitment — a personal, traditional and quality-driven recruitment agency in Gothenburg.

jobs.title: Asentaja
jobs.description:
Konevuokraamo Vatupassi etsii kokenutta, etevää ja korkeissa paikoissa työskentelyyn tottunutta **asentajaa** osaksi työmaapalveluiden tiimiä. Tehtävää hoidetaan pääasiassa Vantaalta käsin ja työskentely tapahtuu Etelä-Suomen alueella. Monipuolinen kokemus kaikenlaisista rakennustyömaiden asennustöistä katsotaan hakijan suureksi eduksi, mutta loput ratkaisee asenne!

**Mitä odotamme hakijalta:**

- Aiempaa kokemusta erilaisista rakennustyömaiden asennustöistä (telineistä hisseihin ja työmaatiloista lämmityksiin), eduksi katsotaan myös kokemus sähkö- ja/tai konevuokraamoalalta

- Työturva- ja ajokorttia. BE-ajokortin katsomme eduksi

- Joustavuutta ja valmiutta matkustaa Suomen sisällä

- Kykyä ja valmiutta fyysiseen työhön

- Tiimityötaitoja sekä rennonletkeää ja työkaverit huomioivaa asennetta


Asentajien työpäivät koostuvat muun muassa mastolavojen ja hissien, rakennustelineiden, työmaatilojen sekä työmaiden lämmityksen ja olosuhdeseurannan asennuksista. **Työtehtävissä** **asennuskorkeus vaihtelee**, eli hakijan tulee olla tarpeeksi huimapäinen, jotta työskentely korkeuksissakin onnistuu.

Vastineeksi tarjoamme rehtiä palkkaa ja minimaalisen vähän nipottamista ja turhantärkeilyä. Emme ole (vielä) Suomen suurin konevuokraamo, mutta haluamme olla paras – ja sehän lähtee mahdollisimman hyvinvoivasta henkilöstöstä. Laajojen työterveyspalveluiden ja työkykyvakuutuksen lisäksi tarjoamme kaikille työntekijöillemme sähköpyörät, myynti-, kunto- ja tupakoimattomuusbonusta sekä panostamme reiluuteen ja työssä viihtymiseen.

**Mikä Vatupassi?**

Vatupassi on perheomisteinen konevuokraamoyritys, jonka toimipisteet sijaitsevat Joensuussa, Jyväskylässä, Kuopiossa, Nurmeksessa, Oulussa, Tampereella, Turussa sekä Vantaalla. Olemme osa kansainvälistä Avesco Groupia, joka toimii Suomen lisäksi kotimaassaan Sveitsissä, Itävallassa sekä Baltian maissa.

Vatupassilaista kulttuuria leimaa perheomisteisen yrityksen reiluus, joustavuus ja oikeudenmukaisuus. Meillä omista pidetään huolta. Ja se tarkoittaa sitä, että vastuuta kannetaan yhdessä, luotetaan toinen toisiimme ja autetaan työkaveria ilman mikromanageerausta.

**Hakeminen ja hakuaika**

Haku on käynnissä 1.11.2026 saakka, mutta pesti täytetään heti sopivan tyypin löydyttyä, joten laita hakemusta heti tulemaan!

Lisätietoja pestistä antaa meidän Kaitsu: Kai Olin kai.olin@vatupassi.fi p. 040 169 3882

jobs.title: Chefs for winter 2026-2027 to Lapland
jobs.description:
CHEFS – WINTER SEASON 2026–2027, LAPLAND (FINLAND)


Are you ready for an unforgettable winter season in the Arctic? Imagine working in Lapland, surrounded by snowy landscapes, northern lights, and international guests from all over the world. This is your opportunity to combine professional growth with a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

Lapland is one of the most unique winter destinations in the world – known for its magical nature, vibrant tourism season, and unforgettable atmosphere. During your free time, you can: watch the northern lights dance across the sky, enjoy skiing, snowboarding, and winter sports, experience snowmobile and husky safaris, relax in peaceful Arctic nature.

About the role

We are looking for motivated and professional chefs to work in Lapland during the next winter season. We have great winter destinations, hotel-restaurants and skiing centers all over the Lapland. Depending on the place and position job description will be ala carte- or buffet-chefs tasks.


Season periods:

- Christmas season: 1 Dec 2026 – 6 Jan 2027

- Winter season: Nov/Dec 2026 – Mar/Apr 2027

- Spring season: Feb 2027 - Mar/Apr 2027


What we expect from you

- EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Finland

- Minimum 2 years of relevant experience as chef

- Good hygiene knowledge and HACCP Standards

- Good communicative English skills (other languages are a plus)

- Positive, proactive, and flexible attitude

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, international environment

- Finnish hygiene passport and salmonella certificate may be required – we will assist you if needed.

What we offer

- Seasonal contract with possibility of extension

- Competitive salary based on experience

- Extra pay for evenings, nights, Sundays, and overtime (Finnish collective agreement)

- Accommodation provided (approx. 250–300 €/month/person)

- Work in unique Lapland destinations

- Support throughout your employment

- Employee benefits

How to apply

Please send your application with your resume in english to us with online application form. To fasten the process, attach your CV and contact details of your referees or recommendation letter. We review applications during the application period and positions will be filled once suitable candidates are found.

We will start video interviews shortly – invitation will be sent via email, if you are chosen for the interview.


Benefits


- Työterveys

- Kuukausittaisia palkitsemisia

jobs.title: Legal Counsel and Senior Legal Counsel, Compliance @ FORCIT Group
jobs.description:
Are you eager to join a growing company and a developing legal team within the defence industry? Are you either a compliance professional, looking to help develop an internal compliance function, or an experienced lawyer with a generalist profile?

If you answered **YES**, continue reading, as these positions could be for you!

**We are now looking for two legal professionals** to join FORCIT Group (FORCIT) as **Legal Counsel and Senior Legal Counsel, Compliance**. In these new roles, you will join the General Counsel to form a three-person legal team. The positions are based in Finland and can be located flexibly at FORCIT's offices, for example in Hanko, Tampere or Tuusula, combined with remote work. Note that the successful completion of the task requires 1-2 days of presence at FORCIT's headquarters in Hanko, depending on the ongoing projects. The position is full-time and permanent.

FORCIT is a leading provider of explosives, defence solutions, and related services, with more than 130 years of experience. Through continuous innovation, strong expertise, and modern technology, FORCIT delivers high-quality products and services to their customers. Today, more than 800 dedicated professionals work across the FORCIT Group.

Learn more about FORCIT **here.**

_At FORCIT, development is constant. We strive to follow trends and to be a pioneer when it comes to modern and innovative solutions that improve efficiency, safety and sustainability. As we continue to grow internationally, our ambition is to be the partner of choice for customers seeking Nordic expertise and values. Maria Neovius, General Counsel @ FORCIT Group_

**As a Legal Counsel at FORCIT**, you will work at the heart of the business, partnering closely with the business areas and a wide range of stakeholders. You will help the business identify and manage legal risks while supporting sustainable growth and responsible business practices. Your role will cover commercial contracts, regulatory matters, risk management, and other legal issues related to the operations. This is a hands-on role where you can take ownership, see the impact of your work and contribute to shaping how the legal function develops.

This is a role for someone who thrives in a varied and evolving environment, enjoys taking on new challenges and is motivated by continuous learning and development.

**As a Senior Legal Counsel, Compliance at FORCIT**, you will have a unique opportunity to shape how compliance supports the business and future growth. You will work closely with the management and business teams to identify regulatory requirements, assess risks and develop practical solutions that enable responsible business. A key part of your role will be to continuously develop FORCITs compliance framework — helping define the principles, policies, processes and governance that form the foundation of the compliance culture. You will advise the organisation on matters such as regulatory compliance, ethics, risk management, internal controls and business integrity, while supporting teams in turning requirements into effective day-to-day practices.

This is a role for someone who wants to do more than interpret rules. You will have the opportunity to help frame the compliance agenda, influence how the organisation operates and build a compliance culture that supports both trust and business success.

**You may be the person were looking for if:**

you have a masters degree in law and at least five years of relevant post-graduate work experience, preferably gained in an in-house legal or compliance role, at a law firm or in a legal consultancy setting. Please note that this is a minimum requirement, and both roles offer plenty of opportunities and interesting challenges for more senior legal professionals as well;

you are positive, solution-oriented and you bring solid legal experience. For the Legal Counsel role, we prefer a generalist profile and for the Senior Legal Counsel, Compliance role, we are looking for someone with strong expertise in compliance and a proven ability to build and develop compliance functions;

you are a collaborative team player who values open communication, knowledge-sharing and working together towards common goals;

you are proactive, resilient, and have a can-do attitude – you are not afraid to roll up your sleeves, take initiative, and get things done; and

you have strong communication skills – fluency in Finnish and English (both written and spoken) is required – Swedish is considered as an advantage.

**FORCIT offers you:**

a versatile new role in which you will find yourself immersed in a constantly evolving environment that provides plenty of opportunities for professional growth and development;

a business-oriented position where your pragmatic, solutions-oriented mindset will enable you to support the business in achieving its goals across a broad range of legal matters;

a responsible role where you will work closely with FORCITs business areas and a broad range of stakeholders, take ownership of key legal matters, and play an active role in shaping and developing the legal function; and

a role in a warm and inclusive, low-hierarchy organization where people value each other, collaborate closely and genuinely support one another.

The selected candidate will be subject to a security clearance in accordance with the Finnish Security Clearance Act (726/2014) and a drug test.

**Interested?** If this sounds like your next career step, please send us your CV and application letter by **20 October 2026**.

If you have any questions, we encourage you to contact Minjon's Senior Recruiter Wilma Tuominen (tel. +358 40 515 3834 or wilma.tuominen@minjon.fi) **before 7 October**. **From 7-14 October**, you can contact Minjon's Senior Recruiter Vilma Suomi (tel. +358 50 360 5134 or vilma.suomi@minjon.fi), and **from 15-20 October**, you can contact Wilma Tuominen (contact details above).

jobs.title: Rengastyöntekijä
jobs.description:
Haemme henkilöautojen sekä raskaan kaluston rengastyöntekijää sesonkityöhön Vantaalle.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu renkaiden kausisäilytys toiminnot, kuten renkaiden pesu ja siirrot rengashotelliin sekä renkaiden asennus taitojesi mukaan. Sinulla voi olla jo aiempaa kokemusta rengasalalta, tai voit olla työurasi alussa. Työtehtävät vaihtelevat osaamisesi mukaan.

Sesonkiaikana renkaan vaihtoa tehdään arkisin. Työaika sijoittuu arkisin klo 8.00-17.00 välille.

Toivomme sinulta sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä eduksi katsotaan, jos sinulta löytyy aiempaa kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä.

Tarjoamme sinulle mukavat työkaverit sekä mahdollisuuden päästä mukaan monipuolisiin työtehtäviin autorengasalan parissa.

Palkkaasi vaikuttaa osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi vastaavanlaisista töistä. Palkassasi noudatetaan autonrengasalan työehtosopimusta 12,50 – 14,66 euroa tunnilta kokemuksesi mukaan.

**Parhaiten rengastyöntekijän tehtävässä onnistut, jos sinulla on:**

- Näppäriä kädentaitoja

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

- Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa

- Joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen


**Tämä rengastyöntekijän tehtävä tarjoaa sinulle:**

- Osaamistasi ja kokemustasi vastaava palkka

- Mahdollisuuden kartuttaa työkokemusta

- Monipuoliset työtehtävät rengasalalla

- Mukavat työkaverit


Kiinnostuitko työtehtävästä? Täytä työnhakulomake osoitteessa alrekry.fi!

Kiinnostuitko ja haluat tietää enemmän, soita rohkeasti minulle ja kysy lisää. Tavoitat minut parhaiten ma - pe klo 9-14.00 välillä p.050 5724844 / Gia. Voit myös lähettää viestin sähköpostilla osoitteeseen hr.alrekry@alrekry.fi.

Etsitään sinulle yhdessä mieleisesi työpaikka! Olemme luotettava ja vakavarainen työnantaja jo yli kahdenkymmenen vuoden ajan. Pitkä kokemuksemme on osoittanut, että voit luottaa meihin.

Tavoitteemme on luoda mahdollisuuksia jokaiselle työntekijällemme onnistua työssään. Alrekyllä on jatkuvasti uusia työpaikkoja monien alojen työntekijöille. Olemme parhaiten edustettuna palvelu-, logistiikka-, teollisuus-, metalli- ja elintarvikealoilla.

jobs.title: Jobb med teleradiologi fra Auckland på New Zealand
jobs.description:
Ønsker du å kombinere din kompetanse innen radiologi med internasjonal erfaring på New Zealand?

Vi søker spesialister i radiologi til et 12 måneders teleradiologioppdrag i Auckland, hvor du arbeider med granskning og rapportering av akutte radiologiske undersøkelser for svenske sykehus.

 

Du jobber fysisk fra en etablert arbeidsplass i Auckland, sammen med radiologer fra flere land. Takket være tidsforskjellen mellom New Zealand og Sverige kan du granske akutte undersøkelser for svenske sykehus på dagtid i Auckland, mens det er natt i Sverige.

 

Dette er en spennende mulighet for deg som har erfaring innen akuttradiologi og ønsker å kombinere klinisk arbeid med et internasjonalt fagmiljø og opplevelsen av å bo på New Zealand.

 

Om oppdraget

 

Oppdraget er innen teleradiologi, med hovedvekt på granskning og rapportering av akutte radiologiske undersøkelser for svenske sykehus.

 

Arbeidet utføres fra en etablert arbeidsplass i Auckland, med moderne teknologi og systemer tilrettelagt for fjernrapportering. Du blir en del av et internasjonalt radiologmiljø med kolleger fra flere land, tydelige arbeidsrutiner og høyt fokus på diagnostisk kvalitet.

 

Tidsforskjellen gjør det mulig å dekke svenske sykehus sitt behov for radiologisk kompetanse på nattestid, samtidig som du selv arbeider på dagtid i Auckland.

 

Oppdraget har en varighet på 12 måneder, med oppstart etter avtale. Oppdragsgiver tilbyr praktisk bistand i forbindelse med flytting og etablering på New Zealand, også for deg som ønsker å ta med familien.

 

Vi søker deg som

  • Har spesialistgodkjenning i radiologi fra Norge, Sverige eller Danmark
  • Har erfaring med akuttradiologi og er trygg på selvstendige diagnostiske vurderinger
  • Trives med et høyt arbeidstempo og kan håndtere akutte problemstillinger
  • Behersker et skandinavisk språk og engelsk
  • Har erfaring med teleradiologi, eller er motivert for å arbeide med fjernrapportering

Relocation og praktisk støtte

  • Hjelp med visum og oppholdstillatelse
  • Støtte med bolig i Auckland og praktiske spørsmål rundt flytting
  • Relocation for hele familien
  • Strukturert onboarding og introduksjon

Auckland er kjent for høy livskvalitet, trygghet og gode internasjonale skoler, noe som gjør byen attraktiv både for deg som flytter alene eller med familien.

 

Vi tilbyr

  • Konkurransedyktige og attraktive betingelser
  • Lønnsmodell knyttet til produksjonsvolum uten fast inntektstak
  • 12 måneders oppdrag med tydelige og forutsigbare rammer
  • Muligheten til å bygge internasjonal erfaring i et globalt arbeidsmiljø
  • Rådgivning og støtte gjennom hele prosessen fra erfaren rekrutterer

Hvorfor New Zealand

 

New Zealand er kjent for høy livskvalitet, trygghet og en livsstil med god balanse mellom jobb og fritid. Auckland er landets største by og regnes som en av verdens mest attraktive byer å bo i, med internasjonalt miljø, moderne infrastruktur og nærhet til natur i alle retninger.

 

Byen ligger mellom to hav og byr på strender, vulkanlandskap, seiling, surfing og fjellturer – alt innen kort avstand fra sentrum. Samtidig finner du restauranter, kulturtilbud og et internasjonalt byliv.

 

For mange er New Zealand også attraktivt på grunn av klimaet, den åpne kulturen og muligheten til å kombinere en internasjonal karriere med en mer avslappet hverdag.

 

Om oppdragsgiver

 

Internasjonal helseaktør med langsiktig fokus på kvalitet innen radiologisk diagnostikk. Du blir en del av et internasjonalt team med felles arbeidsrutiner og tydelige prosesser innen akutt radiologi.

 

Arbeidsmiljøet er organisert for å sikre høy kvalitet, effektivitet og godt kollegialt samarbeid i det daglige arbeidet.

 

Vil du høre mer om muligheten?

 

Send inn din søknad i dag, så tar vi kontakt!

 

Du kan også registrere din CV eller melde deg på vårt nyhetsbrev for å holde deg oppdatert om fremtidige muligheter.

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Dignus Medical er spesialister på rekruttering og utleie av leger, spesialister og sykepleiere. Vi bidrar til å løse bemanningsutfordringene ved å koble rett personell med rett oppdragsgiver – til rett tid.

jobs.title: Tenure track assistant professor/Associate professor positions in Veternary medicine
jobs.employer: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
jobs.description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (ANIVET) is seeking three new staff members for teaching and research in veterinary medicine. The positions are available from 1 August 2027 or soon thereafter.

The educational activities for these positions are aimed at students in veterinary medicine at both the bachelor’s and master’s levels.

The veterinary medicine programme is organised into courses covering educationally relevant themes and integrates a range of disciplines, and this is done with the vision to create a professional engagement while ensuring scientific depth for the students of veterinary medicine.

ANIVET is part of the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University. The department is located near Viborg (Campus AU Viborg – Research Centre Foulum) and encompasses five research units with approximately 200 dedicated employees of which 50% are scientific staff. The AU Viborg campus will gradually grow to a student population of 800 – 900. The positions will be integrated into the department’s existing scientific research units, in which scientists at all career stages work together with skilled technical staff such as laboratory technicians and data analysts.

The positions
  1. Clinical veterinary science – livestock
  2. Veterinary public health
  3. Veterinary pathology

If you wish to apply for more than one position, please apply for each position separately. Please read more down below in “How to apply”.

1. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Clinical veterinary science – livestock
We are seeking a candidate with a clinical background in veterinary science within production animals - Livestock.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is to:
  • Perform clinical veterinary science within production animals, with emphasis on individual or group-level animal diagnostics, clinical decision-making, and evidence-based treatment and prevention strategies.
  • Research in major production diseases in cattle and/or pigs of significant importance in Europe, including development of clinically applicable knowledge and tools supporting veterinary decision-making in practice.
  • Integrate clinical findings with herd-level data to improve disease prevention and health management in modern production systems.



Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of teaching in clinical veterinary science for production animals, with emphasis on case-based and hands-on learning.
  • Provide academic leadership within the clinical production animal field, including mentoring and coordination of junior teaching staff (e.g., assistant lecturers/teaching assistants).
  • Contribute to strengthening collaboration with the veterinary profession and industry stakeholders in Denmark.


Your profile
The preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary clinical science related to pig or cattle production
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it
  • Preferably experiences within obstetrics



2. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Public Health
We are seeking a candidate with strong expertise in veterinary public health, including popu-lation-level animal health, food safety/meat inspection, and the role of veterinarians in society.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is to:

  • Conduct research within veterinary public health, including epidemiology, zoonoses, food safety/meat inspection, disease dynamics, risk assessment or animal welfare.
  • Contribute to interdisciplinary One Health research integrating animal, human and environmental health on population level.
  • Support evidence-based policy and advisory work for authorities.
  • Participate in externally funded research projects.


Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Develop and deliver teaching in Veterinary Public Health for example to apply case-based and problem-oriented teaching methods with focus on real-world scenarios in veterinary services.
  • Do research within monitoring of animal welfare issues across the EU.
  • Contribute to teaching across the veterinary curriculum where public health perspectives are relevant.


Your profile
The preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary public health preferably with an interdisciplinary research profile integrating biological, social and economic aspects in projects
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it. Experience with Danish conditions is an advantage.
  • Preferably, experience with antimicrobial use at the population level.


3. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Pathology

We are seeking a candidate with a broad background in veterinary pathology, encompassing both gross and histopathological examinations for diagnostic purposes with a strong interest in developing and innovating teaching within veterinary pathology.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is:
  • General and comparative veterinary pathology, including the mechanisms, diagnosis, and characterization of disease processes across animal species.
  • Diagnostic pathology, encompassing post-mortem investigations, histopathology, and the integration of pathological findings into veterinary practice and meat inspection.
  • Pathological assessment of animal welfare aspects of mortality in livestock


Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Teach and supervise students and early-career researchers at bachelor, master, and PhD levels.
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the collection and curation of pathological specimens for teaching purposes and reporting of findings to referring veterinarians and animal owners.
  • Contribute to the continued development of the department's digital histopathology teaching platform, TUTOR.
  • Support in the administration and further development of the department's animal donor programme for anatomy and pathology.

Your profile
The preferred candidate should have experience with:
  • Post-mortem examinations, including diagnostic necropsies, case reporting, and communication of findings.
  • Diagnostic histopathology.


Your profle as Tenure Track assistant professor
You are a skilled researcher with a solid background within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • Documented research qualifications at a high international level
  • Teaching and supervision experience
  • Qualifications for the Tenure-Track assistant professor level at Aarhus University must include postdoctoral training or similar with a relevant research profile and a strong scientific publication record in one or more of the areas of the position you are applying for.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Your profile as Associate professor
You are established as a prominent researcher within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • The ability to carry out independent and well-organized research work, as well as work as part of an interdisciplinary team.
  • Documented teaching qualifications at a high international level.
  • Experience with project management

In order to be assessed as qualified as associate professor, you must meet the academic criteria as outlined here

How to apply
  • You must indicate the specific position you are applying for by selecting it in the menu. You may only select one position. If you wish to apply for one of the other positions, you must submit a separate application for each position.
  • Please also indicate in your written application which position you are applying for.
  • Furthermore, please indicate whether you are applying for a tenure-track assistant professor position, an associate professor position, or both by ticking the box. .

Who we are
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with a high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to address essential societal challenges within the green transition; the food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, the environment, climate, and the health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for our research-based public authority consultancy and degree programmes covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programmes within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated with the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies located close to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and strong industrial and professional collaborations.

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities.
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities.
  • A workplace characterised by equality and a good work-life balance, and open discussions across different fields of research.


Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.

Area of employment and place of work
The area of employment is Aarhus University (AU), with related departments The place of work is AU Viborg, Research Centre Foulum, Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele.
AU Viborg is approximately 10 km from Viborg. You can read more about it here: https://international.viborg.dk/

Contact
For further information, please contact Deputy head of department, Professor Henrik Callesen (henrik.callesen@anivet.au.dk)
or Head of department, Professor Charlotte Lauridsen (charlotte.lauridsen@anivet.au.dk)





Technical Sciences Tenure Track
Aarhus University offers talented scientists from around the world attractive career perspectives via the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme. Highly qualified candidates are appointed as Assistant Professors for a period of six years with the prospect of performance- based advancement to a tenured Associate Professorship.

The aim of the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme is to:
  • attract outstanding talented individuals that are competitive at an international level
  • to promote the early development of independent research success early in the career of scientists
  • to create transparency in the academic career path

As part of the tenure track position, the candidate is offered:
  • access to research infrastructure
  • capability development, including postgraduate teacher training
  • a mentoring programme
  • support to develop scientific networks and to secure interdisciplinary research at the highest level

As part of the Aarhus University Tenure Track Programme, the University carries out a mid-way evaluation to review the progress of the tenure track candidate after three years, according to the same criteria used in the final tenure review. The final tenure review is conducted after five and a half years. If the review is positive, the candidate will be offered a tenured position as Associate Professor at Aarhus University.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you want to build modern software for critical logistics and transportation processes, and follow the customer all the way from need to result?

At IMI, we deliver SaaS-based solutions that support warehousing, transportation management, delivery visibility, and checkout experiences, used every day by leading retailers and logistics providers.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who understands the customer’s world, can turn needs into precise requirements, and takes responsibility for what ships. You will work the way modern teams do, with AI as a natural part of how software gets built.

About the Role

You will be a natural part of the customer’s whole journey, from onboarding new customers to supporting and maintaining existing ones. Most of your time will be spent designing, developing, and improving our products and integrations, while also supporting customers and colleagues when technical expertise is needed.

Unlike a traditional in-house development role, you will work directly with customers, particularly within integrations and technical onboarding in real-world logistics operations. You will work on new functionality, integrations, technical improvements, troubleshooting, and the continuous development of our solutions, in a cross-functional team with software engineers, architects, business consultants, and project managers.

You will work with modern SaaS platforms, cloud-native services, distributed integrations, and business-critical systems that process large volumes of transactions every day. Our solutions are built on technologies including .NET, C#, SQL, TypeScript, Azure, and modern web frameworks, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, maintainability, and continuous delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

    Translate customer and business needs into clear, testable specifications
    Design and develop new functionality and integrations between customer systems and our solutions, using AI tools and agents as part of your daily work, and own the quality of the result
    Develop and maintain business-critical software solutions, and troubleshoot issues in production together with customers and colleagues
    Assess business value, risk, and impact before and after changes
    Take part in customer onboarding, support, and maintenance as a technical specialist
    Contribute to product improvements, roadmap initiatives, and technical enhancements

Your Profile

We believe you enjoy combining software development with a customer-focused mindset. You are curious, collaborative, and motivated by solving technical challenges. You take ownership of your work, are comfortable working independently, and are proactive in improving products, processes, and ways of working.

You can turn what you learn from customers into requirements that you or others can build and test against, and you balance business value, risk, and effort with long-term sustainability. You know what good looks like, and you can tell when code is not it, including code you did not write yourself. You are not afraid to ask for help when needed and appreciate knowledge sharing within a team environment.

We Believe You Have:

    A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
    Strong ability to translate business needs into clear, actionable technical requirements
    The ability to read, understand, and judge code, particularly in our stack (.NET, C#, SQL, TypeScript), including code you did not write yourself
    Practical experience developing with AI tools and agents, and a good sense of where they help and where they fail
    Several years of professional software development experience, including making independent technical decisions regarding architecture, quality, and risk
    The ability to get up to speed quickly in a complex domain
    Experience with integration development and customer-facing technical roles within a service-oriented organization
    Experience with cloud platforms and modern architectural patterns
    Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English

Preferred Qualifications:

    Experience with supply chain, logistics, transportation management, or warehouse management solutions
    Experience from a software product company
    Experience with Vue.js and Azure DevOps

The position is primarily based in Linköping and offers a hybrid working model.

Why IMI?

IMI Supply Chain Solutions is a leading software provider specializing in sustainable logistics and order management. Our solutions are at the core of critical industries such as grocery retail and pharmaceutical supply chains. We are in an exciting phase of growth, offering you the opportunity to influence both our products and the way we work with product development going forward.

We are proud to be Great Place To Work certified and offer a workplace with a strong sense of team spirit, a high degree of autonomy, and excellent opportunities for professional development. In addition, we provide a generous benefits package, including extra vacation days, a wellness allowance, and occupational pension contributions.

Application

Is this the right role for you? We warmly welcome your application. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. If you have any questions about the position, please contact our HR Business Partner, Ebba Olofsson, at ebba.olofsson@im.se
