jobs.description:
Get to know Climeworks
Climeworks is a leading high-quality carbon removal provider, combining decades of expertise in Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology with a holistic approach to carbon removal solutions.

Climeworks advises companies on their carbon removal strategies and provides tailored portfolios of nature-based and engineered approaches, offering end-to-end services to help achieve net-zero goals. The company runs the world's first two DAC plants in Iceland, demonstrating its core commitment to high-quality carbon removal that is backed by over 15 years of pioneering research, development, and deployment.

By advancing the most reliable solutions in the market, Climeworks accelerates the global transition to net zero, unlocking economic value for businesses, governments, and society.

We foster a dynamic environment and are building a global purpose driven team. We are looking for disruptive thinkers, passionate achievers and inspiring leaders that are ready to take on the world’s greatest challenge.

Will you join us?

Your mission
Job description
Technical Direction: You define and maintain the technical direction for the Electrical Department.  You lead the development of fit-for-purpose EIC specifications, design philosophies, and basis of design for execution Globally. You ensure owner requirements are clearly defined, documented, and communicated to contractors, and validate design assumptions against operability and safety, and ensure compliance with local and regional codes and regulations.

Contractor management: You review and approve contractor submissions for electrical systems and power distribution, enforce owner requirements, provide technical clarifications, and ensure adherence to schedule, quality, safety, and operability. You set clear expectations for execution methods, field quality controls, and turnover documentation needed for safe operation and maintenance.

System Reliability & Innovation: You lead initiatives to improve reliability and performance of Electrical systems, troubleshoot issues, and implement preventive measures. You evaluate and introduce emerging technologies such as energy efficiency solutions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: You act as the primary Electrical interface with process, instrumentation and controls, mechanical, and project management teams to ensure integrated designs. You identify and mitigate Electrical risks during design and operation phases and support project teams with scope, cost, and schedule estimates.

Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement: You supervise and coach junior team members, provide guidance on technical challenges, and drive lessons-learned sessions to maintain a strong knowledge base and promote continuous improvement.  You maintain thorough records of technical decisions, design bases, vendor information, and lessons learned for future operational use.

Cold-Weather and Constructability: As our next DAC plant could be in a cold or hot weather environment, you incorporate climate conditions into the Electrical design and execution planning (extreme heat, freeze protection, winterization, insulation/heat tracing philosophy, cold start/commissioning constraints). You ensure the design is constructable and able to operate and be maintained through cold or hot conditions, including consideration of temporary works, for instance winter work sequencing, and interface constraints with cold-weather activities.

Your story
Requirements
Professional Experience: You have a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent and have at least 10 years of experience in process plants various climates as an Electrical Engineer.  You have experience leading teams.

Project Experience: You have hands-on involvement in at least one full-cycle project in the mining, water treatment, oil and gas or other comparable industries, covering all phases from FEED and detailed design to construction, commissioning and start-up; preferably in remote/seasonally constrained execution environments.  You have expertise in low and medium voltage electrical systems, industrial instrumentation, and control systems.

Cold-Weather Industrial Plant Experience: You have hands-on experience working with industrial plants in cold-weather environments (e.g. Canada, Nordic countries, or similar climates) and understand the operational, maintenance, and safety challenges associated with extreme weather conditions.

Communication & Collaboration: You demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills and can liaise with diverse stakeholders, including third-party vendors in IP-sensitive collaborations.

Working Style: You are precise, adaptable, and reliable, with a proactive and solution-oriented approach. You are comfortable driving decisions and owning them in the office and under field constraints, including winter productivity and schedule risk.  You are highly organized, able to plan and prioritize work for yourself and others, and comfortable working in fast-paced environments.

Language Skills and Travel: You are fluent in English and ready to travel up to 40% of your time (including extended site presence during peak design, engineering, construction and commissioning periods).

Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together.

What we offer:

Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays.

Flexibility: Work how it suits you best. We offer a hybrid work setup and up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country.

Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter.

Family Support: Inclusive parental leave.

Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth.

Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals.

Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Individual compensation depends on your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the team.

Formalities:

This position is based in Opfikon, Zurich, and we ask that you work onsite at least three days per week.

We do not accept candidate profiles through recruitment agencies.

jobs.title: Klinikassistent søges til deltidsvikariat i Viby J – hurtig opstart
jobs.description:
På vegne af en af vores kunder i Viby J søger FIRMAVIKAR en dygtig og mødestabil klinikassistent til et deltidsvikariat på 1–2 måneder med opstart hurtigst muligt.

Du bliver en del af den daglige drift på en tandklinik, hvor du skal hjælpe med forskellige kliniske og praktiske opgaver.

Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være uddannet klinikassistent, men det er vigtigt, at du har erfaring fra en tandklinik og er vant til at arbejde i et klinikmiljø.

Om jobbet

Du vil indgå i et team på en tandklinik, hvor du hjælper med at sikre, at hverdagen fungerer godt for både tandlæger, kolleger og patienter.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Assistere tandlægen ved behandlinger

  • Klargøring og oprydning af behandlingsrum

  • Rengøring og sterilisering af instrumenter

  • Håndtering af klinikudstyr og materialer

  • Øvrige praktiske opgaver på klinikken efter behov

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra en tandklinik

  • Gerne er uddannet klinikassistent.

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og serviceminded

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Er fleksibel og trives i en travl hverdag

Arbejdstid og ansættelse

  • Arbejdssted: 8260 Viby J

  • Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

  • Arbejdsdage: Tirsdag, torsdag og fredag

  • Arbejdstid: Kl. 07.45–13.00

  • Ansættelse: Midlertidigt deltidsvikariat

  • Varighed: 1–2 måneder med mulighed for forlængelse

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et spændende vikariat på en tandklinik

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige kolleger

  • Faste arbejdsdage og arbejdstider

  • Mulighed for forlængelse af vikariatet

Interesseret?

Hvis du har erfaring fra en tandklinik og har mulighed for at starte hurtigt, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Advance Your Career as a Consultant Pathologist in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Are you a specialist in pathology looking for a role where you can combine advanced diagnostics with a balanced lifestyle?

We are currently seeking specialist surgical pathologists to join a modern and accredited department in central Sweden, located in a region known for its coastal setting, rich history, and strong connection to nature.

About the Department

The surgical pathology and cytology unit plays a central role in diagnostics by analyzing tissue and cell samples using both microscopy and advanced digital systems. The goal is to provide accurate and timely diagnostic support to clinicians, improving patient outcomes and safety.

The department is part of a larger organization within laboratory medicine and is at the forefront of digital pathology, with ongoing development in automation, robotics, and AI-driven diagnostics.

In addition to histopathology and cytology, the unit is also responsible for:

Gynecological screening programs

Autopsy services and morgue operations

Multidisciplinary clinical conferences

You will work in a collaborative and well-structured environment with experienced colleagues across multiple disciplines.

As a specialist surgical pathologist, your work will include:

    Diagnostic work in histopathology and cytology
    Gross examination and specimen handling
    Participation in clinical conferences and interdisciplinary discussions
    Autopsy
    Supervising and mentoring residents

Daytime on-call service for urgent diagnostic cases is shared within the team.

Qualifications

    EU-recognized specialist certification in pathology
    Experience in surgical pathology
    Strong communication skills in English and a willingness to learn Swedish
    Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-based environment
    A structured, collaborative, and flexible approach

Why work here?

This opportunity is located in a coastal region of central Sweden, offering a unique mix of professional development and quality of life. The area is known for:

Easy access to the sea, forests, and outdoor activities year-round

A rich industrial and cultural heritage

A safe and family-friendly environment

Good infrastructure with connections to larger cities

The working environment is modern, forward-thinking, and continuously evolving, providing excellent conditions for both professional growth and long-term career development.

What Dignus Medical offers you:

Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment

Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals

Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed

Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Take the next step in your career

This is an excellent opportunity for surgical pathologists who want to work in a progressive environment while enjoying a high quality of life.

Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Career?

Don’t hesitate to contact me. I look forward to hearing from you and helping you find the perfect job that matches your experience and ambitions.

Apply now!

jobs.title: RE-ADVERTISEMENT - Senior Team Leader for Research Support at the SDU eScience Center for National Research Infrastructure
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Team Leader to lead the Research Support team at the SDU eScience Center. The team plays a central role in helping researchers, research groups, and institutions across Denmark leverage advanced computing, cloud, AI, and data services to accelerate scientific discovery and innovation.

As Senior Team Leader, you will combine scientific insight, technical understanding, and leadership skills to guide a highly skilled team of research support specialists. Working closely with researchers across all disciplines, you will help shape how next-generation digital infrastructure is adopted and utilized within Danish research.

The position offers a unique opportunity to influence both the strategic development of national research services and the day-to-day support provided to tens of thousands of researchers using the center's infrastructure and platforms.

We are looking for a collaborative and forward-looking team leader who is passionate about enabling excellent research through advanced digital technologies. The ideal candidate combines scientific and technical credibility with strong leadership skills and enjoys working at the intersection of research, technology, and service development.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Research Support team, including strategic planning, prioritization, and staff development as part of the management group for the eScience center.

  • Ensure high-quality support and consultancy services for researchers and customers from the public and private sector using the center's computing, cloud, AI, and data platforms.

  • Build strong relationships with researchers, departments, external customers, and research infrastructures across SDU and nationally.

  • Identify emerging research and customers’ needs and contribute to the development of new services, tools, and support initiatives.

  • Collaborate with the center's technical teams to ensure that infrastructure and services align with user requirements and scientific developments.

Required qualifications

  • Relevant university degree at Master's level or higher in computer science, engineering, natural sciences, data science, computational science, or a related discipline.

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, including responsibility for teams, projects, or complex research initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of computational research, scientific computing, data-intensive research, AI, or digital research infrastructure.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in both Danish and English.

  • The ability to engage effectively with researchers, technical specialists, customers from the private and public sector.

  • Proven ability to translate scientific and customers’ needs into practical solutions and service developments.

Desired qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience from a university, research organization, national research infrastructure, or technology-oriented organization, including experience leading projects, teams, or research support activities. 

  • Familiarity with high-performance computing, cloud computing, AI platforms, research data management, or research software engineering.

  • Experience developing research support services, training activities, or scientific user communities.

  • Knowledge of the Danish or European research infrastructure landscape.

While the positions offer flexibility and the possibility of remote work, the candidate is expected to be on-site in Odense.

About the SDU eScience Center

The SDU eScience Center is a national center for advanced digital research infrastructure at the University of Southern Denmark. The center develops, operates, and continuously advances large-scale computing, cloud, data, and AI services that support research across all scientific disciplines.

As Denmark's leading provider of research cyberinfrastructure, the center plays a central role in the national ecosystem for research computing and digital services. Through close collaborations with Danish universities, public institutions, and international partners, the center helps researchers access the computational resources and digital platforms needed to address some of society's most complex scientific and technological challenges.

The center is the primary developer and operator of UCloud, Denmark's national research cloud, which provides researchers with seamless access to advanced computing resources, AI and machine learning environments, data-intensive workflows, and scientific applications. Today, the platform serves tens of thousands of users across the Danish research community and forms a key component of the national e-infrastructure landscape.

At the SDU eScience Center, we combine the mindset of a research environment with the professionalism of a modern technology organization. Our teams work at the intersection of cloud computing, high-performance computing, AI infrastructure, data management, software engineering, and digital platform development. We actively contribute to open-source technologies and collaborate closely with researchers to transform emerging technologies into robust services with national impact.

At our center, you will be joining a highly collaborative community where brilliant minds—from IT professionals and data specialists to world-class researchers—converge to drive research innovation. We don’t just maintain servers; we build the foundational digital platforms that empower researchers, students and innovators to solve global challenges. 

Condition of Employment

The starting date for the job is as soon as possible, and it will be agreed with the successful candidate. The appointment is for a full-time permanent position.

All inquiries are welcome. Please contact:

Prof. Director Claudio Pica

SDU eScience center

Dept. of Mathematics and Computer Science

University of Southern Denmark

email: pica@cp3.sdu.dk

Application deadline 28 October 2026.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. jobs.title: Utleieansvarlig i Bergen
jobs.description:
Utleieansvarlig søkes! Vi leter etter noen som kan ta seg av visninger og overtakelser for våre hus og leiligheter i Bergen. Jobben er deltid, selvstendig og fleksibel.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter en person som:

  • Er trygg, rolig og profesjonell i møte med folk

  • Er selvstendig og strukturert

  • Har god dømmekraft og evne til å se hvem som passer i et leieforhold

  • Er nøye med detaljer, spesielt ved utflytting og dokumentasjon

  • Har en positiv og løsningsorientert holdning

  • Er over 18 år, har førerkort, pc og egen bil

Arbeidsoppgaver

Det er en fleksibel og spennede jobb der man møter mange forskjellige mennesker som skal få seg et sted å bo. Jobben består i å legge ut annonser og ta i mot henvendelser på disse, holde visninger for interessenter og ordne med overtakelser (ikke utvask). Leietakerne er studenter, familier og andre. Du kan avtale tidspunkter som passer din egen timeplan, men noe arbeid på ettermiddag, kveld og helg må påregnes. Det er gjerne 30-50 timer pr måned, men det kan variere. I høysesongen fra april til august er det gjerne 40-60 timer pr måned.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr:

  • En selvstendig deltidsrolle med god mulighet til å styre egen tid

  • Forutsigbare og tydelige arbeidsoppgaver knyttet til utleieprosessen

  • God opplæring og støtte slik at du blir trygg i rollen

  • Et hyggelig, profesjonelt og løsningsorientert samarbeid

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Om Tufte Bygg

Tufte Bygg er et familieeid selskap med fire ansatte, basert i Bergen. Gjennom en konsernstruktur driver vi med utleie av leiligheter, hus og næringseiendom i Bergen sentrum og omegn. Selskapet har vokst jevnt gjennom mange år, og vi legger stor vekt på kvalitet, ryddighet og gode relasjoner - både til leietakere og samarbeidspartnere.

Som familiebedrift er vi opptatt av tillit, langsiktighet og personlig oppfølging, og vi jobber hver dag for å sikre trygge og profesjonelle leieforhold i alle våre eiendommer.

Som entrepriseleder får du ansvaret for vores egenproduktion på en række spændende byggeprojekter. Du sikrer fremdrift, kvalitet, økonomi og sikkerhed og bliver en vigtig del af samarbejdet mellem byggeplads, projektledelse, bygherre og rådgivere.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

• Ledelse af tømrerentrepriser med ansvar for den daglige drift og planlægning.

• Koordinering af medarbejdere og interne ressourcer på byggepladsen.

• Opfølgning på tidsplaner, kvalitet og økonomi.

• Planlægning af materialeleverancer og logistik.

• Kvalitetssikring med støtte fra EMR’s interne KS-afdeling herunder DS1140.

• Ansvar for sikkerheden på pladsen med støtte fra EMR’s arbejdsmiljøorganisation.

• Bidrage til et godt og tillidsfuldt samarbejde med bygherre, rådgivere, underentreprenører og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

Vores ønsker og forventninger til dig:

Stillingen kan tilgås fra flere faglige baggrunde. Vi ser gerne, at du har en baggrund som tømrer, suppleret med en uddannelse som bygningskonstruktør, byggetekniker eller lignende. Det vigtigste er dog din erfaring med styring af tømrerentrepriser, dit engagement og dine samarbejdsevner.

Som person er du:

• Tydelig, involverende og god til at skabe tillid.

• Målrettet, resultatorienteret og vedholdende.

• Motiverende, positiv og samarbejdsvillig.

• Ordholdende, loyal og løsningsorienteret.

• I stand til at læse og forstå tegninger og projektmateriale.

• Engageret i dine kolleger og de sjak, du har ansvaret for.

• Opmærksom på sikkerhed og arbejdsmiljø.

• En dygtig kommunikator med en tydelig, saglig og tillidsskabende kommunikationsstil.

Arbejdsområde:

EMR udfører projekter i hele Danmark i både fag-, hoved- og totalentrepriser. Du vil derfor indgå som en del af byggeledelsen på EMR’s egne projekter med ansvar for tømrerentreprisen, ligesom du vil stå i spidsen for selvstændige fagentrepriser for eksterne bygherrer og samarbejdspartnere.

Entreprisernes størrelse og kompleksitet spænder typisk fra 5 til 80 mio. kr., hvilket giver mulighed for både faglige og ledelsesmæssige udfordringer samt en alsidig hverdag.

jobs.title: Entrepriseleder Beton
jobs.description:
Hos EMR Murer & Entreprenør A/S søger vi en erfaren entrepriseleder til styring af byggeprojekter med egenproduktion inden for betonarbejde.

Ansvar og arbejdsområder:

Som entrepriseleder får du ansvaret for vores egenproduktion på en række spændende byggeprojekter. Du sikrer fremdrift, kvalitet, økonomi og sikkerhed og bliver en vigtig del af samarbejdet mellem byggeplads, projektledelse, bygherre og rådgivere.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

• Ledelse af betonentrepriser med ansvar for den daglige drift og planlægning.

• Koordinering af medarbejdere og interne ressourcer på byggepladsen.

• Opfølgning på tidsplaner, kvalitet og økonomi.

• Planlægning af materialeleverancer og logistik.

• Kvalitetssikring med støtte fra EMR’s interne KS-afdeling herunder DS1140.

• Ansvar for sikkerheden på pladsen med støtte fra EMR’s arbejdsmiljøorganisation.

• Bidrage til et godt og tillidsfuldt samarbejde med bygherre, rådgivere, underentreprenører og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

Vores ønsker og forventninger til dig:

Stillingen kan tilgås fra flere faglige baggrunde. Vi ser gerne, at du har en baggrund som håndværker, suppleret med en uddannelse som bygningskonstruktør, byggetekniker eller lignende. Det vigtigste er dog din erfaring med styring af betonerentrepriser, dit engagement og dine samarbejdsevner.

Som person er du:

• Tydelig, involverende og god til at skabe tillid.

• Målrettet, resultatorienteret og vedholdende.

• Motiverende, positiv og samarbejdsvillig.

• Ordholdende, loyal og løsningsorienteret.

• I stand til at læse og forstå tegninger og projektmateriale.

• Engageret i dine kolleger og de sjak, du har ansvaret for.

• Opmærksom på sikkerhed og arbejdsmiljø.

• En dygtig kommunikator med en tydelig, saglig og tillidsskabende kommunikationsstil.

Arbejdsområde:

EMR udfører projekter i hele Danmark i både fag-, hoved- og totalentrepriser. Du vil derfor indgå som en del af byggeledelsen på EMR’s egne projekter med ansvar for betonentreprisen, ligesom du vil stå i spidsen for selvstændige fagentrepriser for eksterne bygherrer og samarbejdspartnere.

Entreprisernes størrelse og kompleksitet spænder typisk fra 5 til 80 mio. kr., hvilket giver mulighed for både faglige og ledelsesmæssige udfordringer samt en alsidig hverdag.

Vil du vide mere:

Er du interesseret, så send dit CV og et par ord om dig selv. Din ansøgning behandles naturligvis fortroligt. Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende og ønsker tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt, men venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Vil du høre mere om jobbet, eller har du spørgsmål, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Morten Søby - T: 40 62 07 88 - ms@emr-as.dk

jobs.title: Rewarding Nursing Opportunities in Northern Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Would you like to take the next step in your nursing career in northern Sweden?

This is an opportunity to work in a modern healthcare system where quality of care, teamwork, and professional development are a priority. You will become part of a supportive environment with experienced colleagues and a strong focus on patient-centered care.

About the role

As a general nurse, you will play an important role in delivering high-quality, patient-centered care in different healthcare settings, including:

    Hospitals, where you will be part of experienced teams working with both acute and planned care
    Health centres and outpatient clinics, focusing on continuity of care and long-term patient relationships

Your responsibilities will include administering treatments, supporting patients throughout their recovery, and contributing to individual care planning.

You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams, helping to ensure safe and effective care while contributing to continuous improvement of patient outcomes.

Requirements

    Valid nursing license from Finland (Registered nurse)
    Experience in hospital care
    Good English language skills
    Motivation to learn Swedish

Meritorious

    Knowledge of Swedish
    Swedish nursing license

Why northern Sweden?

This opportunity is based in a peaceful region in northern Sweden, surrounded by nature, forests, and open landscapes, ideal for those seeking a calm and balanced lifestyle. The area offers excellent public services, short commuting times, and a strong sense of community.

You will have access to outdoor activities year-round, including hiking, skiing, and other nature-based experiences. The high quality of life makes it an excellent place to live and work long-term.

What Dignus Medical offers you:

    Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
    Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and approvals
    Help with accommodation and relocation for you and your family
    Access to a free Swedish language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Curious about life in the North?

Let’s talk. We’re happy to tell you more about the region, the roles, and how we support you every step of the way.

Are you ready to take the next step in your nursing career and experience working in Sweden?

We look forward to hearing from you.

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.title: Industrail Engineer
jobs.description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.

Role Summary

As an Industrial Engineer, you will play a key role in a smaller production unit where your work has a direct impact on our business. With short decision-making paths, your ideas can quickly become tangible improvements.

You will be an important part of our production engineering development, with the opportunity to take ideas and analyses all the way through to implemented solutions that make a measurable difference. The role offers a high degree of ownership and the opportunity to influence our technology, ways of working and business results. You will work closely with production, maintenance and external suppliers, playing a central role in ensuring robust, efficient and future-proof technical solutions.

We welcome candidates with diverse backgrounds and levels of experience—whether you are at the beginning of your career or bring several years of industry experience.

Job Responsibilities

As a Industrial Engineer, you will be an important part of the bigger picture working closely with our assembly operations. You will provide technical support and help resolve day-to-day production-related questions and challenges as well as responsibility for the procurement and replacement of equipment.

Your responsibilities include:

    Solving problems cross-functionally together with relevant stakeholders, including production, quality, logistics, maintenance, engineering and IT
    Procuring and installing new equipment, as well as modifying existing equipment
    Challenging and adapting production processes to support the introduction of new or modified products
    Leading and delivering improvement projects related to our production processes
    Identifying opportunities for improvement, supporting the justification of new investments and contributing to continuous development
    Providing technical support to production in daily operations

Who You Are

We believe you are someone who enjoys working in a structured production environment, gains energy from cross-functional collaboration and is motivated by achieving results.

You likely have:

    A university degree in engineering or equivalent experience, preferably within industrial, mechanical or electrical engineering
    A strong technical interest; experience in production engineering is an advantage
    Experience leading or contributing to projects
    An interest in IT-related solutions
    Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing

To succeed in this role, you:

    Are solution-oriented and enjoy taking on technical challenges
    Show drive, initiative and a genuine desire to make a difference
    Thrive in a cross-functional environment and build strong working relationships
    Take ownership and deliver high-quality results
    Work in a structured and analytical way, with a focus on continuous improvement
    Communicate clearly and contribute to a positive and collaborative culture

Scania Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

Your application should include a CV and any relevant certificates. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-24. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Administration- och marknadsföringsansvarig
jobs.description:
RE Motors söker en Administration- och marknadsföringsansvarig för fast anställning!

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**

- Ansvara för utveckling och underhåll av företagets webbshop samt hantera beställningar och kundkommunikation, främst via e-post.

- Planera, skapa och publicera innehåll för sociala medier, hemsidan och andra digitala kanaler.

- Planera och genomföra marknadsföringskampanjer, nyhetsbrev, provkörningsevenemang.

- Sköta administrativa uppgifter såsom uppdatering av prislistor och produktinformation etc.

- Bistå vid försäljning av utrustning och tillbehör.


**Kvalifikationer och personliga egenskaper**

Vi söker en självständig, strukturerad och ansvarstagande person som tar egna initiativ och kan planera och prioritera sitt arbete. Du trivs med varierande arbetsuppgifter och har förmåga att självständigt organisera dina arbetsdagar.

**Vi ser gärna att du:**

- Har relevant utbildning inom företagsekonomi, marknadsföring eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.

- Har goda kunskaper i Microsoft 365, särskilt Excel.

- Behärskar svenska, finska och engelska i både tal och skrift.

- Har god datorvana och förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya system och arbetsprocesser.

- Kan arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter.

- Har erfarenhet av Google Ads och Meta Ads Manager (meriterande).

- Ifall du inte uppfyller alla kraven är det inte ett hinder, vi skolar upp dig.

- Viktigast är en stark arbetsmoral och en vilja att lära sig.


**Vi erbjuder**

- En heltidsanställning med varierande och ansvarsfulla arbetsuppgifter.

- Möjlighet att påverka och vidareutveckla företagets e-handel, marknadsföring och administrativa processer.

- Ett självständigt arbete med goda möjligheter till professionell utveckling.

- En engagerad arbetsgemenskap i ett etablerat företag inom motorbranschen.


Skicka eventuella frågor till: **axel@remotors.fi**

Är du intresserad? Skicka in fritt formulerad ansökan till **info@remotors.fi** senast 21.10.2026

Vi börjar intervjua omedelbart och anställer så fort vi har hittat rätt kandidat.

jobs.title: Family medicine specialist in border region of Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Are you a specialist in family medicine looking for a workplace with a supportive atmosphere, skilled colleagues and close access to beautiful nature?

This role offers the chance to work in a primary care centre located in a border region between Sweden and Norway, with short travel distance to Oslo and good connections to other parts of the country.

About the role

As a family medicine specialist, you will be part of a multidisciplinary team where all professional competences are valued. The centre provides care throughout life, from assessment and diagnostics to treatment, follow-up, and rehabilitation.

Primary care here is rapidly developing with a strong focus on accessibility, digital solutions, and close collaboration with patients. The work environment is characterized by teamwork, engagement, and patient focus.

We offer

    Mentorship or professional guidance from experienced colleagues.
    Regular opportunities for continuous professional development.
    A workplace that promotes health and offers wellness benefits.
    Support with practical matters in case of relocation, such as housing, schools, and integration.

Requirements

    Medical license and specialist certification in family medicine/general practice from an EU/EEA country
    Eligibility for recognition by the Swedish National Board of Health and Welfare (Socialstyrelsen).
    Good English skills and willingness to learn Swedish to B2/C1 level (language training provided).

Terms

    Full-time, permanent position.
    Start date by agreement.

Location

The area is known for its stunning natural surroundings with forests, lakes, and rich wildlife – perfect for those who appreciate outdoor life and a good work-life balance. You will also have easy access to cultural activities, sports and international cities.

What Dignus Medical offers you

    Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
    Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and approvals
    Help with accommodation and relocation for you and your family
    Access to a free Swedish language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Please note: Recognition from the Swedish National Board of Health and Welfare (Socialstyrelsen) is required to work independently as a specialist in Sweden. Full support will be provided during this process.

Are you ready to enjoy a fulfilling career and a truly balanced lifestyle in Sweden? Apply today, we look forward to hearing from you!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.title: Build Your Future in Internal Medicine in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Are you a specialist in internal medicine with broad clinical competence looking for a long-term hospital position in Sweden?

Dignus Medical is recruiting internal medicine specialists for permanent roles in hospital settings where internal medicine has a central clinical function.

You will work broadly within internal medicine, covering inpatient and outpatient care and managing complex medical conditions across multiple organ systems.

The work is multidisciplinary, with close collaboration alongside colleagues in geriatrics, cardiology, surgery, and other specialties.

Location and lifestyle

The hospital is located in a scenic part of Sweden known for its forests, lakes, and access to outdoor life throughout the year. The area offers a calm living environment with short commuting distances and easy access to nature, while still providing essential services, schools, and leisure activities.

This setting is well suited for physicians relocating on their own or together with family. Housing is accessible, daily life is structured and predictable, and there are good

opportunities to combine professional work with time for family, outdoor activities, and personal interests.

What Dignus Medical Offers You:

    Ongoing support from a dedicated recruiter before, during, and after your employment.
    Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required.
    Help with accommodation and travel arrangements, including support for your family, if necessary.
    Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype.

Qualifications:

    EU-recognized specialist certification in internal medicine
    Broad clinical experience within internal medicine
    Good communication skills in English
    Willingness to learn Swedish

Why Choose Dignus Medical?

We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.

Interested in a career in Sweden?

Let’s talk! Contact us today to learn more about current openings or submit your application. We look forward to helping you take the next step in your internal medicine career.

jobs.title: Exciting Radiologist Position in the Heart of Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Are you a board-certified radiologist looking for a new challenge in a beautiful part of Sweden?

This position combines professional development with a high quality of life in a scenic region known for its lakes, forests and outdoor lifestyle.

About the hospital and department

The radiology department is part of the Diagnostic Imaging and Functional Medicine division and performs around 24,000 examinations annually. The unit is equipped with two ultrasound machines, one MRI, one CT scanner and two conventional X-ray systems (one with fluoroscopy). Both acute and planned diagnostic services are provided in modern facilities with continuously updated technology.

You will join a skilled and stable team of radiologists, radiographers, nurses and administrative staff. Staff turnover among doctors has been close to zero in recent years. The department is also preparing for a major upgrade of both premises and equipment in the near future.

Tasks and responsibilities

    Broad diagnostic radiology including conventional X-ray, ultrasound and CT.
    Participation in both acute and planned care.
    Collaboration with other clinical specialties.
    On-call duties are possible but not mandatory (primarily organised from a nearby hospital).

Requirements

    Specialist certification in radiology from an EU/EEA country, recognised by EU directive 2005/36/EC.
    Several years of clinical experience preferred, but not mandatory.
    Skills in ultrasound and CT required; fluoroscopy and interventional procedures are a plus.
    Good command of English. Willingness to learn Swedish to minimum B2/C1 level (language training provided).

Personal profile

    Cooperative and a team player, while able to work independently.
    Flexible and adaptable in a changing clinical environment.
    Service-minded and attentive in patient interaction.
    Proactive and quality-focused.

Terms and conditions

    Full-time, Monday–Friday, daytime hours.
    Competitive salary
    Permanent employment in the Swedish public healthcare system.
    Relocation package and intensive Swedish language training included.

Why this location?

The hospital is located in the heart of Hälsingland, a region offering a unique combination of professional challenges and an exceptional quality of life. Here you will find affordable housing, short commutes, and endless opportunities for outdoor activities such as hiking, skiing, and fishing – all within reach of a modern healthcare environment.

Application process

Please send a complete application including:

    CV and cover letter
    Diplomas and specialist certificate
    Employment references
    Information on your availability to start language training and relocation

EU/EEA candidates only. Swedish medical license and specialist recognition from the National Board of Health and Welfare (Socialstyrelsen) are required before independent practice. Support will be provided throughout this process.

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

At Dignus Medical, we specialize in matching experienced specialists in internal medicine with high-quality career opportunities throughout Sweden. Whether you are looking for a smaller hospital setting or a larger multidisciplinary clinic, we tailor the opportunity to your experience, interests, and ambitions.

We are currently seeking EU-certified specialists in internal medicine for permanent roles within hospitals and medical centers across Sweden.

You will be involved in diagnosing and managing a wide spectrum of conditions related to internal organ systems – often working both in inpatient wards and outpatient clinics. Our clients include both regional and university-affiliated hospitals, and many positions offer opportunities to combine general internal medicine with a subspecialty (e.g. cardiology, rheumatology, nephrology, etc.).

What we offer

    Permanent employment with stable and supportive workplaces
    Competitive salaries and favorable working hours
    Structured onboarding, relocation assistance, and integration support
    Personal follow-up and guidance throughout the process
    Free language training with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Requirements

    EU-recognized specialist certification in internal medicine, equivalent to Swedish standards
    Good communication skills in English
    Willingness to learn Swedish – full support provided
    Motivation to develop professionally in a new healthcare system

Why Choose Dignus Medical?

We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.

Interested in a career in Sweden?

Let’s talk! Contact us today to learn more about current openings or submit your application. We look forward to helping you take the next step in your internal medicine career.

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.title: SAP Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Is the feeling of having a meaningful job something you like? Would you like to share your thoughts and knowledge to enable growth and profitability? Do you want tho work with ERP services globally? Then this just might be the right challenge for you as we are looking for new team members to our SAP SAP team.



We have a multi ERP strategy within Epiroc and one of our global managed ERP applications is SAP. Our current SAP installation consist of 4 different SAP ERP solutions that is used by 20 customer centers and 2 productions centers. We have started the cloud journey of upgrade one of our installations for the customer center to the SAP S4HANA. The upgrade will let our business to be able to utilise the latest functionality provided from the SAP application. We are therefore looking for strengthening the team with SAP Solution Architect.



We work in an open and friendly way, where we support each other to ensure we provide the best possible solutions for our users. We complement each other with a broad knowledge, and we make sure to have fun at work. Within Epiroc IT so have we started the transformation to an agile working model.  



Your Mission



As SAP Solution Architect, you will design and govern SAP solutions that align with business strategy while ensuring scalable, future-proof architecture.



You will translate business requirements into SAP functional and technical designs.



Ensure integration across SAP modules and surrounding systems.



Standardization and template based delivery is important factors for the SAP environment.



You should be updated on new technology and functionality that can improve the solution.

Profile description:

Your profileYou have an experience within SAP ERP Solutions.



You have a University Degree or similar knowledge gained through work experience. Experience with leading teams is beneficial.  



You have more than 4 years of experience within an IT area in an international company.



As for your personal skills we are looking for someone who is goal orientated, fast learner and eager to learn along the way.



You are able to adopt new technologies and tools when needed, open-minded to enjoy intellectual sparring and knowledge sharing.



The job requires a lot of collaboration both internally and externally so good interpersonal and communications skills are a prerequisite to be successful in the role.



We also expect you to have good analytical and administration skills. Location and travel



The location is preferable at one of our Epiroc IT hubs, located in Örebro or Stockholm, (Sweden), Prague, (Czech Republic).  



International travel will be part of the role.



Application and contactsIn this recruitment process we review applications continuously and we may close the process before the last application day.







A hybrid workplace



Life at Epiroc can include the possibility for a hybrid workplace. It is a way of working that offers flexibility and participation allowing for a better balance between work and private life, which also promotes well-being.



At the same time, we value in-person collaboration and team connection. Therefore, we expect our employees to be present in the office at least three days per week, with flexibility for remote work during the remaining working days, depending on business needs and role requirements.

jobs.title: Global Talent, People Analytics and Data Management Manager
jobs.description:
Role Summary

The purpose of the role is to lead the global Talent, People Analytics and Data Management agenda within Production, Procurement and Logistics (PPL), ensuring that people, capability and workforce decisions are supported by robust processes, high-quality data and actionable insights.

The role enables sustainable business performance and transformation by strengthening talent and leadership pipelines, supporting succession and development, and transforming people data into insights that guide strategic workforce decisions.

Acting as a key bridge between the PPL business, Group P&C and the global CoE structure, the role ensures that business needs are translated into relevant global processes, data requirements and solutions. The role also drives alignment, governance and continuous improvement across the PPL Process Manager network and supports effective implementation and adoption across countries and business units

Job Responsibilities

    Lead PPL’s global talent and succession agenda, ensuring strong leadership pipelines, talent pools and development planning for critical roles and future capabilities.
    Transform people data into actionable insights, ensure data quality and governance, and support the effective use and development of SAP MySuccess, Power BI and related HR systems.
    Lead and harmonize global P&C processes, translate business needs into scalable solutions, and drive continuous improvement, automation and process effectiveness across PPL.
    Coordinate global implementation.
    Facilitate Process Manager and CoE networks, and provide validated reporting and performance insights to PPL Management.
    Build strong relationships across PPL, Group P&C, CoEs, HRBPs and local organizations, representing business needs and promoting knowledge sharing and data-driven decision-making.

Who You Are

    10+ years of experience in People & Culture, preferably in Talent Management, People Analytics, HR Data Management, Project Management, Process Management, or related areas.
    University degree in HR, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
    Proven track record of working globally across functions in complex matrix organizations, including process and system implementation.
    Experience designing and managing learning & development, performance, and succession processes, including governance, reporting, compliance, and user adoption.
    Strong project management experience delivering global and cross-functional P&C initiatives.
    Experience leading P&C processes and driving automation (e.g., Power Automate) and continuous improvement.
    Strong background in HR systems and people analytics, preferably SAP SuccessFactors/MySuccess and Power BI.
    Experience in talent management, succession planning, leadership development, learning, and strategic workforce planning.
    Excellent stakeholder management skills with senior leaders, CoEs, P&C teams, and business functions.
    Experience in Production, Procurement & Logistics or another global operational environment is an advantage.

This Is Us

You will join Scania’s PPL People & Culture community and work in a cross-functional environment with colleagues and stakeholders across the organisation. The role connects global P&C process development with business needs and people insights, collaborating with process owners, P&C colleagues, managers and data/analytics stakeholders. Together, we develop simple, consistent and value-creating ways of working that support Scania’s people and business priorities.

Scania Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

Your application should include a CV and any relevant certificates. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-23. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:

Jens Åklinder Lagerström, Head of People & Culture Powertrain, jens.aklinder.lagerstrom@scania.com

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Køkkenassistent til Restaurant Nordatlanten
jobs.description:
Køkkenassistent med ambitioner søges

Vil du være med til at forme det moderne nordatlantiske køkken?

Har du passion for gode råvarer, gastronomi og kreativ udvikling? Drømmer du om at arbejde et sted, hvor du ikke bare følger en menu, men faktisk får mulighed for at være med til at skabe den?

Restaurant Nordatlanten søger en køkkenassistent, der har lyst til at blive en del af vores køkken og være med på en spændende rejse, hvor vi udvikler restauranten, vores gastronomi og vores nordatlantiske profil.

Et køkken med plads til dine ideer

Restaurant Nordatlanten ligger på Odense Havn i Nordatlantisk Hus. Vores køkken tager udgangspunkt i Grønland, Island og Færøerne, men fortolket med et moderne, kreativt og gastronomisk blik. Vi arbejder med nordatlantiske råvarer, sæsoner og teknikker og henter samtidig inspiration fra det klassiske franske køkken.

Hos os får du mulighed for at:

  • være med til at udvikle nye retter og menuer

  • arbejde kreativt med nordatlantiske råvarer og smage

  • arbejde med sæsonens råvarer og mere bæredygtige løsninger

  • udvikle dig fagligt og personligt sammen med et engageret team

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • har erfaring i et køkken

  • brænder for gastronomi, gode råvarer og høj kvalitet

  • er nysgerrig og har lyst til at udvikle dig og tænke nyt

  • kan arbejde struktureret og bevare overblikket, når der er travlt

  • har lyst til at udforske nordatlantiske råvarer og smagsuniverser

  • tager ansvar og bidrager aktivt til et godt arbejdsmiljø

  • er en god kollega, der sætter pris på samarbejde og godt humør

  • er fleksibel i forhold til aften- og weekendarbejde

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du har faglig stolthed, nysgerrighed og lyst til at være med til at skabe noget.

  

Mere end bare et køkken

Restaurant Nordatlanten er en del af Nordatlantisk Hus, hvor musik, kultur, udstillinger og events er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Det giver os en anderledes og inspirerende arbejdsplads, hvor der altid sker noget omkring restauranten.

Vi arbejder seriøst med gastronomien, men vi tror også på, at man skal kunne have det godt, mens man gør det.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En spændende arbejdsplads med et kreativt køkken med plads til idéer og initiativ

  • Mulighed for at være med til at forme vores menuer og gastronomiske retning

  • Et stærkt team med fokus på samarbejde og godt arbejdsmiljø

  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring

  • En arbejdsplads med høje ambitioner og plads til at tænke nyt

Har du lyst til at være med?

Hvis du har lyst til at blive en del af Restaurant Nordatlanten og være med til at udvikle vores køkken, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send ansøgning, CV og gerne et billede til Andrea på
andrea@restaurantnordatlanten.dk

Vi læser ansøgningerne løbende, og ansætter så snart vi finder den rigtige kandidat. Så send gerne din ansøgning allerede nu.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Lagermedarbejder til manuelt lagerpluk / Warehouse worker for manual stock picking
jobs.description:
Frisk og energisk kollega søges som lagermedarbejdere hos fødevare virksomhed.


Vi er en fødevare virksomhed som søger en kollega med lyst til at plukke og pakke varer til en bred vifte af restauratører på hele Sjælland.


Vi er en virksomhed i vækst og søger hele tiden nye arbejdsområder og har derfor brug for dygtige lagerfolk, der kan indgå i teams med mange forskellige kolleger.


Lagerarbejde i et mangfoldigt og sundt arbejdsmiljø
Som lagermedarbejder får du en tempofyldt hverdag med mange opgaver. Sammen med dine kolleger skal du sørge for, at de rigtige varer bliver klar til udlevering i det aftalte antal.


Opgaver

  • Plukke varer fra lageret 

  • Opfyldning

  • Varemodtagelse

  • Andre ad. hoc lageropgaver


Din udvikling i din stilling, samt muligheder for forbedringer er noget vi holder øjemed, så vi hele tiden kan skabe et fælles og godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor orden, kvalitet og automatisering er i fokus.


Engagement & fleksibilitet
Du har muligvis erfaring med lager- eller logistikarbejde fra en tidligere stilling. Vi søger både kollega med og uden truckcertifikat. Det er vigtigt, at du er fleksibel og trives godt med at arbejde i et dynamisk miljø, hvor vi lægger vægt på nøjagtighed og kvalitet.


Du er god til at prioritere og planlægge dine opgaver selvstændigt, og det falder diglige så nemt at arbejde sammen med teamet om at løse en opgave.


Fortrukne sprogkundskaber i prioriteret orden;
1. Tyrkisk 2. Kurdisk 3. Dansk    4. Engelsk


Løn
Løn aftales ifht. kvalifikationer. Som minimum aflønnes på baggrund af fællesoverenskomst mellem DI Overenskomst II og 3F Fagligt Fælles Forbund, Transportgruppen - for lagerarbejdere, chauffører og havnearbejdere.


Send din ansøgning og CV til job@megahouse.dk, markeret med ”Lagermedarbejder” i emnefeltet og du vil høre fra os.

 

 

(ENGLISH)
Fresh and energetic colleague are wanted as warehouse workers at a foodservice company.


We are a foodservice company looking for an employee with a desire to pick and packgoods for a wide range of restaurateurs throughout Zealand.


We are a growing company and are constantly looking for new work areas and therefore need more skilled warehouse worker who can join teams with many differentcolleagues.


Warehouse work in a diverse and healthy working environment
As a warehouse employee, you will have a fast-paced everyday life with many tasks.Together with your colleagues, you must ensure that the right goods are ready for delivery in the agreed quantity.


Assignments

  • Pick the right items from the warehouse

  • Filling

  • Goods receipt

  • Other ad. hoc storage tasks


Your development in your position, as well as opportunities for improvement, is something we keep an eye on, so that we can constantly create a common and good working environment, where order, quality and automation are the focus.


Commitment & flexibility
You may have experience with warehouse or logistics work from a previous position.We are looking for both colleagues with and without a truck certificate. It is important that you are flexible and enjoy working in a dynamic environment where weemphasize accuracy and quality.


You are good at prioritizing and planning your tasks independently, and it is just as easy for you to work together with the team to solve a task.


Preferred language skills in priority order;
1. Turkish 2. Kurdish 3. Danish    4. English


Salary
Salary is agreed according to qualifications. As a minimum, wages are paid on the basis of a joint agreement between DI Agreement II and 3F Fagligt Fælles Forbund, the Transport group - for warehouse workers, drivers and dock workers.


Send your application and CV to job@megahouse.dk, marked with "Warehouse employee" in the subject field and you will hear from us.

jobs.title: Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician
jobs.description:
Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands. We welcome applications from candidates across the EU who are willing to relocate to Maastricht for this opportunity.

Are you an experienced manufacturing professional with a background in cell therapy and GMP? Would you like to play a key role in producing advanced therapies that have a direct impact on patients' lives? Then this position as Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician could be the perfect next step in your career.

Job Description
You will become part of an international pharmaceutical organization, focused on advanced cell and gene therapies. Working in a state-of-the-art GMP cleanroom, you will contribute to the manufacturing of innovative medicines while receiving comprehensive onboarding and continuous training. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your technical expertise within a fast-growing and highly regulated industry.
As a Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician, your responsibilities include:

  • Executing manufacturing activities in a GMP-compliant cleanroom using aseptic techniques
  • Performing cell culture processes, including media preparation, cell expansion, and harvesting
  • Accurately completing batch records and manufacturing documentation
  • Identifying, documenting, and reporting deviations while supporting quality investigations
  • Maintaining high standards of GMP compliance, quality, and safety
  • Contributing to process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Working in a 6-shift schedule, including evenings, nights, and weekends

Profile

  • MBO or HBO degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in GMP manufacturing, preferably within cell therapy, ATMP, or biopharmaceutical production
  • Experience working in a cleanroom environment using aseptic techniques
  • Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused mindset
  • Good communication skills in English
  • A collaborative and proactive approach to teamwork
  • Willingness to work in a 5-shift rotation

Please note: This position is intended for manufacturing professionals. Candidates with a PhD are not eligible for this vacancy and will not be considered.


Employment Conditions

  • Salary: €3,000 - €4,000 gross per month, depending on experience, plus 27% shift allowance
  • Initial 12-month contract with the intention of permanent employment
  • Extensive onboarding and GMP training programme
  • The organization offers excellent long-term career prospects and opportunities for professional growth.
  • Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands
  • Vacancy number: 27390

Important Notice
Only candidates who already hold a valid EU work permit or have unrestricted authorization to work within the European Union are eligible to apply.
Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Applications from candidates who require sponsorship or who do not meet the work authorization requirements will not be considered

jobs.title: Erikoistu automaatio- ja ICT-suunnittelijaksi sähköasemille (2 viikon koulutus & vakituinen työ IT- tai automaatioalan ammattilaiselle)
jobs.description:
Tehtävänkuvaus

Boost on Academic Workin konsepti, jossa tarjoamme oppimisennälkäiselle ja kehityshaluiselle alan osaajalle mahdollisuuden syventää osaamistaan täsmäkouluttautumalla ja työllistymällä kauttamme alan kärkiyrityksiin. Boost rakentuu siis kahdesta osasta: viikkojen mittaisesta palkallisesta ja maksuttomasta erikoistumisjaksosta sekä valmistumisen jälkeen odottavasta vakituisesta työpaikasta Academic Workilla, jonka kautta aloitat työt asiakasyrityksessä. Lue Boostista lisää täältä. * Boost on nimensä mukaisesti keino boostata omaa uraa, kerryttäen juuri sellaista täsmäosaamista ja työkokemusta, jolle on tulevaisuudessakin kysyntää!*

Nyt toteutettava sähköasemien tietoliikenteen ja automaation Boost-koulutus on historiamme ensimmäinen, ja se toteutetaan virtuaalisesti opettajan johdolla 25.11.–7.12.2026 välisenä aikana. Koulutuksesta valmistuttuasi sinua odottaa vakituinen työpaikka Academic Workin konsulttina ja aloitat työskentelyn Swecolla. Täytettäviä paikkoja on kaksi.

Sähköasemien tietoliikenteen ja automaation erikoistumisjakso ja työpaikka suunnittelijana voivat sopia sinulle, jos sinua kiinnostaa...
- monipuoliset ja käytännönläheiset työtehtävät: pääset työskentelemään laitteiden ja järjestelmien rajapinnassa. Arkesi voi koostua esim. sähköasemien tietoverkkojen suunnittelusta, kytkimien ja palomuurien konfiguroinnista, teollisuusautomaation vianmäärityksestä, sekä tietoliikenneprotokollien yhteensovittamisesta
- kehittyminen halutuksi osaajaksi: yhdistelmä IT-osaamista ja ymmärrystä sähköinfrastruktuurista on markkinoilla harvinainen mutta kysytty taito. Koulutuksen ja työkokemuksen myötä kasvat alan erityisasiantuntijaksi.
- teknologian eturintamassa työskentely: sähköasemat ja -kaapit ovat keskeinen osa sähköverkkojärjestelmää ja energiamurrosta. Pääset aitiopaikalta rakentamaan älykkäitä sähköverkkoja (Smart Grid) – työ on siis paitsi merkityksellistä myös teknisesti haastavaa ja kiehtovaa
- pääsy kriittisen infrastruktuurin ja kestävän energiatuotannon ytimeen: sähköinfrastruktuuri ja sen häiriötön toimivuus ovat yhteiskunnan vakauden, toimivuuden ja turvallisuuden kannalta avainasemassa.

Tarjoamme
- palkallisen erikoistumisjakson, jossa opiskellaan täysipäiväisesti, tehokkaasti ja käytännönläheisesti oikean opettajan johdolla. Koulutus valmistaa sinut toimimaan juniortason suunnittelijana.
- vakituisen työn Academic Workilla, jonka kautta pääset työskentelemään Swecolla
- haluttua ja työmarkkinoilla arvostettua osaamista sekä poikkeuksellisen tehokkaan väylän uusiin työtehtäviin
- urakumppanuuden: meillä on vuosien kokemus erilaisten työllistävien intensiivikoulutusten järjestämisestä, eli tiedämme mitä koulutus vaatii ja olemme tukenasi - niin koulutuksen aikana, kuin sen jälkeen!
- noin 3000–3500 € kuukausipalkkaa vastaava tuntipalkka, sekä Academic Workin työsuhde-edut kuten Terveystalon laaja työterveys ja Epassin lounasetu.

Koulutus perustuu kiihdytettyyn oppimiseen. Sinua ei opeta passivoivat tallenteet tai videot, vaan alan kokeneet ammattilaiset. Opit yhdessä muiden kanssa ja itse tekemällä! Koulutuksen jälkeen aloitat työt asiakasyrityksessä - elät ja hengität siis työarkea asiakkaalla ja me Academic Workilla olemme taustalla tukenasi.

Mukana olevat asiakasyritykset

Sweco on Euroopan johtava suunnittelu- ja konsultointiyritys sekä keskeinen suunnannäyttäjä energia-alan vihreässä siirtymässä ja sähköverkkojen digitalisaatiossa. Swecolla työskennellään aitiopaikalla, kun perinteistä sähköinfrastruktuuria päivitetään kohti moderneja, kyberturvallisia ja reaaliaikaisesti ohjattavia älyverkkoja (Smart Grid). Sähköasemien tietoliikenteen ja automaation asiantuntijana Swecolla pääset soveltamaan IT-osaamistasi suoraan älykkäiden ohjausjärjestelmien ytimessä.

Etsimme

- soveltuva ICT-alan tai automaatiotekniikan valmiiksi saatu korkeakoulututkinto. ICT-alalta esim. tietojenkäsittelyn tai tietoliikenteen pääaine/suuntautuminen ovat soveltuvia Tuo CV:ssäsi ja/tai liitteissä selvästi esiin, mitä opintosi ovat sisältäneet IT-infrastruktuurin, tietoliikenteen ja automaation osalta. Hakijan koulutustaustan tulee olla riittävän tekninen, minkä takia esim. tietojärjestelmätiede tai ohjelmistokehitys eivät sellaisenaan täytä erikoistumisjakson lähtövaatimuksia.
- vahva ja aito motivaatio boostata ura sähköasemien tietoliikenne- ja automaatiosuunnittelijaksi
- ratkaisukeskeistä ja vastuuntuntoista asennetta, järjestelmällisyyttä ja kykyä pitää langat käsissä paineenkin alla: erikoistumisjakso ja etenkin sen jälkeinen työ ovat antoisia, mutta vaativat myös paljon
- erinomaiset vuorovaikutustaidot ja halu tehdä yhteistyötä erilaisten ihmisten kanssa – oli kyse sitten asiakaskontaktista tai sisäisestä kollegasta
- kyky ja halu oppia nopeasti ja jatkuvasti – koulutus tarjoaa vankan osaamispohjan, mutta ala vaatii jatkuvaa uuden oppimista ja uteliaisuutta
- sujuva suullinen ja kirjallinen suomen ja englannin kielitaito
- sitoutumista asiakasyrityksen työskentelykäytäntöihin: työ on kokoaikaista ja työ voi vaatia ajoittaista matkustamista. Osittainen etätyö voi olla mahdollista kokemuksen kartuttua, mutta lähtökohtaisesti työntekijän odotetaan työskentelevän lähityössä sujuvan perehdytyksen, tuen, oppimisen ja yhteistyön vuoksi.

EDUKSI LASKETAAN, jos sinulla on
- aiempaa osaamista esim. SCADAsta, väylätekniikasta, fyysisen tietoliikenteen (valokuidut, RF...) parissa toimimisesta, tai alan standardeista
- aiempaa kokemusta teknisistä automaatiotekniikan tai IT-alan työtehtävistä, prosessi- tai rakennusautomaation parista, tai kenttätyöstä esim. valokuidun parista

Huomioithan, että valituille henkilöille voidaan tehdä turvallisuusselvitys projektista riippuen.

Rekrytointiprosessimme

Academic Work hoitaa tätä hakua asiakkaansa puolesta, jonka toiveena on kaikkien tehtävää koskevien kysymysten osoittaminen Academic Workille.

Hakijoita aletaan käydä läpi heti haun auettua ja heitä haastatellaan jatkuvasti. Mikäli olemme edenneet rekrytointiprosessissa pidemmälle riittävän monen hakijan kanssa, saatamme sulkea haun ennen lopullisia valintoja.

Haun seuraaviin vaiheisiin kuuluu persoonapiirteitä sekä kognitiivista kykyä mittaavat testit. Testit toimivat työkaluina oikean tekijän löytämiseksi tehtävään sekä takaavat tasa-arvoisen ja oikeudenmukaisen arvioinnin. Testien jälkeen haastattelemme hakijoita ja tarkistamme myös suosittelijat. Ennen lopullista...

jobs.title: Svensktalande Customer Service Consultant - Spanien
jobs.description:
Talar du svenska och tycker om att hjälpa människor? Bli en del av teamet i soliga Spanien.

Viking Assistance är en ledande leverantör av vägassistans i Norge, Sverige, Danmark och Finland. Genom sitt internationella partnernätverk hjälper de även bilister runt om i Europa.

De säkerställer snabb, trygg och pålitlig hjälp för både fordon och passagerare, oavsett var ett problem eller driftstopp inträffar. Deras team hjälper kunder på norska, svenska, finska och engelska.

Om rollen

Som Customer Service Consultant tar du emot och hanterar telefonsamtal från kunder som behöver vägassistans.

Kunderna kan befinna sig i utsatta eller stressande situationer, och din uppgift är att se till att de får rätt hjälp när de behöver den som mest.

Du är ofta den första personen kunden kommer i kontakt med när något oväntat händer ute på vägarna.

Vår kund söker dig som kan arbeta självständigt samtidigt som du har ett starkt fokus på att ge förstklassig kundservice. Du blir en del av ett större team där kollegorna stöttar och hjälper varandra när det behövs.

Du arbetar i flera olika system för att lösa situationer snabbt och effektivt. Du hjälper även samarbetspartners inom försäkrings- och fordonsbranschen med frågor och ärenden kopplade till vägassistans.

Kvalifikationer

• Erfarenhet av kundservice

• Flytande svenska i tal och skrift

• Goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift

• God datorvana och förmåga att arbeta med teknik och digitala system

• Ett rent belastningsregister är ett krav

Du kommer att passa bra hos Viking Assistance om du:

• Värdesätter en stark arbetsmoral

• Är bra på att samarbeta

• Trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra

• Har god kommunikationsförmåga

• Känner dig bekväm med att använda digitala verktyg och telefonen som dina främsta arbetsredskap

• Är van vid att arbeta i flera system samtidigt

• Är noggrann och tycker om att hantera komplexa arbetsuppgifter

• Är lösningsorienterad i kontakten med både kunder och kollegor

• Är nyfiken och vill lära dig nya saker

• Trivs i en snabb och dynamisk arbetsmiljö

• Har lätt för att anpassa dig till förändringar

• Vill vara en del av ett starkt team med en positiv företagskultur

Vad de erbjuder

• En fast heltidsanställning

• Ett meningsfullt arbete där du hjälper människor varje dag

• Omfattande introduktion och utbildning

• Konkurrenskraftiga anställningsvillkor och förmåner

• En samarbetsinriktad och stöttande nordisk arbetskultur med fantastiska kollegor

• Moderna kontor i Torrevieja eller Fuengirola, nära Medelhavet

• Möjligheter till personlig och professionell utveckling inom ett internationellt företag

• Roterande arbetsschema inom en verksamhet som är öppen dygnet runt, året om (24/7/365), vilket inkluderar dag-, kvälls- och helgpass

Anställningsvillkor

• Anställning: Spansk tillsvidareanställning, heltid

• Plats: Kontorsbaserat i Torrevieja eller Fuengirola, Spanien

• Startdatum: Så snart som möjligt eller enligt överenskommelse

• Observera: Möjlighet till distansarbete finns inte

Låter det här som något för dig?

Skicka gärna in ditt CV och personliga brev – vi ser fram emot att få veta mer om dig.
