jobs.title: REKRYTERINGSKONSULT
jobs.description:
**Rekrytering handlar om mycket mer än att tillsätta lediga tjänster. Det handlar om att skapa tillväxt.**

**WasaTalent Oy** är en partner inom rekrytering och direktsökning som förenar rätt människor med rätt möjligheter. Vi har byggt vårt rykte genom ett rakt och tydligt arbetssätt, en djup förståelse för våra kunder och en förmåga att hitta kompetens där andra inte ser den. I takt med att vi växer söker vi nu en rekryteringskonsult som vill vara med och skapa framgång för både våra kunder och WasaTalent.

Vi söker en ny kollega till vårt team – en

**REKRYTERINGSKONSULT**

_Vill du hjälpa företag att hitta rätt kompetens och människor att ta nästa steg i karriären? Brinner du för ditt arbete och möter du människor med ett genuint intresse?_

**Vad innebär arbetet i praktiken?**

Det handlar om samtal med HR, vd:ar, specialister och framtidens talanger. Om att förstå kundernas verksamhet så väl att du kan identifiera rätt person för just deras behov.

Det handlar om att våga lyfta luren, ta kontakt och bygga nätverk som leder till lyckade rekryteringar även långt framöver. Och om de där stunderna när du får ringa en kandidat och säga:

_Grattis, jobbet är ditt._

**Vem lyckas hos oss?**

Vi söker dig som förstår företagens verksamhet och affärsmässiga förutsättningar. Du kan identifiera kompetens, förstå vad olika roller kräver och föra naturliga samtal på alla nivåer i en organisation. Vi värdesätter särskilt erfarenhet av rekrytering av specialister och chefer samt kunskap om metoder för direktrekrytering och digitala sökverktyg. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på finska och engelska. Kunskaper i svenska är en fördel. Det avgörande är ändå att du trivs med människor, är intresserad av affärsverksamhet och vågar ta kontakt med nya personer.

Vi upplever att de bästa rekryteringskonsulterna är nyfikna av naturen. De ställer många frågor, lyssnar noga och ser potential där andra bara ser en rad i ett cv.

**Varför WasaTalent?**

För att vi inte strävar efter att vara störst i branschen, men däremot bäst.

Hos oss har du verkliga möjligheter att påverka ditt arbete, dina kundrelationer och företagets framtid. Du får frihet, ansvar och möjlighet att växa i rollen så långt som din egen ambition tar dig. Din lön består av en grundlön och en resultatbonus som betalas ut varje månad. På så sätt återspeglas dina insatser och framgångar också i din lön.

**Den här rollen kan vara rätt för dig om** du tror att varje lyckad rekrytering börjar med ett genuint möte mellan människor. Och framför allt om du ser potential hos människor innan andra hinner upptäcka den.

Kom och skapa nya framgångshistorier tillsammans med oss.

Din arbetsplats finns i Vasa och arbetet kan inte utföras helt på distans.

Mer information om tjänsten får du av Päivi Ekholm, 040 524 5554 / paivi.ekholm@wasatalent.fi.

**Intresserad?**

Skicka din ansökan och ditt cv via WasaTalents rekryteringssystem senast **8.11.2026**.

jobs.title: 3 anlægsgartnere søges til virksomhed i vækst Skovbyholm Grønt is Hiring 3 skilled landscapers
jobs.description:
Skovbyholm Grønt er i vækst, og vi søger derfor 3 dygtige anlægsgartnere til vores team.

Vi arbejder med juletræsdyrkning, grøn vedligeholdelse og anlægsopgaver for både private og erhverv. Vi driver og vedligeholder mere end 220 hektar, og vi har derfor brug for flere medarbejdere til vores team.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du vil primært arbejde med juletræsdyrkning og vedligeholdelse af vores arealer. Opgaverne vil blandt andet være:

  1. Plantning og pleje af juletræer

  2. Formklipning og topskudsregulering

  3. Fældning og øvrigt arbejde i juletræskulturer

  4. Vedligeholdelse af grønne arealer

  5. Hækklipning og andre anlægsopgaver

  6. Betjening af maskiner og specialudstyr

  7. Andre praktiske opgaver efter behov og sæson

Vi søger dig, som

  1. Har erfaring som anlægsgartner, skovarbejder eller fra lignende praktisk arbejde

  2. Gerne har erfaring med juletræsdyrkning

  3. Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  4. Er fysisk robust og trives med udendørs arbejde

  5. Er mødestabil og fleksibel

  6. Kan arbejde i al slags vejr

  7. Har lyst til at blive en del af en virksomhed i udvikling

Erfaring med juletræsdyrkning er en fordel, men relevant praktisk erfaring inden for anlæg, skovbrug eller grøn vedligeholdelse kan også være relevant.

Vi tilbyder

  1. Fast arbejde i en virksomhed i vækst

  2. Varierede arbejdsopgaver

  3. Et aktivt og praktisk arbejdsmiljø

  4. Gode kollegaer

  5. Mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for juletræsdyrkning og anlægsarbejde

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning og CV.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

ENGLISH

 

3 Landscape Gardeners Wanted for Growing Company

Skovbyholm Grønt is growing, and we are looking for 3 skilled and motivated landscape gardeners to join our team.

We work with Christmas tree cultivation, green area maintenance and landscaping projects for both private and commercial customers. We manage and maintain more than 220 hectares, and we are therefore looking for additional employees to join our team.

Your responsibilities

Your main tasks will involve Christmas tree cultivation and maintenance of our green areas. Your duties will include:

  1. Planting and maintaining Christmas trees

  2. Shaping and pruning Christmas trees

  3. Leader shoot regulation

  4. Felling and other work in Christmas tree plantations

  5. Maintenance of green areas

  6. Hedge trimming and other landscaping tasks

  7. Operating machinery and specialised equipment

  8. Other practical and seasonal tasks as required

We are looking for someone who

  1. Has experience as a landscape gardener, forestry worker or in similar practical work

  2. Preferably has experience with Christmas tree cultivation

  3. Can work independently and take responsibility for their tasks

  4. Is physically fit and enjoys working outdoors

  5. Is reliable and flexible

  6. Is comfortable working in all types of weather

  7. Would like to become part of a growing company

Experience with Christmas tree cultivation is an advantage, but relevant practical experience in landscaping, forestry or green area maintenance may also be considered.

We offer

  1. A position in a growing company

  2. Varied and practical work

  3. An active outdoor working environment

  4. Good colleagues

jobs.title: Fuldtidsstilling i salg - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Telefonsælger til Vivo Sales nye afdeling i Aarhus

Vil du udvikle dig inden for salg og kommunikation og samtidig blive en del af en arbejdsplads med højt humør, stærkt sammenhold og fokus på personlig udvikling?

Hos Vivo Sales i Aarhus søger vi nye kolleger til vores salgsteam. Du behøver ikke have erfaring med salg i forvejen, det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, udvikle dig og blive dygtigere.

Uanset om du har afsluttet din uddannelse, holder sabbatår eller blot er klar til nye udfordringer, kan stillingen være et godt næste skridt.

Om jobbet 

Som telefonsælger hos Vivo Sales kontakter du privatpersoner og rådgiver om a-kasse, fagforening og lønsikring.

Din opgave er at skabe en god og professionel dialog, afdække kundens behov og præsentere de løsninger, der passer til den enkelte.

Du får grundig oplæring i både produkter, salg og samtaleteknik, så du bliver godt klædt på til jobbet. Derfor er tidligere salgserfaring ikke et krav. 

Om Vivo Sales

Vivo Sales arbejder med mødebooking og direkte salg og har afdelinger i Vejle, Silkeborg og Aarhus. Vi er omkring 50 medarbejdere på tværs af afdelingerne.

Hos os går faglig udvikling og et godt arbejdsmiljø hånd i hånd. Vi lægger vægt på, at vores medarbejdere trives, udvikler deres kompetencer og samtidig bliver en del af et socialt fællesskab.

Vi tilbyder dig

  • Grundig oplæring og løbende sparring

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for salg og kommunikation

  • Et socialt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kolleger,

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på både faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Mulighed for at opbygge værdifuld erfaring med salg, kundedialog og behovsafdækning

  • Sociale arrangementer og aktiviteter, der styrker fællesskabet på tværs af lokationer.

  • Små faste traditioner i hverdagen, blandt andet juice hver torsdag

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Trives med at tale med mange forskellige mennesker

  • Har lyst til at lære og udvikle dig

  • Er engageret og møder på arbejde med en positiv indstilling

  • Motiveres af at arbejde med salg og resultater

  • Bidrager positivt til fællesskabet og stemningen på arbejdspladsen

Det vigtigste for os er ikke, hvad der allerede står på dit CV, men at du har motivationen til at lære og blive dygtig til jobbet.

Praktisk information

Arbejdssted: Toldbodgade 8, st. 8000 Aarhus C
Arbejdstid: Fuldtid
Ansøgning: Via ansøgningslinket på siden

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning til os. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og glæder os til at høre mere om dig.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på 55 55 64 64 på hverdage mellem kl. 9.00 og 15.00.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

Team Vivo Sales

Etsimme joukkoomme **ajoneuvomekaanikkoa**, jolla on perustason osaamista ajoneuvojen huolto- ja korjaustöistä sekä halua kehittyä ammatissaan.

Työssä pääset tekemään monipuolisia huolto-, korjaus- ja vianmääritystöitä erilaisten ajoneuvojen parissa. Arvostamme **reipasta, huolellista ja oppimishaluista tekijää**, joka tarttuu töihin oma-aloitteisesti.

Aikaisempaa laajaa kokemusta tai vaativien remonttien hallintaa ei edellytetä – tärkeintä on, että **ajoneuvotekniikan perusteet ovat hallussa ja halu oppia uutta on kohdallaan.**

- Renkaiden vaihdot ja muut yleiset huoltotyöt

- Ajoneuvojen perustason vianmääritys

- Muut monipuoliset huolto- ja korjaustyöt


**Odotamme sinulta**

- Perusosaamista ajoneuvojen huolto- ja korjaustöistä

- Kiinnostusta autoihin ja ajoneuvotekniikkaan

- Tavallisimpien korjaamon työkalujen ja laitteiden hallintaa

- Huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta

- Oma-aloitteisuutta ja halua oppia lisää

- Kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana työporukkaa

Aikaisempi kokemus **vaativammista korjaustöistä lasketaan eduksesi.**

jobs.title: Medarbejder til økonomiafdelingen (2-10 stillinger)
jobs.description:
Medarbejder til økonomiafdelingen (2-10 stillinger)

 I vores økonomiafdeling har vi en stor og vigtig opgave foran os. Vi har en del bilag og data, der har hobet sig op over en længere periode, som skal scannes, bogføres og struktureres. Da det er en omfattende opgave, søger vi et team på 2-10 medarbejdere, som kan arbejde tæt sammen, sparre med hinanden og løbende afløse hinanden i ferier og eksamensperioder.

Du vil blive en central del af teamet og få solid hands-on erfaring med klassiske regnskabsopgaver. Du behøver ikke at have erfaring i forvejen – vi sørger for en grundig oplæring i alle vores systemer, så du bliver klædt ordentligt på til opgaven. Der kan også være ad hoc opgaver som der ikke er beskrevet i opslaget.

 

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

·       Oprydning og digitalisering: Scanning af fysiske bilag/kvitteringer og organisering af historisk materiale. Vi skal nok hjælpe dig med det.

·       Bogføring og kontrol: Kontering af omkostninger og medarbejderudlæg i e-conomic og Pleo. Vi skal nok hjælpe dig med det.

·       Data- og systemarbejde: Indtastnings- og afstemningsarbejde i Excel og Dataløn. Vi skal nok hjælpe dig med det.

·       Regnskab, fakturering og styring: Løbende assistance med debitor-/kreditorstyring, fakturering, fakturabehandling samt hjælp ved månedsafslutning. Vi skal nok hjælpe dig med det.

·       Analyse og Excel/Libre: Ad hoc-opgaver inden for Excel-modellering. Vi skal nok hjælpe dig med det.

·       Ad hoc-assistance: Koordinering via Outlook samt hjælp til praktisk planlægning og afholdelse af interne møder og træningssessioner. Vi skal nok hjælpe dig med det.

·       Kommunikation: Formidling af virksomhedens interne regler og retningslinjer for udlæg og bilagshåndtering til resten af husets medarbejdere. Vi skal nok hjælpe dig med det.

 

Hvem er du?….måske

·       Du kan også være gang i et sabbatår.

·       Du kan også være ledig.

·       Du trives med rutineopgaver og motiveres af at få en stor oprydningsopgave i mål i fællesskab med dit team.

·       Du har mod på at lære systemer som e-conomic, Pleo, Dataløn og Outlook at kende (eller kender dem allerede).

·       Du arbejder struktureret, har et skarpt øje for detaljer og er en god holdspiller.

·       Du er serviceminded og har mod på at guide kolleger i organisationen omkring vores finansielle retningslinjer.

 

Hvad tilbyder vi?

·       Høj fleksibilitet: Vi tilpasser arbejdstiden efter dit studie eller efter dit behov, så der altid er plads til eksamensperioder og forelæsninger.

·       Grundig oplæring – vi forventer ikke, at du kan det hele på forhånd.

·       Stærk erfaring på dit CV med udbredte og markedskendte systemer (Pleo, e-conomic, Dataløn).

·       En uformel arbejdsplads med et stærkt sammenhold i det nye team.

·       Timer: deltid eller fuldtid – det er op til dig

 

Arbejdssted: Skibby (4050 Frederikssund, Frederikssund Kommune / Region Hovedstaden)
Opstart: Hurtigst muligt.

 

 Ansøgning

Vi vil gerne vide, hvem du er – også ud over det, der står på dit CV. Send os derfor et meget, meget kort personlig ansøgning mærket:”studentermedhjælper”, der giver os et indtryk af dit potentiale og din personlighed. Du bestemmer helt selv formen, og du må meget gerne være kreativ!

Vedlæg dit CV samt din kreative ansøgning, og send det hele til josiah@curam.dk hurtigst muligt.

Vi tager løbende samtaler, så tøv ikke med at sende din ansøgning!

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Josiah – Økonomiansvarlig på josiah@curam.dk.

Finance Department Staff (2–10 positions)

 

Our finance department faces a major and important task. A significant volume of vouchers, documents and data has accumulated over a long period and needs to be scanned, recorded, and organized. As this is a substantial undertaking, we are looking for a team of 2–10 employees who can work closely together, collaborate, and cover for one another during holidays and exam periods.

You will become a key part of the team and gain solid hands-on experience with standard accounting tasks. Prior experience is not required—we provide thorough training in all our systems to ensure you are well-prepared for the job. There may also be ad hoc tasks not specifically listed in this job posting.

 

Your primary tasks:

• Organization and digitization: Scanning physical vouchers/receipts and organizing historical records. We will assist you with this.

• Bookkeeping and verification: Coding expenses and employee reimbursements in e-conomic and Pleo. We will assist you with this.

• Data and system work: Data entry and reconciliation in Excel and Dataløn. We will assist you with this.

• Accounting, invoicing, and management: Ongoing assistance with accounts receivable/payable, invoicing, invoice processing, and month-end closing. We will assist you with this.

• Analysis and Excel/Libre: Ad hoc tasks involving Excel modeling. We will assist you with this.

• Ad hoc assistance: Coordination via Outlook and help with the practical planning and hosting of internal meetings and training sessions. We’ll help you with that.

• Communication: Communicating the company’s internal rules and guidelines regarding expenses and receipt handling to the rest of the staff. We’ll help you with that.

 

Who are you?… perhaps…

• You might be taking a gap year.

• You might be currently unemployed.

• You enjoy routine tasks and are motivated by successfully completing a major cleanup project together with your team.

• You work in a structured manner, have a keen eye for detail, and are a good team player.

• You are service-minded and comfortable guiding colleagues across the organization regarding our financial guidelines.

 

What do we offer?

• High flexibility: We tailor working hours to fit your studies or personal needs, ensuring there is always room for exam periods and lectures.

• Thorough training – we don’t expect you to know everything from day one.

• Valuable experience for your CV working with widely used, market-leading systems (Pleo, e-conomic, Dataløn).

• An informal workplace with a strong sense of team spirit. Location: Skibby (4050 Frederikssund, Frederikssund Municipality / Capital Region of Denmark)

• Hours: partime or full time – its up to you

Start date: As soon as possible.

 

 

Application

We would like to know who you are—beyond just what is on your CV. Please send us a very brief personal application marked "student assistant" that gives us an impression of your potential and personality. You are free to choose the format, and we encourage you to be creative!

Please attach your CV and your creative application, and send everything to josiah@curam.dk as soon as possible.

We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so don't hesitate to send your application!

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Josiah (Finance Manager) at josiah@curam.dk.

jobs.title: Hoitaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Pietarsaareen
jobs.description:
Hoiva-avustaja sympaattiselle seniorille Pietarsaareen

Haemme hoiva-avustajia osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Pietarsaaressa.

Haluaisitko tehdä hoiva-avustajan työtä osa-aikaisesti, kiireettömästi ja ilman sairaanhoidollisia työtehtäviä sympaattisten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva hoitaja-helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen omaavia helppereitä tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

Mitä hoitaja-helpperi tekee?

Hoitaja-helpperi on sosiaali- ja terveysalan koulutettu henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua ja seuraa omalle nimetylle ikäihmiselle. Hoitaja-helpperi tukee ikäihmistä kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilu ja kauppareissut, kodin ylläpito, ruokailussa tukeminen, saattoapu, yhdessäolo ja jutustelu.

Hoitaja-helpperi tukee seniorin hyvinvointia kokonaisvaltaisesti. Hoivan ja huolenpidon tehtävät sisältävät:

- suihkuapua

- voinnin tarkkailua

- kotona pärjäämisen tukemista

- liikkumisessa tukemista


Lisäksi voit auttaa asiakasta suihkussa ja henkilökohtaisessa hygieniassa. Työtehtäviin ei kuitenkaan kuulu sairaanhoidollisten palveluiden toteutusta, kuten lääkehoitoa.

Mitä hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii?

Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa ikäihmisiä. Lisäksi hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii sosiaali- ja terveysalan tai hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen tai vankan kokemuksen hoiva-avustajan työstä.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

Mikä on parasta hoitaja-helpperin työssä?

Kysyimme tätä hoitaja-helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

Hoitaja-helpperinä saat:

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 15,29-17,29 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

Lähetä hakemus hoitaja-helpperiksi täällä.

Lue lisää Hembystä klikkaamalla tästä.

jobs.title: MIG/MAG WELDERS, ROBOT WELDERS for sheet metal tasks
jobs.description:
MIG/MAG WELDERS, ROBOT WELDERS for sheet metal tasks

VPS Henkilöstöpalvelu, part of the VPS Group, has been operating since 1987 and is a chain of companies specializing in labor hire and recruiting services, with coverage throughout Finland. We are a member company of the Employment Industry Finland, HELA. VPS Henkilöstöpalvelu is committed to quality and customer service, our motto is WE CHOOSE THE BEST FOR YOU. Find out more about our company at our website .

We are looking for skilled MIG/MAG welders for our client company situated in Salo, Western Finland, to perform various metal industry tasks. Applicants are expected to have MIG/MAG welding skills (no certification requirements), a good work ethic, and the ability to read technical drawings. A reasonable command of Finnish is appreciated and a willingness to work shifts if required.

Besides MIG/MAG welders we are also looking for robot welders, whose duties include setting up workpieces, adjusting parameters, and quality monitoring. Applicants are expected to have experience with robot welding, a good work ethic, basic welding skills (no certification requirements), and the ability to read technical drawings. A reasonable command of Finnish is appreciated and a willingness to work shifts if required.

Measurement and quality assurance skills are also good to have in both positions. We also value a cheerful attitude to work, good motivation and desire to learn new things. 

We welcome applications from recent graduates. Wages are paid in accordance with the collective agreement for the technology industry. This is an opportunity for long-term employment! We will assist with housing and visa if needed.

Please fill out the application form via the link provided. You may also attach a cover letter and your CV to the form. For inquiries regarding the position, please call +358 2 527 8900 or email salo@vps.fi. 

Note! If you have already completed the VPS electronic application form, please log in and attach your existing profile to this vacancy.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja mieshenkilölle, 40h/viikko
jobs.employer: Lounais-Suomen Lihastautiyhdistys ry, ruotsiksi Sydvästra Finlands Muskelhandikappförening rf
jobs.description:
Kauttamme etsitään henkilökohtaista avustajaa lihassairautta sairastavalle miesasiakkaalle Kaarinan keskustaan. Työsuhde alkaa heti sopivan avustajan löydyttyä ja työtä on 40h/vko. Työajat pääsääntöisin klo 14.00-22.00, työ sisältää myös viikonlopputyötä.

Asiakkaalla on käytössä rollaattori sekä manuaalipyörätuoli, jota avustaja työntää tarvittaessa sekä sähköpyörätuoli pääsääntöisesti ulkokäytössä. Avustajan apua kaivataan kodinhoidollisissa asioissa, kuten pyykkihuolto, siivous, lakanoiden vaihto, ruuanlaitto sekä asiointikäynneillä. Työ voi sisältää nostoja ja siirtoja sekä intiimihygienian hoitoon liittyviä tehtäviä. Työtä on n. 5 päivänä viikossa ja työvuorot sijoittuvat pääosin iltapäivään ja iltaan. Toivotaan n. 40-55-vuotiasta naispuolista avustajaa.

Työsuhteessa noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa ja Heta-JHL:n työehtosopimusta. Työnantajalla on oikeus tarkistaa työhön valitun rikosrekisteriote.

Palkka B1-luokan mukainen, 13,73€/h.

jobs.title: Electrical Supervisor, Data Centers
jobs.description:
Eltel Networks Oy is a leading provider of critical infrastructure services in the Nordics. We enable the digitalization and electrification of society through reliable solutions for power, communication and renewable energy networks.

Do you want to help deliver the next generation of critical infrastructure on the frontline? Eltel is looking for a hands-on, proactive Electrical Supervisor to join our growing Data Center team.

This is a 100% site-based role tailored for an energetic and solution-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced construction environment, loves velocity, and excels in leading execution safely and efficiently directly on the field.

Your key responsibilities

-
Pre-Mobilization & Constructability Verification: Review electrical designs, models, and technical drawings from a practical contractor's perspective before site mobilization. Identify potential installation clashes, assess layout feasibility, and proactively suggest constructability improvements.

-
On-Site Supervision & Quality Control (QA/QC): Manage day-to-day electrical installation workflows on-site. Oversee for example cable containment routing, cable and busbar installations. Drive a strict 'Right First Time' quality culture, ensuring all torque marks, cable pull tension logs, and inspection sheets are digitally documented.

-
HSE Leadership & Energy Isolation: Maintain rigid adherence to Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) protocols. Lead sureness around specialized Permit to Work (PTW) systems for energized spaces, working at heights, and confined zones. Manage complex Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) protocols to safely isolate energy during construction and commissioning phases.

-
Logistics & Material Management: Supervise on-site materials, track component delivery workflows, perform material take-offs (including MV and LV cable tracking), and manage subcontractors and crew sourcing to hit strict project timelines.

-
Commissioning (Cx) & Interface Management: Partner closely with Commissioning (Cx) Engineers as energization approaches. Coordinate testing activities (including for example Megger insulation resistance and protection relay testing) to ensure an ultra-smooth, high-velocity transition from installation to active operations.

What We Are Looking For

-
We are looking for a technically astute, assertive, and energetic field leader who enjoys solving real-time engineering challenges on active construction sites.

-
Strong understanding of SFS standards and the ability to apply their requirements to practical installation workflows on-site.

-
Solid experience as an Electrical Supervisor or General Foreman on industrial sites, substations, or large-scale mission-critical electrical construction projects.

-
Technical understanding of MV/LV electrical distribution systems (cabling, TX, RMU, busbar, CB etc.), back-up solutions (UPS and generators) and general construction sequencing.

-
Proven track record managing technician and subcontractor groups and site crews in high-pressure, fast-paced project environments.

-
Strong safety mindset with direct exposure to strict Permit to Work (PTW) systems and operational Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) methodologies.

-
Professional communication skills with the ability to operate comfortably in an English-speaking project environment.

Desirable Skills (considered an advantage)

-
B.Sc. degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field (or an applicable strong technical trade background).

-
Ability to navigate and work with CAD drawings or 3D models (Autodesk BIM, Dalux, Navisworks).

-
Prior experience working inside high-security or mission-critical Data Center environments.

Why should you apply to Eltel?

Our professionals describe Eltel as a flexible workplace that offers a wide range of expertise, diverse roles, and a well-balanced mix of freedom and responsibility. At Eltel, people work guided by our core values — always professionally, stronger together, caring for life, and creating new opportunities.

A skilled team around you - At Eltel, you are never alone. You have a reliable and collaborative team of professionals backing you up. This skilled and reliable team is a source of pride for us - that's why we can successfully handle even large EPC-projects. We encourage open-mindedness and curiosity to continuously find better ways to work.

A workplace where people care and grow stronger together - Team spirit and peer support consistently receive high marks in Eltels employee surveys. At Eltel, people look out for one another, follow safety protocols, and ensure that everyone gets home safely every day. Together, we create a positive working environment and strive for a healthy work-life balance.

Support your professional development - At Eltel we support your professional growth from day one. We are proud of the long careers our employees have built at Eltel, and we are committed to supporting their career development.

Employee benefits - Well-being, resilience, and job satisfaction are our key priorities. Eltel offers a wide range of benefits, including ePassi lunch and Flex benefits, a company phone, Auntie mental well-being service, and discounted services such as massage therapy.

Sounds interesting?

Submit your application through our recruitment system by 30.11. Please note that we process applications continuously and will proceed to interviews as soon as suitable candidates are found, so do not hesitate to apply as soon as possible!

For further information, please contact Jesse Korhonen firstname.lastname@eltelnetworks.com. Email is the most efficient way to send a call request. For general questions regarding the recruitment process or Eltel, please contact rekrytointi@eltelnetworks.com

Read more about Eltel and our work with data centers: [Services for data centers](https://www.eltelnetworks.fi/fi/palvelut/services-for-data-centers/)

Follow us on social media:

LinkedIn: [Eltel Networks](https://www.linkedin.com/company/eltel-networks/)
Instagram: [eltelsuomi](https://www.instagram.com/eltelsuomi/)

Why join Eltel?

At Eltel, you will be part of a team delivering some of the most demanding and exciting infrastructure projects in the Nordics. We offer an opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals, develop your expertise in mission-critical electrical system

jobs.title: Huoltoinsinööri, HST-turbokompressorit
jobs.description:
Haluatko työskennellä maailman johtaviin kuuluvien korkean teknologian turbokompressorien parissa ja auttaa asiakkaitamme saavuttamaan energiatehokkaampia sekä kestävämpiä prosesseja? Etsimme nyt huoltoinsinööriä vahvistamaan Kotkan tiimiämme HST-turbokompressoreiden osalta. Tässä roolissa toimit keskeisenä teknisenä asiantuntijana tukien asiakkaitamme ja Sulzerin myyntiyhtiöitä ympäri maailmaa HST-kompressorien käyttöönotto-, huolto- ja vianratkaisutehtävissä. Tässä roolissa pääset yhdistämään teknisen osaamisen ja vahvan asiakaspalvelutyön. Asiakkaamme ovat meille tärkeitä ja halumme on palvella heitä luotettavalla osaamisella ja ammattitaidolla. Tehtävän palkkaus asettuu välille 4000 – 4500 EUR/kk. Lopullinen palkka määräytyy valitun henkilön osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan. Tehtävässä on mahdollisuus käyttöautoetuun.

**Tässä tehtävässä saat vastuullesi:**

- HST-turbokompressorien asennusten valvonta, käyttöönotto ja käyttöönoton jälkeinen tuki

- tekninen vianetsintä ja ongelmanratkaisu asiakkaiden kohteissa sekä etänä

- asiakaskoulutusten järjestäminen ja tekninen konsultointi

- yhteistyö tuotekehityksen kanssa laitteiden suorituskykyä ja kehitystarpeita koskevissa asioissa

- uusien tuotteiden ja ominaisuuksien omaksuminen sekä niiden tekninen tukeminen markkinoilla

- huolto- ja palveluratkaisujen myynti sekä tarjousten laatiminen

- asiakassuhteiden kehittäminen ja palveluliiketoiminnan kasvattaminen

- turvallisuus-, laatu- ja ympäristövaatimusten varmistaminen kaikessa työssä


Huoltoinsinöörinä vastaat HST-kompressorien teknisestä tuesta koko niiden elinkaaren ajan. Työ sisältää asiakaskäyntejä, käyttöönottoja, vianetsintää, koulutuksia sekä tiivistä yhteistyötä tuotekehityksen, tuotannon ja kansainvälisten Sulzer-yksiköiden kanssa. jobs.title: TIG Welder, Urjala
jobs.description:
TIG WELDER – URJALA

Are you familiar with TIG welding, and can you maintain a precise finish even in challenging working positions? We are looking for a TIG Welder to join our customers production team in Urjala.

The role includes both TIG welding and more demanding mesh welding. The materials used are mild steel and stainless steel.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

* TIG welding

* Mesh welding on thin material

* Welding mild steel and stainless steel

* Welding covers in challenging working positions

* Producing very thin and clean weld seams

The mesh welding involves thin material that can easily burn through. This means the work requires a precise hand, a good feel for the welding process and patience. The weld seam needs to be very thin and clean.

You will also be working in challenging positions, so a careful and practical approach is important.

WHAT KIND OF PERSON ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

* You are familiar with TIG welding and have a good understanding of the basics

* You can produce clean and precise welds, also on thin material

* You are comfortable working in challenging positions

* You are careful and quality-oriented

* You are willing to learn and develop your welding skills

* Finnish or English is enough

What matters in this role is not how much welding experience you have on paper, but what you can achieve with your hands.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

* Varied TIG welding tasks

* The opportunity to develop your welding skills

* Full-time work, 40 hours per week

* Day-shift working hours

* Fixed-term employment at least until summer, with the possibility to continue afterwards

* Salary based on your skills and experience

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Location: Urjala
Working hours: Day shift, 40 hours/week
Employment: Fixed-term, at least until summer
Start: As soon as possible
Salary: Based on skills and experience

The workplace is not accessible by public transport, so you will need a car or another reliable way to get to work.

INTERESTED?

Send us your application as soon as possible. The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person.

Jenna Vuorinen

jobs.title: Associate Professor in Radiography
jobs.description:
A position as associate professor (10% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Radiology (Odense), the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark.

UNIFY – Research and Innovation Unit of Radiology, Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), in collaboration with University College Lillebælt (UCL) and Odense Universitetshospital (OUH), invites applications for a position as Associate Professor in Radiography, with 10% research time at the Department of Radiology, OUH. The position is offered for a five-year period with the possibility of extension. The starting date is subject to agreement.

About the research unit

UNIFY – Research and Innovation Unit of Radiology conducts high-quality research across all radiological specialties and contributes significantly to the education and development of highly qualified staff for both clinical and academic work.

The unit values researchers with diverse professional backgrounds and has approximately 20 affiliated members, including a professor, associate professors, PhD students, adjunct professors and others.

The unit has a well-established research environment and organises a number of regular activities and meetings throughout the year, including research retreats combining academic and social activities.

Research and Teaching Responsibilities
The position involves research, academic development, research training, teaching, including examinations, supervision and assessment activities.

Qualifications and Expectations
The Associate Professor must hold a primary position at UCL.

The successful applicant must have documented research and teaching experience within radiography and a particular interest in ultrasound.

Furthermore, strong collaborative skills are required in order to further develop research in radiography, both across disciplines and at national and international level. Having international research collaborators is considered an advantage but is not a requirement.

Joint Research Strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and OUH

The joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and OUH sets the direction for our shared research activities in the coming years.

Based on the vision, “We conduct research together to create the patient care of the future,” particular emphasis is placed on:

  • Research across disciplines, with people at the centre

  • Strong research environments as a driving force for development

  • The research pathway from idea to impact

Further information about the joint research strategy is available on the SDU website.

Applicants Must Document

  • A PhD degree or equivalent postgraduate research qualifications

  • Relevant research experience documented through publications in international peer-reviewed journals

  • Relevant clinical experience

  • Relevant experience in educational administration

  • A successful track record in obtaining research funding

Applicants must meet the qualifications required at Associate Professor level in accordance with the applicable Danish Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Reporting

The Associate Professor will report to Head of Research Bo Mussmann on matters relating to the associate professorship.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Head of Research Bo Mussmann, Department of Clinical Research/OUH: Email: bo.mussmann@rsyd.dk, Telephone: +45 20 59 88 56

Application deadline

01.11.2026 at 23:59 CET

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Associate Professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed associate professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Kløvervænget 10, 2nd floor, 5000 Odense C, Denmark.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below. 

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply. 

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation. 

Your application must include the following as PDF files:

Please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total).

  • a motivation letter 

  • a detailed CV 

  • degree certificates (including a Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications 

  • 6 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file. 

  • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan

  • a detailed description of research experience 

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application

Incomplete applications regarding the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Purchaser - Global Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Do you have experience with technical or project procurement in a larger international company? Would you like to help develop a global supply chain in an international project-driven organization? Then you may be the Purchaser we are looking for.

We are upgrading, servicing, and operating engine- and biomass-based power plants around the world. This creates a continuous need to source goods and services from subcontractors and ensure reliable transport for our customers.

For our Global Supply Chain department, we are looking for an outgoing and internationally minded colleague with commitment, determination, and a positive attitude. The department consists of 20 employees responsible for procurement, warehousing, and transport of goods and services.

BWSC – Ever better energy! 

Join us in our mission of building a world of sustainable energy and make a meaningful impact on the world of power generation and energy conversion.

BWSC is a leading player in the power generation industry, specializing in the service, operations, and maintenance of power plants. We are seeking to always provide Ever Better Energy whether it comes to optimizing a conventional power plant, operating a biomass power plant or constructing new energy facilities. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and environmental stewardship sets us apart in the industry.

Your responsibilities

  • Support Project Procurement Managers with procurement tasks related to the execution of upgrading, service- and maintenance projects for engine and biomass power plants globally.
  • Obtain quotations from suppliers and place purchase orders within a defined area of responsibility.
  • Participate in broader departmental activities such as category management, supplier relationship development, negotiations, and implementation of supplier agreements.
  • Contribute to identifying and evaluating potential suppliers.
  • Convert purchase requisitions into purchase orders.
  • Maintain and update various data, including supplier data, in the ERP system.
  • Follow up on purchase orders, deliveries and invoice approvals.
  • Assist with various development-oriented Global Supply Chain tasks within BWSC, including work instructions and new workflows.

The work is carried out in close collaboration with other departments in a dynamic and project-oriented organization. A flexible, cooperative, and positive attitude is therefore essential.

Desired Background and Qualifications

  • Experience within procurement, including purchase order placement and follow-up.
  • Completed education as an office assistant and/or relevant higher education qualification.
  • Minimum 3 years of practical experience with technical or project procurement.
  • Strong written and spoken English skills.
  • Good IT skills and experience with ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
  • Ability to work in a structured manner and meet deadlines.

What do we offer? 

At BWSC we build inspiring careers locally and internationally and give you access to a great network of possibilities. 

We offer you a position with great colleagues and the opportunity to bring your skills into play and grow professionally and personally. As a Purchaser at BWSC, you will receive a competitive starting salary and a strong reward package.

We offer an exciting position in a skilled, collaborative, and project-driven work environment, with opportunities for professional development and growth.

We have a good canteen, fitness facilities, and an active Staff Club that organizes various events and activities. Our HQ is located in Allerød, close to the train station and only a 30-minute ride from central Copenhagen.

Ready for a challenge?  

We review applications and invite relevant candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Supply Chain Manager Anders S. A. Pedersen at asap@bwsc.dk.

BWSC is committed to promoting equality and diversity. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of ethnic background, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or age. Therefore, we do not recommend specifying age, etc., in the application. 

BWSC no longer receives or handles applications received via email due to GDPR requirements. In order for your application to be processed, you must submit your application via our online recruitment system. 

Get to know us even better on our website, www.bwsc.com, where you can learn more about our business, organization, project portfolio, and what we want to achieve at BWSC. 

About BWSC 

Burmeister & Wain Scandinavian Contractor A/S (BWSC) is a global power plant Operation & Maintenance and technical service provider with engineering expertise, enabling power plant owners to deliver cleaner and affordable energy. We are experts in servicing, upgrading, operating, and maintaining energy systems for diesel, natural gas, and renewable baseload power plants worldwide. We help our customers increase reliability and availability of energy production, improve efficiency and performance of their power plant, design and integrate future-proof technologies, and secure lower cost of maintenance.

Our people are at the core of everything we do and key to building strong relationships with our customers. We invest in our people and their wellbeing, supporting professional development and creating an environment where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and personal growth drive our continued success and growth as a company.

jobs.description:

Työnhakijoille ja tekijöille yrittäjävetoisuus tarkoittaa henkilökohtaisempaa ja välittävämpää palvelua sekä aitoa huolenpitoa. Tarjoamme räätälöityjä työ- ja uramahdollisuuksia – etsit sitten vakituista, määräaikaista tai osa-aikaista työtä.

jobs.title: Electrical Solutions Engineer, Data Centers
jobs.description:
Eltel Networks Oy is a leading provider of critical infrastructure services in the Nordics. We enable the digitalization and electrification of society through reliable solutions for power, communication and renewable energy networks.

Do you want to help deliver the next generation of critical infrastructure? Eltel is now looking for a driven and enthusiastic Electrical Solutions Engineer to join our growing Data Center team.

In this role, you will support our Data Center team in developing and evaluating electrical solutions for large-scale data center projects. Rather than focusing solely on design or reviewing the existing, you will help ensure that proposed solutions are technically robust, commercially competitive, and ready for successful execution. You will provide technical input for bids and supplier evaluations while ensuring that solutions reflect Finnish industry practices, utility requirements, and proven construction methods. Your involvement will not end at contract award; you will continue to support project teams throughout delivery, helping to evaluate design changes, resolve technical challenges during construction and commissioning, and ensure that all agreed modifications are accurately reflected in the final project documentation and handover package. You will work closely with solutions sales, suppliers, and site teams, helping bridge the gap between engineering and construction.

Your key responsibilities

-
Review electrical designs: Review electrical designs, models, and drawings from a contractor's perspective.

-
Assess layouts & feasibility: Assess equipment layouts, cable routing, and installation feasibility.

-
Discipline coordination: Support the coordination of electrical, mechanical, automation, and structural disciplines.

-
Technical calculations: Review electrical load calculations, cable sizing, equipment selections, and protection concepts.

-
Material Take-Offs: Prepare equipment and material take-offs, including cable quantities.

-
Tendering & Procurement support: Support technical tendering, procurement, and supplier evaluation activities.

-
Supplier documentation: Review supplier documentation and coordinate technical clarifications.

-
Technical issue resolution: Assist project teams in resolving technical issues during project execution.

-
Documentation update: Help ensure that design changes are correctly implemented in project documentation.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a technically strong, energetic, and solution-oriented procurement professional who loves velocity, excels in dynamic, fast-moving projects, and wants to grow within a leading infrastructure company.

We expect you to have:

-
Degree: B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

-
Industry understanding: Good understanding of electrical distribution systems and infrastructure projects.

-
Evaluation skills: Ability to review and evaluate technical solutions and documentation.

-
Problem-solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

-
Communication: Good communication skills and ability to work with multiple stakeholders.

-
Language skills: Fluency in Finnish is required; English language skills are considered an asset.

A workplace where people care and grow stronger together - Team spirit and peer support consistently receive high marks in Eltels employee surveys. At Eltel, people look out for one another, follow safety protocols, and ensure that everyone gets home safely every day. Together, we create a positive working environment and strive for a healthy work-life balance.

Support your professional development - At Eltel we support your professional growth from day one. We are proud of the long careers our employees have built at Eltel, and we are committed to supporting their career development.

jobs.description:
Tykkäätkö puuhata työpäiväsi IT-laitteiden parissa ja auttaa kollegoitasi niiden käytössä? Jos vastaat kyllä, saatat olla asiakkaamme Hansel Oy:n etsimä arjen pelastaja. Etsimme heille nyt vakituiseen työsuhteeseen

IT-ASIANTUNTIJAA

Hanselilaisia on noin 150, ja toimiva IT-infrastruktuuri on työssämme välttämättömyys. Etsimme nyt IT-asiantuntijaa varmistamaan, että työympäristömme on huippukunnossa ja kehittämään sitä koko ajan tekniikan aallonharjalla.

Sovit IT-asiantuntijaksi, jos

- saat laitteen kuin laitteen toimimaan sujuvasti

- olet näppärä tietoteknisten ongelmien ratkaisija

- pystyt työskentelemään paikan päällä Helsingin keskustassa

- hallitset sujuvasti sekä suomen että englannin kielen

- sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva IT-alan koulutus

Monipuoliseen työnkuvaasi sisältyvät muun muassa käyttäjätuki, ohjeistusten ylläpito sekä laitteiden käyttöönotot ja vaihdot. Vastaat myös laitehankinnoista ja siitä, että toimistollamme Postitalossa on tarvittava välineistö työpisteillä ja neuvotteluhuoneissa käytettävissä. Olet siis työkavereidesi luottohenkilö, joka on valmiina auttamaan.

Sinulle ovat tuttua termistöä esimerkiksi työssä käytettävät Intune, Autopilot ja Jira. Kehität mielelläsi omaa osaamistasi ja jaat oppeja muille. Tämä voi henkilökohtaisen neuvonnan lisäksi tarkoittaa esimerkiksi infojen järjestämistä tai videoiden tekemistä opetuskäyttöön. Kiinnostuksesi mukaan sinulla on mahdollisuus myös osallistua digitiimimme kehityshankkeisiin. Tärkeintä tässä työssä on kuitenkin aito halu tukea kollegoita IT-laitteiden sujuvassa käytössä.

Työ alkaa pikaisesti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Valittu henkilö tekee toistaiseksi voimassa olevan työsopimuksen StaffPointin kanssa.

Hakuohjeet ja lisätiedot:

Rekisteröidy hakijaksi www.staffpoint.fi ja täytä hakemus huolellisesti sekä liitä hakemukseesi CV:si. Tuothan hakemuksessasi esiin, miten vahvuutesi tukevat tehtävän eri painotuksia.


StaffPoint Oy

Olemme julkishallinnon yhteishankintayksikkö ja palvelujemme ytimen muodostavat siis yhteishankinnat. Meillä on yhteensä tarjolla yli sata puitejärjestelyä ja dynaamista hankintajärjestelmää, joista asiakkaamme voivat hankkia monipuolisesti tuotteita ja palveluja. Niitä on mukana tarjoamassa yli 800 sopimustoimittajaa. Yhteishankintojen lisäksi valikoimaamme kuuluvat hankintojen asiantuntijapalvelut: kilpailuttaminen ja kehittäminen.

Tavoitteenamme on säästää yhteiskunnan varoja lisäämällä tuottavuutta koko julkishallinnon hankintatoimeen. Toimintamme perustuu [Hansel-lakiin](https://www.finlex.fi/fi/laki/ajantasa/2008/20081096), jossa määritellään tehtävämme ja asiakkaamme. Olemme voittoa tavoittelematon osakeyhtiö, josta valtio omistaa 65 prosenttia ja Kuntaliitto 35 prosenttia. Toimintamme rahoitetaan sopimustoimittajilta perittävällä palvelumaksulla, joka perustuu asiakkaidemme yhteishankintojen kautta tekemiin hankintoihin.

jobs.title: Automotive Painter / Surface Treatment Specialist – ABS1 Oy, Lempäälä
jobs.description:
AUTOMOTIVE PAINTER / SURFACE TREATMENT SPECIALIST – ABS1 OY, LEMPÄÄLÄ

ABS1 Oy is a modern multi-brand vehicle repair shop located in Lempäälä, right next to Ideapark. The company services and repairs vehicles from a wide range of brands, with electric and hybrid vehicle servicing and repairs also playing an important role in its operations.

ABS1 has invested in modern facilities and equipment. The company moved into its new premises in April 2026, with seven vehicle lifts and brand-specific digital service systems for VAG Group, BMW and Mercedes-Benz vehicles.

At ABS1, professional skills, high-quality workmanship and good customer service are highly valued. The company offers a versatile working environment where you get to work with different types of vehicles and modern automotive technology.

ARE YOU AN AUTOMOTIVE PAINTER OR SURFACE TREATMENT SPECIALIST LOOKING FOR A ROLE WHERE YOU CAN WORK HANDS-ON, LEARN NEW SKILLS AND DEVELOP YOUR EXPERTISE?

As part of a new product line, ABS1 Oy is manufacturing fiberglass roof structures for vans, and we are now looking for an Automotive Painter / Surface Treatment Specialist to join the team.

You don't need to know everything from day one. If you have a solid foundation in surface treatment and some experience or training in spray painting, you're already off to a good start. Fiberglass lamination will be taught on the job.

At ABS1 Oy, you'll be part of a fair and supportive team where good work is appreciated and rewarded.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

You will be involved in the manufacturing of a new product and work with a variety of surface treatment tasks:

* cleaning and sanding surfaces

* filling and priming

* spray painting

* fiberglass lamination

Fiberglass lamination may be completely new to you – and that's perfectly fine. You will receive training and learn the process hands-on.

In this role, quality matters. Attention to detail, careful working and patience are directly reflected in the finished result, so this is a good fit for someone who takes pride in doing things properly.

WHAT KIND OF PERSON ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for a motivated and eager-to-learn professional who wants to develop their skills through practical work.

You have:

* vocational training and a solid foundation in surface treatment

* some experience or training in spray painting

* a careful and precise approach to your work

* a willingness to learn new things

* the ability to handle moderately physical work

Previous experience in fiberglass lamination is not required. What matters most is that you have a good foundation in surface treatment and are willing to learn.

You can work in Finnish or English – English alone is enough for this position.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Location: Lempäälä, Ideaparkinkatu 11
Working hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00–16:00, 37.5 hours/week
Salary: €2,300–€2,500/month, depending on experience and skills
Start: As soon as the right person is found
Employment: Permanent employment through Worknow

ABS1 Oy also has another location at Ideaparkinkatu 2. The workplace is easily accessible by public transport, with a bus stop nearby.

INTERESTED? APPLY NOW!

jobs.description:
Primary location:
SEINÄJOKI

Tykkäätkö yöelämän sykkeestä, hyvästä meiningistä ja ihmisten kohtaamisesta? Nyt olisi tarjolla duunia yökerhon vauhdikkaassa ympäristössä pikkujoulusesongin ajaksi!

Haemme TARJOILIJAA ravintola Karmaan, Seinäjoelle
Etsimme energistä ja reipasta tarjoilijaa määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen pikkujoulusesongin ajaksi 10.1.2027 saakka. Työtunteja on keskimäärin 25h/3 vkoa.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?
Työ iltaravintolassa on vauhdikasta, vaihtelevaa ja täynnä erilaisia asiakaskohtaamisia. Työssä palvelet asiakkaita, luot hyvää fiilistä, tarjoilet juomia ja huolehdit yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa siitä, että ilta sujuu mukavasti. Tarjoamme sinulle rennon yökerhoympäristön, mukavan ja energisen työporukan sekä mahdollisuuden kartuttaa kokemusta ravintola-alalta. Hommia tehdään viikonloppuisin ja yöaikaan - meillä tehdään töitä silloin kun muut juhlivat.


🔥 Mitä toivomme sinulta?
Iloista asennetta ja asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä
Reipasta otetta ja kykyä toimia kiireessä
Joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen
Täysi- ikäisyyttä
Hygienia ja anniskelupassi ovat plussaa
Asiakaspalvelutilanteissa kommunikointikykyä suomenkielellä
Kokemus ravintola-alalta on plussaa, mutta ennen kaikkea asenne ratkaisee!


🎉 Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
Me Eepeellä sanomme olevamme Ihan tavallisissa töissä. Työtä kuvaillaan usein erilaisin korulausein, jotka toivottavasti ovat myös totta, mutta meidän mielestämme ihan tavallinen työ on mahtavaa. Työ ravintola-alalla on vaihtelevaa, toisinaan vaativaa ja aina mielenkiintoista – mutta tekijälleen se on arkea, sitä ihan tavallista työelämää. Ja arki ravintolassa on tunnetusti vauhdikasta!

Erityisen hyvät henkilöstöedut! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai henksuhintainen hotellihuone viikonlopuksi? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista S-ryhmän ja Eepeen henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakuatäältä.
Koko henkilöstöämme koskevatulospalkkiojärjestelmän
Kattavat työterveyspalvelut sekä liikunnan, kulttuurin ja hyvinvoinninEpassi-edut
Eepeenja S-ryhmän koulutus- ja uramahdollisuudet
Poikkeuksellisen paljon mahdollisuuksia! Voit vaihtaa ammattia, toimialaa tai ottaa lisätyötä oman osaamisesi ja toiveidesi mukaan


Kiinnostuitko? Tämä homma sopii sinulle, joka viihdyt yövuoroissa ja nautit vauhdikkaasta menosta! Laita hakemusta tulemaan ja kerro meille hieman itsestäsi sekä siitä, miksi juuri sinä olisit meidän tiimiimme sopiva tyyppi! Työt alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, mahdollisimman pian.

Hakemukset sähköisen hakulinkin kautta. Haku avoinna 27.10.2026 saakka. Käsittelemme hakemuksia ja teemme valintoja jo hakuaikana.
Jäikö jokin mietityttämään? Henna kertoo mielellään lisää tehtävästä.
Henna Korhonen, ravintolapäällikkö
Henna.korhonen@sok.fi // 010 76 47061

***********************************************************
Etelä-Pohjanmaan Osuuskauppa on monipuolinen työpaikka!

Eepee on osuuskauppa,jonka omistavat sen yli 97 000 asiakasomistajaa. Tarjoamme toimialueellamme työpaikan 1300 palvelualan ammattilaiselle 71 toimipaikassamme.

Eepeellä teemme ihan tavallisia töitä. Tavallisuus on voima, joka erottaa meidät muista. Meillä työ ei ole vain peruspesti, mutta samalla se on juuri sitä. Tavallinen työ on sitä, mitä pitääkin olla – tehokasta, arvokasta ja tärkeää. Ihan tavallisen työn lisäksi, meillä on epätavallisen hyvät edut ja poikkeuksellisen mahtavat työkaverit. Tutustu meihin paremmin ja kurkkaa, mitä tulevat työkaverisi kertovat työstään – ehkä seuraava tarina on sinun.

jobs.title: Diætist eller kok med interesse for sundhed og ernæring
jobs.description:
Vi er en familie på 3 som søger en privat kok. Dit primære fokus er at lave varieret, sund og velsmagende mad fra bunden, som lever op til en række krav, herunder fx

  • Øko som udgangspunkt

  • Min 125 g fed fisk om dagen

  • Min 200g kål om dagen

  • Min 50 g bær om dagen

  • Min 35g protein per måltid

  • Monitorering af kalorieindtag

Som følge heraf kræver det, at du kan trives med at måle og veje maden.

Du skal kunne lide at nørde mad ned i detaljen, og hvis emnet “longevity” fra et ernæringsmæssigt synspunkt interesserer dig, er det et plus.

Det er et job, hvor du udfylder alle roller omkring madlavningen: indkøb, klargøring, anretning, servering, rengøring og oprydning.

Egen bil, samt at du er villig til at bruge denne til indkøb er et must.

Arbejdstiden er 20-25 timer per uge og ligger som udgangspunkt i tidsrummet 8.30-13.30 man-fre, men noget vi aftaler løbende. Weekendarbejde kan forekomme, og er igen noget vi aftaler. Ferie som udgangspunkt, når vi selv holder ferie.

Om os:

Vi har faciliteterne i orden til at tilbyde et professionelt køkkensetup. Vi har tidligere haft en privat kok, som lavede super velsmagende mad, men vi måtte sande at det sundhedsmæssige aspekt led en del i denne periode, da der blev serveret for meget og for usund mad. Derfor vil vi gerne forsøge igen med et nyt fokus, hvor sundheden i hverdagsmaden har det primære fokus, og din evne til at trylle i køkkenet til et middagsselskab i ny og næ kommer mere i anden række - til trods for, at vi er madentusiaster og bestemt også værdsætter en god middag, hvor der ikke er sparet på noget.

jobs.title: Expression of Interest - Offshore Helicopter Pilots
jobs.description:
Join Our Pilot Pool for Future Opportunities

At Avincis, we are proud to support the green energy transition by providing safe and efficient helicopter transport to offshore wind farms and associated installations.

As the offshore wind industry continues to grow, we are preparing for potential future expansion of our operations in Denmark and Northern Germany. We are therefore interested in connecting with experienced helicopter pilots who may wish to join our team as new opportunities arise.

---

Please note that this is not an active vacancy. We are building a network of qualified helicopter pilots who may be interested in future opportunities within our operations. Candidates whose qualifications and experience match our requirements may be contacted as suitable positions become available.

About the Opportunity

Pilots joining Avincis operate Airbus H135 and H145 helicopters in support of offshore wind operations, including:

  • Personnel transport to offshore wind farms and vessels

  • Crew change operations

  • Equipment transport

  • Offshore hoist operations

  • IFR and offshore flight operations

Our current Danish bases include Esbjerg, Roskilde, Grenaa and Thorsminde, supporting some of Northern Europe's largest offshore wind projects.

While no positions are currently guaranteed, candidates meeting our requirements may be contacted regarding future opportunities as business needs develop.

Who We Are Looking For

Minimum Qualifications

  • EASA ATPL(H) or CPL(H) with IR(H)

  • EASA Class 1 Medical

  • English Language Proficiency Level 6

  • Minimum 2,000 hours total helicopter flight time, including:

    • 1,000 hours PIC

    • 500 hours PIC Multi Engine

    • 500 hours offshore helicopter experience

Highly Desirable Experience

  • Offshore HHO experience

  • IFR operations

  • Airbus H135 or H145 experience

  • MCC / Multi-Pilot qualification

  • Residence in Denmark or the surrounding region

Why Register Your Interest?

By joining our pilot pool, you will:

  • Be among the first candidates considered for future opportunities

  • Connect with a leading offshore helicopter operator

  • Become part of an organization committed to safety, professionalism and operational excellence

  • Explore future opportunities within both Avincis Denmark and the wider Avincis Group

How to Apply

Please upload:

  • CV

  • Relevant licences

  • Certificates

Candidates meeting the qualification requirements may be invited to provide additional documentation regarding aeronautical experience and qualifications.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and retained for consideration in connection with future recruitment processes.

Lasten oikeudet, osallisuus ja lapsiperheiden hyvinvointi ovat meille ensisijaisia toimiessamme yhteistyössä perhehoitajien, vanhempien ja yhteistyöverkostojen kanssa.

Koulutusvaatimuksena tehtävään on ylempi korkeakoulututkinto, valtiotieteiden tai yhteiskuntatieteiden maisteri, johon sisältyy tai jonka lisäksi on suoritettu riittävät sosiaalityön opinnot (sosiaalityöntekijän pätevyys vaaditaan). Edellytämme vähintään 2 vuoden kokemusta lastensuojelun avo- tai sijaishuollosta, minkä lisäksi sekä monipuolinen perhehoidon kentän tuntemus että lasten ja perheiden parista hankittu kokemus katsotaan eduksi.

Perhehoidon sosiaalityöntekijänä osallistut sijais- ja tukiperheiden rekrytointiin, valmentamiseen ja tukemiseen. Vastaat asiakasprosessien suunnittelusta ja tavoitteiden mukaisesta toteutumisesta. Perhehoidon sosiaalityöntekijänä kuulut Pohjanmaan moniammatilliseen lastensuojelutyöryhmään, ja työtäsi tukee lisäksi valtakunnallinen perhehoidon tiimi.

Meille Familarin Pohjanmaan perhehoitopalveluissa on tärkeää sekä asiakkaiden että työntekijöiden hyvinvointi.

Tarjoamme sinulle:
-mielenkiintoisen työn, jonka sisältöön pystyt myös jonkin verran itse vaikuttamaan
-joustotyöajan
-tehokkaan ja toimeliaan työtiimin, jossa kaveria autetaan ja tuetaan
-hauskan työporukan, jossa työtä tehdään sydämellä ja lapsen etua ajatellen
-mahdollisuuden päästä kehittämään ja vakiinnuttamaan alueellisesti sekä valtakunnallisesti perhehoitopalvelujen toimintaa
-mahdollisuuden osallistua monipuolisesti täydennyskoulutuksiin
-liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun, työterveyshuollon ja Mehiläisen digiklinikan palvelut 24/7
-yhteistyöverkostomme kautta kattavasti henkilöstöetuja ja -alennuksia erilaisista tuotteista ja palveluista

Monissa työpaikkailmoituksissa etsitään superihmistä.
Me etsimme ihan vaan Ihmistä isolla I:llä.

Meille tärkeää on, että:
-lasten oikeudet, osallisuus ja lapsiperheiden hyvinvointi ovat sinulle tärkeitä arvoja ja näkyvät työskentelyssäsi
-teet työtäsi inhimillisellä asenteella ja olet taitava kohtaamaan ihmisiä
-olet valmis oppimaan uutta, kehittymään ja kehittämään myös työskentelyämme
-pystyt suhtautumaan joustavalla mielellä yllättäviin ja muuttuviin tilanteisiin
-olet toimeen tarttuva tyyppi ja luotettava työkaveri, eikä huumorintajukaan olisi pahitteeksi.
-sinulla on ymmärrystä lapsen kehityksestä ja perheiden tukityöstä

Sosiaalityöntekijän tehtävä tulee asettumaan Pohjanmaan tiimiin, jonka toimisto sijaitsee Seinäjoella. Pääsääntöisesti matkustus tapahtuu Pohjanmaan alueella ja työhön sisältyy sekä jonkin verran ilta- ja viikonlopputöitä. Edellytämme sinulta ajokorttia ja mahdollisuutta oman auton käyttöön. Meillä on mahdollisuus työskennellä joustavasti etätöissä tai toimistolta käsin.

Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämistä koskevan lain (504/2002) edellyttämä rikosrekisteriote.

Haastattelut järjestetään Seinäjoella ja niitä voidaan järjestää jo hakuaikana, joten laitathan hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään su 8.11.2026.

jobs.title: SAP Basis Specialist, Espoo
jobs.description:
About the role

In this role, you will work at an important interface between internal stakeholders and the SAP technical team. The role is suitable for someone who already has some practical experience with SAP environments or other similar technical maintenance and support work, and who wants to further grow their expertise alongside more experienced specialists.

We offer a competitive salary (approx. €2,800–€4,000/month), the opportunity for significant professional development, and learning with the support of experienced colleagues. You will receive comprehensive onboarding and a flexible working model that considers work-life balance. You will work as part of a supportive team where everyone's contribution is valued.

Work tasks

Your main duty will be to ensure the stable and efficient operation of the SAP production environment through continuous maintenance and monitoring. The job involves close cooperation with an external SAP team, ticket management, and system configuration, offering an opportunity to deepen your expertise as a SAP Basis specialist.

In your role, you will be responsible for, among other things:
- Daily maintenance of the SAP environment and supporting production continuity
- Monitoring, troubleshooting error situations, and analyzing technical problems
- Cooperation with the SAP ECS team and managing necessary tickets in the SAP for Me environment
- Coordinating maintenance breaks, downtimes, and other technical changes
- Supporting the deployment of transports to production
- Individual system setting changes and service activations
- Coordinating technical observations and measures with different stakeholders

We are looking for

What we hope from you

In this role, the most important thing is not a perfect list of all SAP Basis expertise areas, but the ability to get involved in technical daily operations and learn quickly. So you are not necessarily a senior yet, but not quite at the beginning of your career either. You have already seen enough of practical IT or SAP environments to work independently without constant hands-on guidance.

You might be the person we are looking for if you have
- already some experience in SAP Basis tasks, technical application support, or a similar maintenance environment
- a technical mindset and the ability to understand where problems may originate from
- readiness to investigate, learn, and take responsibility for practical work
- ability to work in English
- possibility to work in a hybrid model in Espoo (after onboarding 2-3 days/week remotely ok)

We consider it an advantage if you have experience in, for example
- SAP Basis maintenance
- SAP for Me tool
- monitoring, analyzing short dump errors, and investigating error situations
- transport management
- security note implementations
- EarlyWatch or Cloud ALM environments – ownership of this
- system or client copy operations
- knowledge of ABAP basics

We Offer You
- an opportunity to work in an interesting and business-critical SAP environment
- a role where you get to grow your expertise through hands-on work
- an expert team and collaboration with experienced SAP professionals
- a hybrid work model: work is done mainly in Espoo, at least 2–3 days a week at the office, more during the onboarding phase
- a salary of approx. €2,800–€4,000/month depending on expertise and experience, and for very experienced specialists, the level can be higher

Other Good to Know Information
- The role occasionally involves on-call situations related to maintenance breaks in the evenings or on weekends. These occur a few times a year, but during these times we hope for readiness to be at the computer if necessary
- A security clearance will be conducted for the person selected for the position
- Start date is as soon as possible after finding a suitable person

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Sales Executive - Ready to turn Software/ERP expertise into closed deals? Interform HQ Birkerød, DK or Remote
jobs.description:
The role

Interform builds InterformNG2, an Output Management platform that sits next to the ERP and handles the documents a business runs on: invoices, labels, delivery notes, e-invoicing. When output fails, shipments stop and invoices get rejected. Our customers buy certainty that this never happens.

You will sell InterformNG2 to new customers across Europe - with our core markets in the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux and the UK - typically manufacturing, logistics and distribution companies running ERPs such as Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or IBM i. You own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed agreement.

There is no BDR team here, but you are not starting from a blank sheet either. We identify the most relevant accounts together, backed by an AI-driven engine that tracks buying signals across our markets. Your job is what happens next: the outreach, the conversations, the proposals and the close.

What you will do

  • Turn qualified target accounts into meetings, pipeline and closed deals across your European territory.

  • Open doors through direct outreach and your own network of ERP consultants, partners and IT decision-makers.

  • Run full sales cycles - qualification, demo coordination, proposal, negotiation, close - in close collaboration with the rest of the commercial team.

  • Work with our partner ecosystem around Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i and other ERP platforms as a second route to market.

  • Feed what you learn in the market back into how we position and price.

Who you are

  • Driven. You show up every day ready to do your best, and you keep that standard through long sales cycles.

  • Connected in the ERP ecosystem. Ecosystem knowledge is essential in this role: you know at least one major ERP ecosystem in real depth - the partners and implementation consultants in it, how they influence a deal and when to bring them in - and you bring a working network you can call on from day one.

  • Self-starting. You plan your own work, execute without being chased, and deliver.

  • Accountable. You own your number and you follow up - customers can trust that you are always a step ahead.

  • At home in the ERP world. You have sold software or services into environments running Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i or comparable ERP platforms, and you speak the language of IT managers and operations directors.

  • AI-forward. You already use AI in your daily sales work - research, preparation, follow-up - and want a company that works the same way.

  • A closer. You have proven you can turn outreach into pipeline and pipeline into signed deals - not just manage inbound.

  • Languages: fluent English is required. German, Danish or Dutch on top is a strong advantage - ideally you cover one of our core markets natively.

What we offer

  • A place in a solid company: profitable, in strong growth, and with a large market still ahead of us.

  • A product that is easy to stand behind: more than 4,500 installations worldwide, and customers who stay.

  • A defined category - Output Management - where we compete on depth, not noise.

  • Short decision paths and direct access to management.

  • An AI-driven account-based marketing engine that shows you which companies are in the market - so your time goes to conversations, not list-building.

  • A competitive package that rewards what you close.

About Interform A/S

Interform has built Output Management software since 1987 from our headquarters in Birkerød, Denmark. Our platform, InterformNG2, works with any ERP, any format and any environment - customers change or upgrade their ERP and keep their output running. Our first customer from 1987 is still with us today. Our customer base is international - companies across the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux, the UK and further afield - and our own team works across borders in the same way, with colleagues based in Denmark and Germany. We are a profitable, solidly run company in strong growth, and investment backing supports continued development of the platform.

Practical details

  • Location: our office in Birkerød, Denmark, or remote from anywhere in our European markets - we already have employees working outside Denmark, so a distributed setup is nothing new to us.

  • Travel: limited. Most sales work runs remotely, with occasional customer, partner and event travel.

  • Reports to: our Chief Commercial Officer - you will work alongside the rest of the commercial team.

  • Start: as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

How to apply

Upload your CV and cover letter, including the deals you are most proud of.

Birkerød I Remote

jobs.title: SØKER ERFARNE BILLAKKERERE OG -OPPRETTERE
jobs.description:
Øyvind Lambes vei 17 AS søker etter fagfolk på vegne av tilknyttet og nyetablert aksjeselskap Sandnessjøen Bilskade. Selskapet etableres i leide lokaler i Øyvind Lambesvei 17 som består av flere bedrifter, grunder- og fagmiljø. Fagstillingene søkes til framtidsrettet skade- og lakkverksted i byen.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som:

● Har fagbrev som billakkerer, eller solid relevant erfaring

● Har erfaring fra skade- og lakkverksted

● Arbeider selvstendig, effektivt og nøyaktig

● Er kvalitetsbevisst og har yrkesstolthet

● Er løsningsorientert og samarbeider godt med andre

● Har førerkort klasse B

● Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for manglende fagbrev.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver BILLAKKERER:

● Forarbeid, sliping, sparkling, maskering og grunning

● Lakkering av biler og løse deler

● Fargeblanding og fargetilpasning

● Reparasjon av små og større lakkskader

● Etterarbeid og kvalitetskontroll

● Samarbeid med biloppretter og øvrige medarbeidere

● Bidra til god produksjonsflyt, orden og HMS på verkstedet

Vi tilbyr

● Faste og heltids stillinger

● Konkurransedyktige lønnsbetingelser

● Moderne verksted og godt utstyr

● Varierte arbeidsoppgaver

● Mulighet til å påvirke og forme en helt ny arbeidsplass

● Et lite og godt fagmiljø med korte beslutningsveier

● Gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og en sentral rolle i oppbyggingen av aksjeselskapet Sandnessjøen Bilskade

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sandnessjøen Bilskade (SUS) er et nyetablert aksjeselskap. Selskapet etableres i spennende fagmiljø i Sandnessjøen, og samlokaliseres med bl.a. bil- og verkstedservice.

Selskapet søker 3-4 fagstillinger som lakkerer, biloppretteter og/eller bilskadeoperatør.

Selskapet ledelse har mangeårig erfaring og kompetanse innen fag-områdene på Helgeland. Selskapet søker erfarne og dyktige fagfolk. Ansatte, ledelse og eiere vil bli del av et nytt fagmiljø i byen og får mulighet til å bygge både verksted- og arbeidsprosesser.

Det installeres helt ny og komplett lakeringsboks.
