jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Business Management Support - CEO Office (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:


Executive Assistant


Pour l'un de nos clients, acteur bancaire de premier plan au Luxembourg, nous recherchons un(e) Executive Assistant & Business Management Support pour rejoindre l'environnement direct du CEO et de son Executive Office.


A PROPOS DU POSTE

Vous avez déjà acquis une première expérience solide dans un environnement exigeant, idéalement au sein d'un Big4, d'un cabinet de conseil, d'un cabinet d'avocats ou du secteur financier, et vous souhaitez aujourd'hui vous rapprocher du cœur des décisions d'une organisation ?

Cette opportunité va au-delà d'un poste classique d'Executive Assistant.

Aux côtés du CEO et de son environnement exécutif, vous combinez support de haut niveau, coordination, préparation de supports et suivi de sujets stratégiques et opérationnels.

Votre rôle : permettre au CEO d'être organisé, préparé et concentré sur ses priorités, tout en assurant un suivi rigoureux des informations, demandes et actions qui gravitent autour de l'Executive Office.

Il s'agit d'une fonction particulièrement intéressante pour un profil ayant environ 5 années d'expérience, souhaitant continuer à apprendre, gagner en exposition et évoluer progressivement vers des responsabilités plus larges de Business Management / Executive Office.


VOTRE RÔLE ET RESPONSABILITES:
Executive Support & organisation

Vous assurez un support quotidien fluide et structuré auprès du CEO et de son environnement exécutif :

    gestion proactive d'un agenda complexe et mouvant ;
    organisation et coordination des réunions internes et externes ;
    préparation des rendez-vous, agendas et documents nécessaires ;
    anticipation des échéances et identification des priorités ;
    coordination des déplacements professionnels et de leur logistique ;
    gestion des notes de frais, factures et autres sujets administratifs associés.

Vous ne vous contentez pas d'organiser : vous anticipez, identifiez les conflits de priorité et proposez des solutions.
Business Management & coordination

Une partie importante de votre rôle consiste à faciliter le fonctionnement de l'Executive Office.

À ce titre, vous :

    assurez le suivi des actions et décisions prises lors des réunions ;
    sollicitez les différentes parties prenantes afin d'obtenir les informations attendues ;
    consolidez des informations provenant de plusieurs interlocuteurs ;
    structurez ces éléments afin de les rendre immédiatement exploitables par le CEO ;
    maintenez des trackers et outils de suivi permettant de donner de la visibilité sur l'avancement des différents sujets ;
    contribuez à la coordination de projets et initiatives transverses ;
    identifiez les échéances ou sujets nécessitant une attention particulière et les faites remonter de manière proactive.

Votre capacité à comprendre rapidement un sujet, structurer l'information et assurer le suivi jusqu'à sa finalisation fera réellement la différence.
Executive Communication & préparation de supports

Vous contribuez directement à la qualité des informations et documents utilisés au niveau exécutif :

    préparation et mise en forme de présentations PowerPoint ;
    préparation de briefings, notes de synthèse et meeting packs ;
    consolidation de données et préparation de reportings simples sous Excel ;
    rédaction, relecture et adaptation de communications en français et en anglais ;
    préparation et organisation de documents destinés à des réunions de management ou de gouvernance.

Vous savez transformer une quantité importante d'informations en un support clair, synthétique et orienté décision.
Coordination & stakeholder management

Positionné(e) au cœur de l'organisation, vous êtes en interaction avec de nombreux interlocuteurs internes et externes.

Vous assurez une communication fluide et professionnelle, relancez lorsque nécessaire et savez adapter votre approche à des interlocuteurs de niveaux de séniorité différents.

La confidentialité, la diplomatie et la qualité de votre communication sont essentielles dans cette fonction.


Vous avez idéalement :

    un Bachelor ou Master en gestion, économie, management ou formation équivalente ;
    environ 5 années d'expérience professionnelle dans une fonction d'Executive Assistant, Business Support, PMO, Executive Office ou une fonction comparable ;
    une expérience acquise dans un Big4 ou un environnement de conseil/professional services exigeant, fortement appréciée ;
    l'habitude de travailler directement avec des Partners, Managing Directors, membres de direction ou autres senior executives ;
    une excellente maîtrise de PowerPoint, avec la capacité de produire des présentations professionnelles et structurées ;
    une bonne maîtrise d'Excel et des outils de suivi/reporting ;
    d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse ;
    une parfaite maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l'anglais ; le luxembourgeois constitue un atout.

Au-delà de votre expérience, nous recherchons surtout une personnalité.

Vous êtes structuré(e), fiable et extrêmement organisé(e), mais également curieux(se) et capable de comprendre ce qui se joue derrière une demande.

Vous savez travailler dans un environnement où les priorités peuvent changer rapidement, sans perdre en qualité ni en précision.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec des interlocuteurs seniors tout en conservant une posture professionnelle et naturelle.

Enfin, vous recherchez un poste dans lequel vous pourrez apprendre, prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités et développer une compréhension transverse du fonctionnement d'une banque et de son Executive Management.

jobs.title: R&D Engineer – VR User Interface Developer (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST E.P.
jobs.description:
SD-26153 R&T ENGINEER - VR USER INTERFACE DEVELOPER

Fixed term contract | Belval | 2.5 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

We are looking for a skilled and hands-on VR User Interface Developer to join a short-term research and development project. The successful candidate will design and implement an immersive user interface running on a VR headset and connect it to a robot digital twin. The interface will enable users to visualise the robot, access relevant operational information, and interact with the digital-twin environment in an intuitive and reliable way. The role combines virtual-reality development, user-interface engineering, 3D interaction design, and integration with robotics or simulation software.

Key tasks:

·       Designing and developing an immersive user interface for a VR headset.
·      Implementing intuitive 3D interactions, menus, dashboards, status indicators, controls, and notifications.
·      Integrating the VR interface with a robot digital twin and its underlying simulation or robotics platform.
·       Visualising relevant robot and system information, such as robot position, operating mode, sensor data, alerts, and task progress.
·       Supporting user interaction with the robot digital twin, including monitoring, exploration, and, where applicable, control functionalities.
·       Developing the application using a suitable real-time 3D engine, such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
·       Testing and optimising the interface on the target VR headset, with particular attention to usability, reliability, and performance.
·       Collaborating with researchers, robotics engineers, software developers, and user-experience specialists.
·       Maintaining the source code and preparing technical documentation covering the architecture, installation, configuration, and integration procedures.
·       Delivering a functional and demonstrable prototype within the three-month assignment.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

·          University degree or equivalent professional experience in computer science, software engineering, game development, robotics, human-computer interaction, or a related field.
·          Knowledge of software development, 3D visualisation, virtual reality, and user-interface design.

Language skills

•               Fluency in English (and French), both oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits

·          An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
·          Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
·          Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
·          An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
·          Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
·          Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
·          Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
·          Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
·          32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
·          Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

Your application must include:

·          A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
·          A CV with contact details
Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.
As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements
For the purposes of the position and in accordance with applicable legislation, the successful candidate may be requested to provide a recent criminal record certificate.

This position offers a gross monthly salary between €5043 and €6586, paid over 13 months (€65.559–€85.618 annually) based on full time employment. The final salary offer within this range will be determined based on the candidate's overall profile, qualifications and professional experience. For part time employment, the salary is adjusted pro rata.

jobs.title: Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (h/f)
jobs.description:
Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F) – Région Liège-Luxembourg

Reference: LU879641
Luxembourg
Permanent
Legal and Professional Services

Notre client est un cabinet de conseil international fondé au début des années 2000 et aujourd'hui présent dans plusieurs pays européens.
Sa mission est d'accompagner les entreprises dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs en délivrant des résultats mesurables et concrets.
Son expertise couvre l'excellence opérationnelle, l'optimisation de la supply chain, la data, la conduite du changement, la transformation digitale et la transition durable.

Le cabinet intervient auprès d'organisations de premier plan dans des secteurs variés tels que l'industrie, les sciences de la vie, le secteur public, les services financiers, le retail et la construction.
Dans un contexte où les transformations numériques s'accélèrent et où les DSI, CIO et CTO jouent un rôle croissant dans la définition de la stratégie des entreprises, notre client souhaite aujourd'hui franchir une nouvelle étape avec la création et le développement d'une practice CIO Advisory.

Cette practice a vocation à devenir un axe majeur du développement du cabinet, en accompagnant les dirigeants IT et les directions générales dans leurs réflexions et transformations stratégiques, organisationnelles et technologiques.
Pour accompagner sa croissance et participer à des projets de transformation et d'excellence opérationnelle, notre client recherche actuellement un(e) Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F).

Votre rôle

En tant que Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory, vous aurez la responsabilité de piloter et délivrer des missions de transformation IT à fort impact, tout en contribuant au développement de la practice, de son portefeuille clients et de ses équipes.
Vous interviendrez directement auprès des CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, de la définition des orientations jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre, avec une forte exigence de résultats, de qualité de delivery et d'impact durable.

Pilotage et delivery des missions clients

Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conduite et la réussite des missions de la practice :

• Piloter des missions complexes de stratégie et transformation IT, de leur cadrage jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre.
• Accompagner les clients dans la définition de leur vision cible IT et sa déclinaison en feuilles de route concrètes et opérationnelles.
• Superviser les diagnostics, analyses, recommandations et plans de transformation réalisés par les équipes.
• Challenger les organisations, processus, architectures et modes de fonctionnement IT afin d'identifier les leviers de performance et de transformation.
• Assurer la qualité des livrables, le respect des engagements et l'atteinte des résultats attendus.
• Intervenir directement auprès des instances de direction et accompagner les clients dans leurs décisions stratégiques.
• Sécuriser l'exécution des transformations et accompagner les équipes clients jusqu'à l'obtention de résultats durables.
Développement et structuration de la practice

En vous appuyant sur les besoins rencontrés sur le terrain, vous contribuerez à faire évoluer et structurer l'offre CIO Advisory :

• Développer des méthodologies et approches permettant de transformer l'expertise acquise en mission en offres structurées et réplicables.
• Identifier les nouvelles problématiques rencontrées par les CIO et faire évoluer l'offre en conséquence.
• Développer des synergies avec les autres expertises du cabinet : cybersécurité, data, ERP, cloud, transformation et excellence opérationnelle.
• Contribuer au positionnement et au développement de la practice au sein de mon client.
Développement commercial et relation client
Le développement commercial s'inscrira dans la continuité de votre activité de conseil et de votre proximité avec les clients :
• Développer des relations de confiance durables avec les CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités à partir des enjeux et besoins rencontrés chez les clients.
• Construire et développer un portefeuille de missions CIO Advisory.
• Piloter les avant-ventes, propositions commerciales, appels d'offres et soutenances.
• Développer le cross-selling avec les autres practices et contribuer à la croissance du cabinet.

Leadership et développement des équipes

En tant que Directeur, vous serez également responsable de la qualité et du développement des équipes intervenant sur vos missions :

• Encadrer les équipes et leur apporter le niveau de guidance nécessaire à la réussite des missions.
• Challenger les analyses, recommandations et livrables afin de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence.
• Accompagner les consultants dans leur montée en compétences et leur capacité à prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités en delivery.
• Transmettre votre expertise à travers le coaching, le mentoring et le partage d'expérience.
• Contribuer au recrutement et au développement des expertises nécessaires à la croissance de la practice.
• Développer une culture fondée sur l'excellence du delivery, le pragmatisme, la collaboration et l'obtention de résultats concrets.

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons avant tout un leader entrepreneurial, capable de combiner expertise technique, excellence du delivery et développement commercial.

Vous disposez idéalement de :

• Une formation de niveau Master (Bac+5), idéalement issue d'une école d'ingénieurs, d'une université ou d'une grande école avec une spécialisation IT, digitale ou technologique.
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans le conseil, la transformation IT ou des environnements technologiques complexes.
• De solides compétences techniques et une forte compréhension des enjeux IT, vous permettant de challenger des architectures, des organisations, des choix technologiques et des trajectoires de transformation.
• Une expertise sur plusieurs dimensions du CIO Advisory : stratégie IT, operating model, cloud, infrastructures, architecture, cybersécurité, data, modernisation ou rationalisation des systèmes d'information.
• Une expérience significative dans le pilotage et le delivery de missions complexes, depuis le cadrage stratégique jusqu'à la mise en œuvre.
• Une expérience solide auprès de CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, avec la capacité à intervenir comme interlocuteur de confiance sur des problématiques stratégiques et techniques.
• Une réelle capacité à développer du business : identification d'opportunités, développement de comptes, construction de propositions commerciales, soutenances et développement de nouvelles missions.
• Une forte capacité à développer et entretenir des relations de confiance avec des décideurs de haut niveau.
• Un fort esprit entrepreneurial, avec l'envie de construire, structurer et faire grandir une activité.
• Une excellente communication, une forte posture de conseil et une capacité à embarquer clients et équipes.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer Operations (F/M/X)
jobs.description:
Job area:  Quality Management

Type of Contract:  Permanent

1 Op der Ahlkërrech, Grevenmacher, Luxembourg


Quality Engineer Operation (f/m/x)

Make individual mobility more enjoyable and sustainable by advancing technology and people – As one of the top 100 automotive suppliers worldwide, Webasto actively shapes the transformation of the industry through expertise and forward-thinking solutions. Our goal is to make mobility a full sensory experience, working toward more comfort, wind in your hair, the perfect temperature in any season, and driving with a clear conscience – for a safe and sustainable future. We bring joy to mobility – are you in?

You can look forward to these exciting tasks:

    Ensure product and process quality in serial production by monitoring quality performance, driving containment actions, and supporting stable manufacturing processes
    Lead problem-solving and root cause analysis activities for internal defects, customer complaints, and process deviations using structured quality methods
    Act as a core team member on the shopfloor, coordinating quality-related actions with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Maintenance, and Supply Chain to achieve operational targets
    Manage quality improvement initiatives and quality systems, including audits, corrective actions, deviations, rework approvals, and continuous improvement activities
    Serve as the interface between operations and customer quality, ensuring customer requirements are translated into effective production controls and quality standards



This is what you bring to us:

    Bachelor's degree in engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing Engineering, or a comparable technical field
    Several years of experience in quality engineering within a manufacturing environment, preferably automotive or automotive supplier industry
    Strong knowledge of quality management systems and problem-solving methodologies (IATF 16949, VDA, 8D, FMEA, SPC, Control Plan, 5 Why, Six Sigma)
    Excellent analytical and communication skills with the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and drive corrective actions
    Fluent English skills and confident use of quality and data analysis tools (e.g., SAP, Power BI, Minitab, MS Office); German and/or French are considered an advantage

Applications from qualified individuals with disabilities are expressly welcome.

jobs.title: Remote Office Assistant

Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade

  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

jobs.title: Early Childhood Education Teacher (recruitment from abroad, permanent position in public sector daycare))
jobs.description:
Hello, Early Childhood Education Teachers! Are you interested in working in a public daycare in Finland, known for its high-quality education system? We offer a permanent full-time position, competitive salary, great employee benefits, free Finnish language training, apartment, relocation support, and a clear pathway to living and working in Finland. Whether you are an experienced Early Childhood Education Teacher or newly qualified, we at the City of Helsinki would be delighted to hear from you!

In Finland, ECE teachers are highly trusted professionals. You have significant autonomy in planning pedagogical activities and are encouraged to use your professional expertise in everyday work. You support the holistic development of children aged 0-6 in an inclusive, child-centred environment. You work in a multi-professional team, sharing responsibility for childrens wellbeing and learning.

In Finland, ECE is part of the national education system and follows the Educare model, integrating care, education and teaching (read more from the Finnish National Agency for Education: https://www.oph.fi/en/education-system/early-childhood-education-and-care-finland). In practice, this means that:
Every moment is pedagogical
Play is the foundation of learning
Learning happens throughout the whole day
Nature and outdoor environments are used yearround
Childrens interests and questions guide learning

Your core responsibilities:
Plan, implement and assess play-based learning activities
Lead your groups pedagogical work together with childcare nurses
Observe and document childrens learning and development
Create and update individual learning plans in collaboration with families
Collaborate with colleagues and multidisciplinary professionals
Design inspiring learning environments indoors and outdoors

Our daycare units' opening hours range between 6:15-17:30, depending on families needs. As a full-time teacher you work 38.25 hours per week Monday-Friday.

We are looking for professionals who connect well with others and are open to learning and professional growth. You value teamwork and recognise that high-quality pedagogy is built together. You will enjoy this role if you want to fully use your pedagogical expertise and appreciate professional trust and autonomy. You are an advocate of play-based learning and see learning opportunities in everyday moments. As a professional you are reflective, curious and resilient.

Qualification and other requirements to start the Finnish language course in February 2027:
Right to work in Finland, for example, on the basis of EU/EEA citizenship
At least Bachelors degree in Early Childhood Education Your qualification gives you the right to work as an Early Childhood Education Teacher for children aged 0-6 years in the country where the degree was obtained.
At least level B2 in English language
Willingness and ability to commit to learning Finnish language prior to employment contract and relocation. The working language in our daycares is Finnish. During the language course we test your language skill development regularly.

Requirements to enter into a permanent employment contract in January 2028:
Reaching target level B1 in Finnish language
Decision from the Finnish National Agency of Education demonstrating eligibility to work as an ECE teacher in Finland
Criminal record extract from the Legal Register Centre
Proof that you do not have respiratory tuberculosis

We can only enter into a permanent employment contract with you if you meet all the above requirements.

We provide comprehensive support to make your relocation to Finland as smooth as possible:
Assistance with degree recognition process
Remote Finnish language training (10 months, part-time, 4x90min lessons every week + 4-8h/wk independent study, homework and assignments) which you can complete alongside your current employment
Pre-departure training also includes practical information about working and living in Finland
Support in registrations with Finnish authorities upon arrival (also for relocating family members)
Assistance in finding an apartment. As a City of Helsinki employee, you can rent a City-owned apartment and no rental deposit is required.

Language training and relocation schedule:
Feb'27-Dec'27: Finnish language training remotely. Attendance and active participation is essential.
Jan'28: Relocation to Finland and starting work.

Salary and benefits:
Starting salary: €3,298/mth +3-8% experience-based supplements for 5-10 yrs of relevant experience
ePassi benefit: €550/year (sports, culture, wellbeing, commuting)
Comprehensive private occupational health care
Paid annual leave: 23-28 days + 5 extra days for qualified teachers
Holiday bonus pay

Watch our teachers who have already relocated share their experiences of pedagogical work, life in Finland, and the support they received in the relocation process:
Álvaro and Eva: https://youtu.be/KhcaHeu-xLc
Melissa: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6eyjJjnxRiY
Yaiza: https://youtu.be/4IPA8d0pkI4

We warmly welcome you to join a workplace that values your expertise and recognises the potential in both you and the children!

Please note:
(ENG) If you are already living in Finland and hold a degree in early childhood education obtained abroad, please do not apply through this path. Instead, explore our other employment opportunities at www.helsinkirekry.fi and https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals or contact us at rekry.kasko@hel.fi.
(FIN) Jos asut jo Suomessa ja sinulla on ulkomailla suoritettu varhaiskasvatuksen tutkinto, älä hae tähän polkuun. Tutustu sen sijaan muihin työpaikkoihimme osoitteessa www.helsinkirekry.fi ja työllistymispolkuihimme osoitteessa https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals, tai ota meihin yhteyttä: rekry.kasko@hel.fi.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
About DEUNA ð§¡

 

DEUNA is a rapidly growing startup revolutionizing global commerce with ATHIA, our AI-powered orchestration and payments platform that helps large enterprises boost approval rates, reduce costs, and unlock new revenue. Built by the team behind DEUNAâthe fastest-growing Commerce OS in Latin AmericaâATHIA combines payment intelligence, checkout optimization, and data orchestration in one powerful solution.

 

With deep integrations across 300+ PSPs and alternative payment methods, and over 20% of Mexicoâs digital economy running through our platform, we simplify global payments through a single integration and centralized reconciliation.

We are a rapidly growing startup expanding into the U.S. to meet the urgent needs of large retailers, marketplaces, airlines, and QSRs. Join us to shape the future of payments! ð

 

Visit https://www.deuna.com/ to learn more about us!


About the Role

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will be the primary technical point of contact for our merchants after their initial go-live.

You will help monitor merchant technical health, support incident management, answer ongoing technical questions, and guide merchants through future technical evolutions.

For DEUNAâs premium and key accounts, the TAM plays a critical role in making sure merchants feel technically protected, proactively monitored, and confident operating on our platform.

Your mission is to help ensure every merchant is operationally stable, technically satisfied, and continuously improving on DEUNA.

 

 

Responsibilities

Proactively monitor merchant technical health

  • Monitor merchant performance, transaction behavior, errors, declines, latency, and anomalies.

  • Identify potential risks before they become merchant-impacting issues.

  • Raise internal flags when technical or operational risks are detected.

  • Help maintain account-specific dashboards, alerts, and health views for key merchants.

Be the main technical contact after go-live

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for merchant questions and doubts after go-live.

  • Help merchants understand technical flows, configurations, integrations, and platform behavior.

  • Coordinate internally with Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, and Account Management when merchant needs require cross-functional support.

Support technical incident management

  • Triage merchant-reported and internally detected issues.

  • Escalate issues to the appropriate on-call, Engineering, Product, or Operations teams.

  • Track resolution and ensure timely internal and external follow-up.

  • Help ensure communication with merchants is clear, factual, and timely.

  • Support post-incident follow-up, including impact explanation, corrective actions, and prevention measures when required.

Drive merchant technical improvements

  • Identify opportunities to improve merchant performance, stability, acceptance rate, routing behavior, fraud flows, provider configuration, or processing cost.

  • Partner with Account Management to support merchant expansion and long-term account growth.

  • Help merchants adopt new payment methods, providers, features, or technical capabilities after launch.

Build merchant health visibility

  • Build and deliver simple Merchant Health Reports periodically to Account Management and/or merchants.

  • Maintain accurate technical documentation for merchant-specific configurations, customizations, providers, integrations, and known risks.

  • Help prioritize and advocate for merchantsâ technical needs internally.

 

 

Requirements

  • 3+ years in Technical Account Management, Merchant Support, Solutions Engineering, Technical Customer Success, or similar roles.

  • Strong technical understanding of online payment ecosystems, including APIs, SDKs, transaction flows, processors, acquirers, fraud tools, chargebacks, refunds, captures, and 3DS.

  • Experience with incident management, post-launch technical operations, technical troubleshooting, and client-facing support.

  • Ability to analyze logs, dashboards, error patterns, transaction behavior, and operational metrics.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong organization, ownership, urgency, and follow-up discipline.

  • Fluent in Spanish and English.

  • Experience working with LatAm merchants is a must.

  • Startup environment experience is a plus.

 

 

What Success Looks Like

A successful TAM helps premium merchants feel that DEUNA is actively watching over their payment operation, not simply reacting when something breaks.

The TAM should help ensure that:

  • Merchant issues are detected and escalated quickly.

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

  • Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints: model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

Preferred:

  • Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source.

jobs.title: Zámečník kolejových vozidel, Mechanici a opraváři kolejových vozidel
jobs.description:
Místo výkonu práce: Dělnická č.p. 1408/29
Děčín VI-Letná, 405 02  Děčín 2

Jsme ryze česká, rodinná firma s více než stoletou tradicí, umíme revidovat a opravovat nákladní železniční vozy. Děláme to profesionálně, s nadšením, respektem a láskou. Máme zákazníky z celé Evropy. Dokud budou jezdit vlaky, budeme tu taky.
U nás se rychle rozhodujeme, máme přehledné procesy a jasné postupy, umíme naslouchat, reagujeme na podněty, problémy neřešíme. Jsme stabilní, spolehlivý a slušný zaměstnavatel. O svých více než 350 zaměstnanců se staráme, vážíme se svých lidí i lidské práce. I díky tomu rosteme, rozvíjíme se, modernizujeme a daří se nám. U nás platí podání ruky, neslibujeme, co nemůžeme splnit, jednáme na rovinu. Šikovní, ochotní a pracovití kolegové se u nás mají dobře.
Topíme, svítíme, opravujeme. Práci máme nasmlouvanou na několik let dopředu, daří se nám, proto i dnes nabíráme nové kolegy. Rádi mezi nás přijmeme lidi, kteří se nebojí práce. Právě teď oslovujeme ty z vás, kteří věří, že se k nám hodí, mají rádi vlaky a bavilo by je u nás pracovat 5, 10, 15, 20 i více let.
Hledáme totiž šikovné a spolehlivé dělníky pro pracoviště Děčín.

Náplň práce:
Práce při opravě nákladních vlaků - broušení, čištění, tryskání, vrtání, soustružení, demontáž, kontrola, výměna dílů, montáž… jedná se o dělnickou pozici. Hlavní činností RYKO je provádět technickou kontrolu železničních vozů. Budete ten, kdo umí rozebrat jednotlivé části vagónu, zkontrolovat je, opravit nebo vyměnit a poté změřit. Pracujete s úhlovou bruskou, pneu nářadím, gola sadou, autogenem a někteří i se svářečkou. Vaším úkolem bude rozebrat šroubové spoje, odmontovat nebo namontovat díl, umět narovnat plech nebo vyměnit pororošt nebo prkno. Pracujete u nás také s měřidly, měřícími zařízeními a s počítačem. Umíte nejen opravit rozbitou část vozu, ale i vyplnit protokol, namazat nárazník nebo provést zkoušku brzy. Ze zámečníka jsme schopni vychovat paliče, svářeče, brzdaře, lakýrníka, písmomalíře nebo tlakaře. Ze zámečníka se může stát také četař nebo mistr. Pracujete u nás s železničními nákladními vozy a jejich jednotlivými díly v jednosměnném nebo dvousměnném provozu od pondělí do pátku.

Požadujeme:
Vzdělání - vyučení výhodou (zámečník, mechanik, strojař, automechanik, instalatér..)
Manuální zručnost
Vhodná pracovní zkušenost, zkušenost s výše uvedenými pracemi
Pečlivost, přesnost a zodpovědnost
Ochota a zájem pracovat a občas chodit na přesčasy (12 hodin/měsíc)

Nabízíme:
• Několikaměsíční zaškolení a zapracování pod vedením zkušených kolegů, kteří u nás dlouhé roky pracují
• Práci na dlouhodobě nasmlouvaných zakázkách, stabilní, rodinné prostředí a lidský přístup
• Práci v jednosměnném nebo dvousměnném provozu (ranní a odpolední směny), Po - Pá, občas • So, neděle vždy volné.

Termín nástupu: dohodou

Mzdové podmínky:
• Mzda má fixní a variabilní složku, která je závislá na výkonu, každý potřebný přesčas platíme a za nadstandartní počty přesčasových hodin jsou zvláštní bonusy
• Výše nástupní mzdy dle znalostí a zkušenostní, konkrétní mzdové podmínky pro nástup, období zapracování a možnosti růstu vysvětlíme u pohovoru

jobs.title: Projektstilling i projekt med at være kirke for unge i Aarhus
jobs.description:
Kan du se dig selv i en vision om at folkekirken tilbyder et sted for unge i Aarhus, hvor man kan hænge ud og indgå i fællesskaber? Er du relationelt orienteret? Og har du det fint med både at sidde til planlægningsmøder og løfte konkrete, praktiske opgaver – så tror vi, at du vil finde dette opslag interessant.

For godt et års tid siden åbnede Christianskirken i Aarhus STEDET. Her kan unge i Aarhus hænge ud, sidde med deres studier, deltage i aktiviteter, møde andre unge til fællesspisning og få et møde med kirken i øjenhøjde. Er du den, som skal være med til at videreudvikle og konsolidere dét arbejde?

 

STEDET er fysisk lokation på Katrinebjerg, men det er også en måde at vise at kirken er mere end gudstjenester; at kirken er fællesskaber, samtaler om stort og småt, mulighed for at møde andre unge og et pitstop i den hverdag, som unge lever i.

 

Der er tale om en etårig projektstilling på 30 timer ugentligt, med eventuel mulighed for forlængelse, hvis den fremtidige finansiering falder på plads.

Opgaver

Som projektmedarbejder ved Christianskirken, skal du overordnet set være med til at udleve kirkens vision:

Christianskirken - et livstræ med mange grene, der

·        Rækker synligt ud i sognet

·        Peger opad og inspirerer til at søge Gud

·        Styrker og engagerer den enkelte og menigheden

 

    - for at gøre evangeliet kendt, troet og levet.

 

Konkret betyder det, at…

·        du – i samarbejde med bl.a. menighedsrådet, projektets styregruppe og den anden projektmedarbejder – sikrer den daglige drift på STEDET, og i mange sammenhænge er du STEDETs ansigt udadtil.

·        du er vært på STEDET, så de unge der kommer ind ad døren, mærker at de er velkomne her.

·        du ærligt kan sige, at du har lyst til at arbejde sammen med unge, er imødekommende og kan tage initiativ til fx en snak eller igangsætte brætspil.

·        du indgår i et samarbejde med ansatte og frivillige om at planlægge og afvikle forskellige typer af aktiviteter. Fx fællesspisning hvor du veksler mellem at stå i front og ”være den” og stå i baggrunden og få andre til at lykkes i deres frivillige opgave.

·        du sidder med i styregruppen (som består af repræsentanter for menighedsråd, ungdomsråd og ansatte ved Christianskirken) for STEDET, og er med til at sætte retning for projektet, og i mange tilfælde er du ansvarlig for at det som besluttes dér, bliver til virkelighed.

·        du vil være ansvarlig for rekruttering, fastholdelse og udrustning af frivillige. For STEDET er ikke noget, som laves for de unge, men noget vi laver sammen med unge.

·        du får til opgave at pleje og videreudvikle vores netværk med samarbejdspartnere og interessenter i Aarhus. Det er fx uddannelsesinstitutioner, NGO’er som arbejder med unge, naboer på Katrinebjerg, nøglepersoner i Aarhus kommune og kirker i Aarhus.

·        du løser forskellige administrative og koordinerende opgaver såsom at have overblik over vores forbrug og sørge for at betalinger sker rettidigt; booking af lokaler; forberedelse af møder, at vores tillidsbod har varer på hylderne m.v.

 

I det daglige er din nærmeste kollega vores projektmedarbejder, som har fokus på kommunikation og aktiviteter og den præst, som er tilknyttet STEDET og er projektleder. I har hver jeres ansvarsområder, men arbejder sammen om meget af det som sker på STEDET.

 

Vi forventer at du…

·        har en konstruktiv tilgang til tingene og kan samarbejde med både professionelle og amatører.

·        har erfaring fra selv at have frivilligt engageret, og gerne at du har erfaring med engagere, motivere og samarbejde andre frivillige på en måde, så de føler sig påskønnede og som en aktiv del af STEDETS liv og aktiviteter.

·       er nysgerrig på nye mennesker og har det godt med at samle mennesker.

·        kan se idéen i at vi som kirke laver dette tilbud til unge i vores by.

·        er i stand til at omsætte strategiske beslutninger til konkrete handlinger.

·        har syn for både helheden og detaljen, og trives med at arbejde både på et overordnet og et praktisk plan. Nogle dage vil du derfor sidde og udvikle en idé, og andre dage svinger du støvsugeren, så der er klar til næste event.

·        kan lide at arbejde i team med andre, samtidig med at du er god til at arbejde selvstændigt, systematisk og struktureret med dine opgaver.

·        har en faglig eller erfaringsmæssig baggrund, som er relevant for dette job.

·        er fleksibel ift arbejdstid. Der er primært tale om arbejde i dagtimerne, men der er også aftenarbejde i skiftende omfang.

·        kan identificere dig med Christianskirkens samspilsværdier - åbenhed, respekt, omsorg og engagement - samt evner at omsætte disse i relation til andre mennesker.

 

 

Om kirken:

Christianskirken er en aktiv kirke på Christiansbjerg. Kirkens arbejde præges af mere end 400 frivillige, der bidrager til kirkens liv og aktiviteter på forskellig vis.

Vi tilbyder bl.a.:

•        Samarbejde med engagerede kolleger i et godt arbejdsmiljø, der vægter teamsamarbejdet højt.

•        Godt besøgte gudstjenester, der i udtryk og stilarter rummer variation, tradition og fornyelse.  

•        Et rigt menighedsliv.

 

Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte daglig leder, Vibeke Dahmen på 41 72 71 06 eller projektleder Lasse Holmgaard Iversen på 26 25 57 88.

Som ansat ved Christianskirken refererer du overordnet set til menighedsrådet som arbejdsgiver, repræsenteret ved menighedsrådets kontaktperson. I det daglige referer du til Christianskirkens daglige leder, Vibeke Dahmen, der vil forestå den daglige ledelsesopgave, samt til projektleder for STEDET, sognepræst Lasse Holmgaard Iversen. Ansøgningssted: Ansøgning, anbefalinger, referencer samt kopi af evt. eksamensbevis, sendes via sikker mail til kirkekontoret, att. daglig leder Vibeke Dahmen. (Link findes på kirkens hjemmeside).

Omalt poolt pakume: MIKS ASUDA TÖÖLE JUST MARIELL ILUSTUUDIOSSE?
Sest pakume Sulle.. - Imeilusat töökeskkonda - Tallinnas on kümneid ja kümneid töökodasid (Sa tead ju küll neid büroohoone kümnendal korrusel keerates vasakule ja paremale ja korruse lõpus asuvaid "ilusalonge"), milleks Sulle see? Tule asu tööle esinduslikku i-l-u-s-a-l-o-n-g-i! - Turundus - me hoolime sellest, et Sul hakkaks hästi minema. Me ei anna Sulle ainult töökoha vaid aitame Sul ka kliente leida. - 24/7 ligipääsu ruumidele - Sa ei sõltu administraatorist ega kellestki teisest. Tahad tulla hommikul kell 07:00 tööle? Tule! Me teame, millest me räägime ja kuidas oleks asju kõige mugavam korraldada. - Tervisesõbralikkus - meie ruumid vastavad terviseameti nõuetele, et just Sina oleksid hoitud. Veedad suure osa oma päevast tööl, tee seda parimal võimalikul viisil! - Super hea asukoht - Pärnu maantee 23 on ülimalt läbikäidav tänav, püüame kliente ka tänavalt! - Meeskond - ettevõtlus ei ole pelgalt raha teenimine. See on ühised üritused - jõulud, sünnipäevad, naistepäevad. See on kliendipäevad, heategevuspäevad, family mealid ja ka roosad esmaspäevad, kui me seda soovime! - Salongi lahendus - Ilustuudio Mariell Tallinnas on jagatud kolmeks poolkorruseks, ehk et igal iluteenindajate grupil on enda privaatsus.

jobs.title: Global Demo Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As one of Notion’s founding Demo Engineers, you’ll build the global demo engine behind how we bring Notion’s most important customer stories to life. You’ll shape the standards, systems, and experiences that help our Sales teams demonstrate what is possible with Notion, from the first customer conversation through implementation and deployment.



This is a high-impact opportunity to create the function from the ground up. You’ll establish global standards, turn our strongest customer solutions into repeatable demos, and give regional teams the tools and autonomy to innovate. Your work will directly influence how customers understand Notion’s platform, AI capabilities, and potential to transform how their organizations work.



This role reports to the Global Head of Acquisition and partners closely with Sales, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Enablement, and PMM.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build the global demo engine that brings Notion’s most important customer stories to life
   
   - Partner with Enablement and PMM to define the core narratives, scripts, environments, and assets for each demo
   
   - Create a durable release and versioning process so demos stay current as the product evolves
   
   - Automate repeatable setup and maintenance wherever possible so the system can scale globally

 - Turn Notion’s strongest customer and internal solutions into reusable GTM assets
   
   - Identify high-impact use cases and transform them into repeatable, field-ready demos
   
   - Partner with FDE to package customer solutions, implementation guidance, and technical patterns into demos the field can confidently deliver
   
   - Work with GTM Systems to translate demos into workspaces that can be deployed in customer environments

 - Set the global standard for demo quality and help the field deliver it
   
   - Define what great looks like for each demo moment, from the first customer conversation to a tailored technical experience
   
   - Train and coach customer-facing teams on storytelling, environment setup, delivery, and troubleshooting
   
   - Partner with Enablement to create practical resources and programs that raise demo quality across regions

 - Create a clear path from experimentation to global scale
   
   - Give customer-facing teams a structured way to safely build, test, and pilot new demo concepts
   
   - Evaluate the strongest ideas and turn them into scalable standards, templates, and reusable assets

 - Serve as the strategic demo partner for high-impact opportunities
   
   - Advise teams on custom or personalized demos that fall outside the standard portfolio
   
   - Help teams balance customer relevance, technical credibility, and speed without compromising quality




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years in a technical or customer-facing role such as Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Demo Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Software Engineering

 - Experience designing and delivering technical demos, prototypes, or solution experiences for a SaaS product

 - Strong systems thinking, with experience building scalable standards, templates, documentation, versioning practices, and operating processes

 - Ability to translate complex product capabilities into clear, compelling customer stories tied to business value

 - Technical fluency across APIs, integrations, automation, data, permissions, and enterprise security concepts

 - Working proficiency with scripting or automation tools such as Python or JavaScript

 - Experience partnering across Sales, Product, Engineering, Enablement, and Marketing to drive alignment and deliver shared outcomes

 - Strong communication and coaching skills, with the ability to raise the capabilities of customer-facing teams

 - Comfort creating structure, setting priorities, and making progress in a fast-moving environment with evolving requirements




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience building or scaling a demo engineering, solutions engineering, or technical enablement function

 - Experience with enterprise sales cycles and complex, multi-stakeholder customer environments

 - Hands-on experience with demo automation platforms such as Consensus, Navattic, Reprise, Storylane, or Demostack

 - Experience supporting major product launches or global go-to-market programs

 - Familiarity with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor

 - Experience with productivity, collaboration, AI, or horizontal SaaS products

 - Notion power user
   


TOOLS YOU'LL USE:

 - Demo environments: Notion, plus demo automation platforms as needed

 - Collaboration: Slack, Salesforce, Gong for call review

 - Automation: Zapier, scripting tools, API clients (Postman or similar)

 - AI Coding Tools: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is $220,000 - $250,000 per year.


By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Holstedgaard er et socialpsykiatrisk botilbud, hvor der bor 69 beboere fordelt på flere teams og med forskellige psykiatriske diagnoser. Som en særlig og spændende faglig udfordring har mange af vores beboere også komplicerede somatiske lidelser.

Dine vigtigste opgaver hos os vil være:

  • Helhedsorienteret sygepleje: Ansvar for den grundlæggende og komplekse sygepleje hos beboerne med et skarpt blik for både de psykiske og somatiske problemstillinger.

  • Faglig dokumentation: Sikre høj kvalitet i den sundhedsfaglige og socialpædagogiske dokumentation.

  • Metodisk arbejde: Indgå i teamsamarbejdet med afsæt i Holstedgaards socialpædagogiske metoder.

  • Tværfagligt samarbejde: At være en del af et tværfagligt team med blandt andet pædagoger, social- og sundhedsassistenter samt en skolelærer.

Dine kompetencer:

  • Du er uddannet og autoriseret sygeplejerske – gerne med erfaring inden for psykiatri eller en specialuddannelse i psykiatrisk sygepleje.

  • Du drives af at arbejde med mennesker med sammensatte behov og af at støtte dem i forhold til både personlig pleje og psykisk omsorg.

  • Du har lyst til at udvikle dig fagligt og ser fælles succes som målet.

  • Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til principperne i Low Arousal, Recovery og KRAP-modellen – men det er ikke et krav, da vi sørger for, at du bliver klædt godt på hos os.

Det får du hos os:

  • Et stærkt fagligt miljø med regelmæssig ekstern supervision samt intern og ekstern undervisning.

  • En uformel personalekultur præget af nysgerrighed, fleksibilitet, åbenhed og engagement samt masser af humor og glæde.

  • En skøn samling af beboere, som altid byder på gode udfordringer og godt samvær.

  • Personalegoder: Sundhedsforsikring, adgang til motionsrum samt personalearrangementer og julegaver.

  • Pædagogiske måltider: Maden er inkluderet og dækket som en del af dit arbejde.

Det praktiske

  • Arbejdstid: Som udgangspunkt er stillingen enten en en aftenvagt eller dagvagt med arbejde i weekender og helligdage. De præcise rammer drøfter vi nærmere ved en eventuel samtale.

  • Straffeattest: Stillingen er omfattet af loven om pligt til at indhente straffeattest. Ansættelsen kan først påbegyndes, når en tilfredsstillende attest foreligger.

  • Kørekort: Ikke et must, men en absolut fordel.

Vil du vide mere?

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Ann-Sofie Hartvig på telefon 22 75 77 35.

Ansøgningsproces

Er denne stilling noget for dig? Så glæder vi os rigtig meget til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.

Vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler løbende. Bemærk venligst, at vi ikke sender bekræftelse for modtagne ansøgninger. Hvis du ikke har hørt fra os inden annoncens udløb, er stillingen besat til en anden ansøger. Dine oplysninger gemmes og behandles fortroligt ud fra GDPR.

jobs.description:
*Job Title:** Housekeeping & Breakfast Attendant
**Location:** Hótel Skógafoss / Hótel Anna, Skógar, Iceland
**Position:** Full-Time
**Start Date:** November 15, 2026

Hótel Skógafoss and Hótel Anna, located in the beautiful surroundings of South Iceland, are seeking a dedicated and versatile individual to join our team in a full-time capacity. The ideal candidate will be a proactive and reliable professional responsible for maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness and ensuring our guests have a wonderful start to their day.

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Performing comprehensive cleaning of guest rooms and public areas to ensure a comfortable and welcoming environment.
* Managing all aspects of the daily breakfast service, including setting up and replenishing the buffet, and ensuring the dining area is clean and well-presented.
* Handling the hotel's laundry services, including washing, drying, and folding linens.
* Providing excellent customer service, assisting guests with inquiries, and processing payments for breakfast when required.

**The Ideal Candidate:**
* Has proven experience in housekeeping and/or food and beverage service.
* Is fluent in English and possesses excellent communication skills. Proficiency in other languages is a strong asset.
* Holds a valid B-category driver's license.
* Is a dependable team player with a positive attitude and a strong work ethic.
* Is flexible and willing to work a varied schedule.

**What We Offer:**
* A stable, full-time position in a friendly and dynamic work environment.
* Competitive wages according to the collective bargaining agreement with the VLFS union.
* **On-site accommodation is available for a fee.**
* The opportunity to live and work in one of Iceland's most scenic areas.

**How to Apply:**
We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis.

Interested parties are requested to send an application along with a CV to the email address: johann@ejhotels.is or applications@ejhotels.is
Last application date is November 15th , 2026.

***

**Starfsheiti:** Umsjónaraðili herbergja og morgunverðar
**Staðsetning:** Hótel Skógafoss / Hótel Anna, Skógum
**Starfshlutfall:** Fullt starf
**Starf hefst:** 15. nóvember 2026

Hótel Skógafoss og Hótel Anna, staðsett í hinu fallega umhverfi Suðurlands, óska eftir að ráða þjónustulundaðan og fjölhæfan einstakling í fullt starf. Leitum að ábyrgum og traustum aðila sem hefur metnað til að viðhalda ýtrustu kröfum um hreinlæti og tryggja að gestir okkar fái frábæra byrjun á deginum.

**Helstu verkefni og ábyrgðarsvið:**
* Umfangsmikil þrif á herbergjum og sameiginlegum rýmum hótelsins til að tryggja snyrtilegt og notalegt umhverfi.
* Fullnaðarumsjón með morgunverðarþjónustu, þ.m.t. undirbúningur og áfylling á hlaðborð.
* Umsjón með þvotti hótelsins, s.s. þvottur, þurrkun og frágangur á líni.
* Veita framúrskarandi þjónustu, aðstoða gesti og taka við greiðslum fyrir morgunverð þegar við á.

**Hæfniskröfur:**
* Sönnuð reynsla af þrifum og/eða störfum í veitingaþjónustu er skilyrði.
* Mjög góð enskukunnátta og framúrskarandi samskiptahæfni. Kunnátta í öðrum tungumálum er mikill kostur.

* Áreiðanleiki, jákvæðni og hæfni til að vinna vel í hóp.
* Sveigjanleiki og vilji til að vinna á breytilegum vöktum.

**Það sem við bjóðum:**

* Laun samkvæmt gildandi kjarasamningi við VLFS.

jobs.title: Pædagog søges til Holstedgaard
jobs.description:
Er du vores nye Kollega

Brænder du for at skabe meningsfulde relationer og understøtte mennesker i at leve det liv, de ønsker? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til vores engagerede medarbejdergruppe på Holstedgaard.

På Holstedgaard udvider vi vores personalegruppe og søger en pædagog, der gennem tillidsfulde relationer kan motivere, inddrage og samarbejde med vores beboere. Vi arbejder målrettet for, at beboerne oplever medbestemmelse, tryghed og et hjemligt miljø, hvor deres ønsker, behov og drømme er i centrum.

Vores botilbud er først og fremmest beboernes hjem. Da flere af vores beboere udover psykiske lidelser også har somatiske problemstillinger, yder vi en helhedsorienteret indsats. Som pædagog hos os skal du derfor forvente, at der også er perioder, hvor du skal deltage i og være ansvarlig for, at der udføres personlig pleje som en naturlig del af beboerens hverdag og trivsel.

Om Holstedgaard

Holstedgaard har 69 pladser fordelt på flere teams. Vi tilbyder både midlertidige og længerevarende ophold efter Servicelovens §§ 107 og 108 til borgere over 18 år. Målgruppen er mennesker med forskellige psykiatriske lidelser og ofte komplekse somatiske problemstillinger.

Vi er i gang med at implementere og forankre KRAP (Kognitiv, Ressourcefokuseret og Anerkendende Pædagogik), som danner rammen om vores faglige tilgang. Her arbejder vi med fokus på beboernes styrker, ressourcer og udviklingsmuligheder.

Stillingen indebærer dag- og aftenvagter samt arbejde hver anden weekend.

Vi søger en kollega, der:

  • Er uddannet pædagog eller har anden relevant socialpædagogisk uddannelse.

  • Er indstillet på at tage ansvar for og deltage i den personlige pleje og somatiske understøttelse af beboerne.

  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for det socialpædagogiske område, gerne inden for psykiatrien.

  • Arbejder fagligt reflekteret og kan omsætte teori og metode til praksis.

  • Kan dokumentere faglige indsatser og følge op på mål og delmål.

  • Er ansvarlig, fleksibel og kan bevare overblikket i en varieret hverdag.

  • Trives med både selvstændigt arbejde og samarbejde i mindre teams.

  • Værdsætter kollegial sparring, feedback og fælles refleksion.

  • Er initiativrig og ønsker at bidrage til den fortsatte udvikling af vores botilbud.

  • Har mod på at indgå i et læringsmiljø, hvor nysgerrighed, faglig udvikling og refleksion er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

  • Kørekort er ikke et krav, men vil være en fordel.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En engageret og fagligt stærk medarbejdergruppe med fokus på både socialpædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige indsatser.

  • En mangfoldig gruppe beboere, som bidrager til en spændende og meningsfuld hverdag.

  • En uformel og anerkendende arbejdskultur med plads til humor og fællesskab.

  • Indflydelse og medansvar i et teamsamarbejde under fortsat udvikling,med fokus på trivsel og arbejdsglæde.

  • Løbende supervision.

  • Sundhedsforsikring.

Praktiske oplysninger

  • Timetal: Stillingen er på 25-37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

  • Ansættelsesproces: Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat høre du ikke fra os er stillingen gået til anden side.

  • Straffeattest: Stillingen er omfattet af reglerne om indhentelse af straffeattest. Ansættelse kan først finde sted, når tilfredsstillende straffeattest foreligger.

  • GDPR: Vi behandler og opbevarer alle personoplysninger i overensstemmelse med gældende GDPR-regler.

Vil du vide mere?

Du er velkommen til at kontakte Ann-Sofie Hartvig på telefon 22757735.

Ansøgning og CV sendes til: ash@holstedgaard.dk

jobs.title: Policy and Information Officer
jobs.description:

ICOS is seeking an experienced Policy and Information Officer to join our Communications Team. The role combines directly engaging with and supporting international students with broader member and stakeholder consultation to inform our advocacy work. Key responsibilities Information and enquiries •Respond to enquiries from international students and ICOS members, providing accurate, accessible information, signposting and referrals within the boundaries of ICOS’ role; escalate complex or sensitive issues as appropriate. •Research, verify and maintain practical information resources on the issues affecting the rights of international students, including: immigration, employment, accommodation, education and student welfare. •Record and analyse enquiries and member feedback, identifying recurring and emerging issues to inform ICOS’ policy positions, communications and reporting. Policy and research •Monitor relevant policy, legislative and regulatory developments affecting international students and international education in Ireland. •Research issues and analyse evidence from enquiries, student engagement and other sources to inform ICOS’ policy positions and recommendations. •Draft policy submissions, consultation responses, briefings and advocacy correspondence, and support engagement with government, public bodies, members and other stakeholders. Communications and member engagement •As part of communications team, contribute to: researching, drafting, editing and proofreading accurate, accessible content for ICOS’ website, member updates, email mailings and social media, translating complex information for different audiences. •Prepare and coordinate regular member mailings and information updates, supporting engagement and information-sharing with ICOS members. •Use website content management systems, email marketing or mailing platforms and social media tools to publish and distribute content, keeping information up to date. •Work with communications colleagues to plan content and campaigns and promote ICOS’ policy work, research, events and resources. •Support the planning and delivery of ICOS seminars, consultations, workshops, campaigns and other student and stakeholder engagement activities. International student engagement •Coordinate ICOS’ Student Advisory Group, including recruitment, communications, meeting planning, facilitation and follow-up. •Develop inclusive opportunities for international students to contribute through consultations, focus groups, surveys, events and campaigns. •Build relationships with international students and student representatives, ensuring their perspectives inform ICOS’ information, policy and communications work. •Provide support to the Ireland Fellows Programme events and activities, including participant support when required. Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Data & Analytics Department.

The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs. 

As Student Assistant, you will support various initiatives across the department, with a primary focus on NRCC's analytics platform ‘BluePool’, and data governance activities.

BluePool Support

Data Governance

jobs.title: OT Security Architect - Renewables, Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced and motivated OT Security Architect and do you want to leave your mark on the global energy industry? If so, we want to hear from you! 
 
Your position
 
In your new position as OT Security Architect in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the OT Security Team, whose mission is to ensure excellent OT security deliveries on large-scale EPC substation projects. You will have the chance to take the architectural lead and help shape a collaborative team culture built on expertise and knowledge-sharing. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be at one of our offices in either Esbjerg or Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel 10–30 days per year.

“Every day, we help enable the green energy transition by building secure, resilient OT solutions that ensure renewable energy assets operate safely and reliably.” - OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.
 
Your tasks & responsibilities 

In our Renewables division, we have major EPC projects in the pipeline for both short- and long-term operations. As an OT Security Architect, you will take the architectural lead and support all OT Security areas across the EPC substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Contributing to the implementation of industry-accepted good practice and required Cyber/OT Security architecture at solution level, typically based on standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and NIS
  • Helping define products and standards relevant to OT Security and infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience with cybersecurity audits and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Critical Infrastructure regulations, and IEC 62443
  • Reviewing requirements/ITT packages and providing input to tenders consisting of calculations, solutions, descriptions, clarifications, and reservations
  • Taking on an advisory or active role in infrastructure, identity access management, or logging/event-based activities
  • Being responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing FAT, SAT, and SIT activities to ensure successful system delivery and integration
  • Implementing customer-specific Cyber/OT Security requirements in substation design for multiple systems and subsystems, such as SCADA, low-voltage, HVAC, Auxiliary Control and Monitoring System, etc.


Crucial to this position is your ability to take ownership of project deliverables and coordinate OT Security deadlines with internal and external stakeholders. You should thrive in a leading role where your skills, collaboration, and structured approach help ensure that requirements are met.
 
Your profile & qualifications

You are a team player who enjoys leading projects and working with stakeholders to align on timing, scope, and objectives. You know when technical expertise should be brought in to support delivery. To us, this means that you have a structured and solution-oriented approach, the ability to influence stakeholders, and the dedication to see tasks through to completion.

You will be part of a team of six colleagues that values quality, attention to detail, and a flexible working environment. We are sociable, helpful, and open to input, and we work in a dedicated, structured, and execution-focused way while respecting the agility that is a natural part of our core tasks. We want the same from you.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in OT Security from a similar position
  • A Tech Lead mentality – we are not seeking an extreme subject matter expert, but a well-rounded colleague who can work through heavily structured large projects involving many stakeholders 
  • The ability to know when additional technical specialists or resources are needed to complete a project
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English
  • Experience working in complex engineering projects, as well as project and stakeholder management, is an advantage


If you have any questions, you are more than welcome to contact OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.
 
Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey: how to get there. We provide the answers needed to make change real, because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever, pragmatic solutions. This is what we do, and this is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.
So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.
